articles.title: GameHorizon Suite: Multi-Horizon Data and Evaluation in Gameplay
articles.content: Modern video games provide a measurable testbed for AI models, combining abilities of visual understanding, instruction decomposition, goal planning, and precise action control over multiple temporal horizons. Existing datasets and benchmarks, however, either cover a narrow range of games, lack language instructions, or rely on high-variance online rollouts. To address these challenges, we introduce GameHorizon, a unified data and evaluation suite that measures gameplay capabilities at different horizons for diverse model families. GameHorizon Suite consists of three components. First, GameHorizon-Annotator is a scalable and automated annotation pipeline for multi-horizon instructions. Second, utilizing the pipeline, we construct GameHorizon-Data, the first large-scale AAA gameplay dataset with temporally aligned videos, player actions, and multi-horizon instructions. It comprises 5,000 hours of recordings from 21 games, collected by 100 human expert players. Third, we build GameHorizon-Bench with reproducible offline and stepwise online testing. The offline track enables reproducible evaluation using thousands of standardized questions organized into three primary tasks and a series of diagnostic variants, while the online track tests whether offline scores reflect actual gameplay capabilities and localizes failures to specific steps within long-horizon gameplay. Based on our GameHorizon Suite, we evaluate 47 models through more than one million model invocations, revealing a meaningful hierarchy of task difficulty and pronounced differences in model capabilities. Our work can provide a standardized yardstick for evaluating gameplay capabilities across horizons and model families. We will release our dataset, annotator, and benchmark to facilitate future research.

articles.title_zh: GameHorizon 套接字:游戏游戏中的多视野数据和评价
articles.content_zh: 现代电子游戏为AI模型提供了一个可测量的测试台,结合了视觉理解能力,指令分解能力,目标规划能力,以及对多时域的精确动作控制能力. 然而,现有的数据集和基准要么涵盖范围狭窄的游戏,要么缺乏语言指令,要么依赖高差异的在线推出. 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了GameHorizon,这是一个统一的数据和评价套件,用于衡量不同视野的游戏游戏能力,供不同的模范家庭使用. GameHorizon Suite由三个组件组成. 首先,GameHorizon-Annotator是多视距指令的可伸缩和自动化注解管道. 第二,利用管道,我们构建了GameHorizon-Data,这是第一个大型的AAA游戏游戏数据集,有时间对齐的视频,玩家动作,以及多视距指令. 它由来自21个游戏的5000小时录音组成,由100名人类专家玩家收集. 第三,我们建造GameHorizon-Bench,采用可复制的离线和逐步在线测试。 离线赛道可以使用被组织成三大任务和一系列诊断变体的上千个标准化问题进行可再生评价,而在线赛道测试离线分数是否反映了实际的游戏游戏能力并本地化了对长视游戏游戏内特定步骤的失败. 基于我们的GameHorizon Suite,我们通过超过一百万个模型引用来评价47个模型,揭示了有意义的任务难度等级,并宣告了模型能力的差异. 我们的工作可以为评估跨地平线游戏能力和模范家庭提供一个标准化的尺度。 我们将公布我们的数据集、注释员和基准,以促进今后的研究。

articles.title: VideoGen-Agent: Reinforcing Video Generation Agents
articles.content: Recent advances in video generative models have enabled high-fidelity, temporally coherent video generation. However, these models often struggle to satisfy prompts requiring specialized knowledge, specific identities, physical consistency, or ordered events. In this paper, we present VideoGen-Agent, a multimodal agent trained through multitask agentic reinforcement learning to use external tools for video generation. The agent coordinates augmentation, generation, and verification tools through multi-turn interactions, using the prompt and intermediate observations to guide its decisions. We train a shared policy on a category-balanced dataset spanning six tasks. Supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated trajectories establishes tool-use behavior, which is then refined through reinforcement learning. A category-aware hybrid reward evaluates tool-call validity, task-appropriate tool use, and generated video quality. We further introduce VABench, a held-out benchmark of 600 prompts covering procedural knowledge, single- and multi-entity identity preservation, physical consistency, scene composition, and multi-shot temporal structure. On VABench, VideoGen-Agent improves over its base text-to-video generator by 19.1 points, from 56.5 to 75.6. Upgrading the generation tools further raises the score to 86.1 without additional agent training. Human raters prefer the upgraded configuration over the strongest standalone baseline in 84.3% of comparisons. These results support learning tool use across video-generation tasks and show that the trained agent can benefit from subsequent advances in generation tools.

articles.title_zh: 视频Gen代理:强化视频生成代理
articles.content_zh: 视频基因模型的近期进步使得视频产生具有高度真实性、时间一致性。 然而,这些模式往往难以满足需要专门知识、具体身份、身体一致性或命令的事件的提示。 在本文中,我们介绍了VideoGen-Agent,这是一个通过多任务代理强化学习培训的多模式代理,使用外部工具制作视频. 物剂通过多回合互动,利用即时和中间观测来协调增强、生成和核查工具,以指导其决定。 我们在一个涉及六项任务的类别平衡数据集上培训一项共同政策。 对教师所出轨迹的监督微调确立了工具使用行为,然后通过强化学习来完善. 一个有意识的混合奖励评价工具调用的有效性,适合任务的工具使用,并产生视频质量. 我们进一步引入了VA Bench, 即600个提示的基准, 涵盖程序知识、单实体和多实体身份保存、物理一致性、场景组成和多镜头时间结构。 在VA Bench上,VideoGen-Agent比其基本的文本到视频生成器改进了19.1分,从56.5分到75.6分. 在不进行额外的代理培训的情况下,将生成工具的升级进一步将分数提高到86.1分. 在84.3%的比较中,人们更喜欢升级的配置,而不是最强的独立基线。 这些成果支持在视频生成任务中使用学习工具,并表明训练有素的代理人能够从随后生成工具的进步中受益.

articles.title: WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory
articles.content: Video world models enable interactive exploration of dynamic environments, yet struggle to respect prior observations over long horizons and across viewpoints. We present WorldCrafter, a video world model that learns a camera-queryable implicit 3D-aware memory for this purpose. The key insight is to let the requested viewpoint shape how multi-view evidence is compressed into the video generator's limited token budget. Trained jointly with the video generator, a memory encoder and pose-conditioned readout module integrate historical observations into a fixed set of target view-specific tokens before denoising, without explicit depth-based correspondences. By combining this memory with recent temporal context and few-step distillation, WorldCrafter enables streaming scene exploration from a single input image or text prompt. Experiments across static and dynamic scenes show substantial gains in long-horizon consistency and camera-control accuracy while preserving visual quality during minute-scale exploration.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: WorldCrafter:具有隐形3D意识的一致视频世界模型 内存
articles.content_zh: 视频世界模型能够对动态环境进行互动探索,但努力在长期和跨观点中尊重先前的观察。 我们介绍WorldCrafter, 一个视频世界模型, 学习一个相机可调速 隐含的 3D 意识的记忆, 关键见解是让所请求的观点塑造多视图证据如何被压缩到视频生成器有限的象征性预算之中. 与视频生成器,内存编码器和装设条件的读出模块联合训练,在解密前将历史观测数据整合到一组固定的目标视域特定符号中,没有明确的深度对应. 通过将这个内存与最近的时间上下文和几步蒸馏相结合,WorldCrafter使流传的场景探索能够从单一的输入图像或文本的提示中进行. 跨越静态和动态场景的实验显示,在长视距一致性和照相机控制准确性方面有很大提高,同时在分钟的探索中保持视觉质量.

articles.title: GAE: Learning a Geometry-Native Latent Space for 3D-Consistent World Generation
articles.content: We present a compact geometry-native latent space as a shared foundation for perception and generation. Visual generators can produce photorealistic frames without preserving a consistent 3D scene. We argue that this is not only a modeling problem but also a representation problem: generators typically evolve appearance-centric latents, while perception models recover geometry in a semantically rich space that encodes cross-view structure. Rather than adding geometry as another output, we reparameterize a geometry foundation model's features into a compact latent space for generation. We realize this shift with the geometry-native autoencoder (GAE), whose latent is jointly decodable to appearance, depth, cameras, and point maps. With this state, a standard conditional flow supports diverse generation tasks. In controlled comparisons that hold the generator and training protocol fixed, replacing the latent with GAE improves both visual quality and independently measured 3D coherence: FVD falls by $12.7\%$ and $23.1\%$ on RealEstate10K and DL3DV, and camera-trajectory error is halved on RealEstate10K. Together, these results show that the latent space is central to geometry-consistent generation and can serve as a shared interface between perception and generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GAE:为3D-恒定世界一代学习几何-自然后期空间
articles.content_zh: 我们提供了一个紧凑的几何-内在的潜在空间,作为感知和生成的共同基础。 视觉生成器可以在不保留一致的3D场景的情况下产生光现实化帧. 我们认为,这不仅是一个建模问题,而且也是一个代表性问题:发电机通常演化出以外观为中心的潜质,而感知模型则在一个拼接着交叉视野结构的丰富空间中恢复几何学。 我们不是将几何学作为另一种输出,而是将一个几何基础模型的特征重新调整成一个紧凑的潜在的生成空间。 我们用几何-本地自动编码器(GAE)来意识到这一转变,其潜伏性可以共同解码到外观,深度,摄像头和点图上. 有了这种状态,标准的条件流支持不同的生成任务. 在控制比较中,将生成器和培训协议固定下来,用GAE取代潜伏物既能提高视觉质量,又能独立测量到3D一致性:在RealEstate10K和DL3DV上,FVD下降了12.7美元和23.1美元,在RealEstate10K上,相机-弹射误差减半. 这些结果共同表明,潜在的空间是几何-一致生成的核心,可以作为感知与生成之间的共享界面.

articles.title: DexTacWAM: A Visuo-Tactile World-Action Model for Dexterous Manipulation
articles.content: Dexterous manipulation depends on contact dynamics that are often only partially observable from vision. Recent World-Action Models (WAMs) couple predictive video world modeling with action generation, but remain largely vision-centric and therefore cannot directly model these contact dynamics. We present DexTacWAM, a visuo-tactile WAM that encodes each fingertip independently, aggregates the resulting features through a finger- and pose-aware tactile compressor, and injects the tactile latent into a video diffusion world model for joint visuo-tactile world modeling. Across six contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks on a 22-DoF bimanual platform, DexTacWAM achieves the highest score on every task, averaging 70.6 versus 38.0 for the strongest baseline. Ablations attribute the gain to modeling contact evolution as part of the predicted world state rather than tactile conditioning alone: removing tactile world modeling reduces the four-task mean from 74.7 to 26.6 while keeping the same tactile features and action expert. After four hours of tactile-encoder adaptation with a frozen pretrained vision VAE, our continual vision-to-touch learning extends the pretrained video model to touch using roughly 100 demonstrations per task without tactile midtraining, while retaining visual prediction quality within 0.5 dB of vision-only counterparts. The compressor retains 89.4% of pre-fusion contact recall while enabling 2.26x faster training and 1.29x faster inference. Together, these results show that pretrained video priors can be extended to distributed multi-finger contact dynamics in a data- and compute-efficient manner.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DexTacWAM:用于Dexterous操纵的维苏奥-Tactile世界行动模型
articles.content_zh: Dexterous的操纵取决于接触动态,而接触动态往往只能从视觉中部分地观察到. 最近的世界行动模型(WAMS)将预测性视频世界模型与行动生成结合起来,但在很大程度上仍然是以视觉为中心,因此无法直接模拟这些接触动态。 我们介绍DexTacWAM, 一种独立编码每个指尖的粘着式WAM, 通过手指和姿势知觉的触觉压缩器来汇总所产生的特征, 并将触觉潜入视频传播世界模型, 用于联合粘着式世界模型。 在22 DoF双人平台上的6个接触力很强的操纵任务中,DexTacWAM在每项任务上都取得了最高的得分,最强基线的平均得分为70.6比38.0. 缩写将增益归结于模拟接触进化,作为预测世界状态的一部分,而不只是触觉调节:去除触觉世界模型将四任务平均值从74.7降至26.6,同时保持相同的触觉特征和行动专家. 经过四个小时的触觉编码器调整后,我们持续进行视线对触觉的学习,在不进行触觉中训练的情况下,使用约100次演示,触摸每个任务,同时将视线预测质量保持在仅视线对等者的0.5 dB范围内。 压缩机保留了89.4%的预聚聚变前接触召回,同时允许2.26x快速训练,1.29x快速推导. 这些结果显示,预先训练的视频前传可以以数据和计算效率的方式扩展至分布多指接触动态.

articles.title: Anatomy-Decomposed Chest Computed Tomography (CT) Projections as Scalable Supervision for Bone Suppression in Chest Radiographs
articles.content: Bone overlap can obscure abnormalities in chest radiographs, while scarce paired training data limit supervised bone suppression. We address this challenge with a digitally reconstructed radiograph (DRR) framework that converts chest computed tomography (CT) into paired supervision for component suppression. A novel bone segmentation algorithm enables CT decomposition into bone, non-lung soft-tissue, and lung components, which are projected separately. Their weighted combination yields synthetic radiographs with pixel-registered component images that sum exactly to the full DRR. Models trained on these data suppress bone or lung components by predicting the target component and recovering the remainder by subtraction, transferring to real radiographs without real paired training data. As an extension, their outputs on real radiographs provide target domains for unpaired, component-wise DRR translation, reducing the appearance gap while retaining anatomical details. Across multiple public datasets, downstream detection experiments demonstrate the utility of bone suppression, with gains concentrated on abnormalities with substantial bone overlap. Compared with open-source DRR engines applied to the same CTs, our unmodified DRRs achieve comparable realism and preservation of label-relevant anatomy, while translated DRRs achieve the best Fréchet inception distance (FID), lung-field sharpness, and agreement with source-CT anatomy among the evaluated methods. Models and inference code: https://huggingface.co/qureaiorg/bone-suppression; Translated projections: https://huggingface.co/datasets/qureaiorg/ct2xr-projections.

articles.title_zh: 解剖学-十进制胸腔计算剖面学预测,作为胸腔射线学中骨骼抑制的可扩展监督
articles.content_zh: 骨架重叠可以遮掩胸腔放射图中的异常现象,而稀缺的配对训练数据限制了监督的骨架压制. 我们以数字重建的射电图框架来应对这一挑战,这种框架将胸部计算成的成像图(CT)转换成用于抑制组件的配对监督。 新颖的骨分化算法可以使CT分解为骨,非龙的软质组织,以及肺的元件,这些元件分别预测. 它们的加权组合产生合成射电图,其像素注册的组件图像与完整的减少灾害风险完全一致。 有关这些数据的模型通过预测目标成分和通过减法恢复其余部分,在没有真正的对等训练数据的情况下向真正的射电图转移来抑制骨骼或肺部成分. 作为一种扩展,它们在真射线图上的输出为未发酵的,基于组件的 DRR 翻译提供了目标域,在保留解剖细节的同时缩小了外观差距. 在多个公共数据集中,下游检测实验显示,抑制骨骼是有用的,收益集中于有较大骨骼重叠的异常现象。 与应用于同一CT的开源DRR引擎相比,我们未经修改的DRR实现了可比较的现实主义,并保留了与标签相关的解剖学,而翻译的DRR则实现了最佳的Fréchet初始距离(FID),肺场锐度,以及评价方法中与源-CT解剖学的一致. 模型和推论代码:https://huggingface.co/qureaiorg/bone-suppression; 翻译预测:https://huggingface.co/datasets/qureaiorg/ct2xr-projections.

articles.title: PixelDiT2: Representation-Grounded Pixel Diffusion Transformers
articles.content: Recent advances in pixel-space diffusion models have narrowed the image quality gap with latent-space diffusion, but still converge more slowly and lag behind in final image quality. We argue that a key reason is the lack of an explicit representation prior: unlike latent diffusion, which usually denoises in a compact and structured latent space, pixel diffusion needs to learn denoising-friendly representations and pixel generation simultaneously from raw RGB space. To address this problem, we propose PixelDiT2, an end-to-end pixel-space diffusion model designed to decouple representation learning from pixel generation without introducing an autoencoder or latent reconstruction bottleneck. We propose representation grounding that uses a frozen pretrained vision foundation model to provide explicit per-patch representation guidance throughout denoising, allowing the pixel diffusion transformer to focus more on pixel generation. On ImageNet-256x256, PixelDiT2 achieves an FID of 1.46 after 600 epochs; at 512x512 resolution, PixelDiT2 achieves an FID of 1.48 after 680 epochs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 像素DiT2: 代表式圆形像素扩散变换器
articles.content_zh: 最近在像素空间传播模型上的进步,随着潜在空间的传播,缩小了图像质量差距,但仍较慢地汇合,最终图像质量落后. 我们提出,一个关键的原因是之前缺乏明确的表述:不同于潜在的扩散,这种扩散通常在紧凑和结构化的潜在空间中隐蔽,像素扩散需要同时从原始的RGB空间中学习去诺能友好的表述和像素生成. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出PixelDiT2,一种端到端的像素空间传播模型,旨在从像素生成中解析表现学习,而不引入自动编码器或潜在的重建瓶颈. 我们建议采用冷冻预加固的视觉基础模型进行表达基,在整个解析过程中提供清晰的每幅表达指导,使像素扩散变压器更注重像素生成. 在ImageNet-256x256上,PixelDiT2在600个纪元后实现了1.46的FID;在512x512分辨率下,PixelDiT2在680个纪元后实现了1.48的FID.

articles.title: SLICEChat: Progressive In-Encoder Token Pruning for Whole-Slide Pathology Language Models
articles.content: Whole-slide pathology images (WSIs) contain gigapixel-scale visual content, creating a major scalability challenge for slide-level multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing approaches process thousands of patch tokens and typically apply compression only after slide encoding, leaving multimodal attention computationally expensive. We introduce SLICEChat, a slide-level MLLM that integrates progressive token pruning within a hybrid Mamba--Transformer slide encoder. Mamba layers enable efficient long-range propagation, while Transformer layers preserve global interactions as the sequence is progressively shortened. Between stages, language-supervised, region-aware pruning removes spatially coherent low-utility regions under a controlled keep-rate schedule, producing compact slide representations before multimodal fusion. On SlideBench VQA, SLICEChat achieves 79.84% accuracy on TCGA and 59.09% on BCNB cohorts, outperforming prior slide-level pathology MLLMs, and achieves the highest overall WSI-Bench metrics. It also provides competitive memory usage and the inference latency among the evaluated models. These results demonstrate accurate and computationally efficient multimodal reasoning over gigapixel WSIs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SLECCHAT:全滑病理学语言模型的进化编码器
articles.content_zh: 全滑病理图像(WSI)包含千兆像素尺度的视觉内容,为滑动级的多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)创造了重大的可伸缩性挑战. 现有方法处理上千个补丁符号,一般只在幻灯片编码后进行压缩,使多式联运注意力计算成本昂贵. 我们介绍SLICEChat, 一种滑动级的MLLM, 它将渐进式的符号调试 在一个混合的Mamba-Transformer幻灯片编码器中。 Mamba层能够有效进行远距离传播,而变形器层随着序列的逐渐缩短而保持全球相互作用。 在各阶段之间,语言监督、区域意识的穿透消除了在控制保持率时间表下空间一致的低效用区域,在多式联运聚变之前产生紧凑的幻灯片表示。 在SlidBench VQA上,SLICEChat在TCGA上达到79.84%的精度,在BCNB组中达到59.09%,比之前的滑行级病理MLLMs表现优异,并实现了WSI-Bench总的测量标准最高. 它还提供有竞争力的内存使用和被评价模型的推断。 这些结果表明,在千兆像素和西施方面,采用精确和计算高效的多式联运推理。

articles.title: Generating Chest X-Ray Counterfactuals by Specialising Foundation Image Models
articles.content: Counterfactual image generation answers questions about how a subject would have looked under retrospective, hypothetical scenarios. Recent methods have improved perceptual quality, identity preservation and faithfulness to an underlying causal model, but their adoption in healthcare is limited by scarce annotated data, distribution shift between datasets, and mismatches between pretrained generative models and those required for counterfactual inference. We propose specialisation, a data and parameter-efficient framework for adapting pretrained, non-causal generative models into causal mechanisms under distribution shift. Based on this framework, we train a radiology counterfactual image generation model, called RadCF, using latent flow matching. We validate our approach on three chest X-ray datasets spanning different dataset shifts, data volumes, and counterfactual questions, associated with challenging, highly-localised interventions. Our results show that RadCF and specialisation improve counterfactual soundness over existing methods while being data and parameter efficient, and that the resulting counterfactuals can detect and mitigate shortcut learning in a downstream medical classifier. Code is available at https://github.com/GSK-AI/RadCF/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过专业基础图像模型生成胸X射线反事实
articles.content_zh: 反事实图像生成解答了一个主体如何在回溯性,假设情景下看的问题. 最近的方法提高了知觉质量、身份保存和对基本因果模型的忠诚度,但是由于缺少附加说明的数据、数据集之间的分布转移以及预先训练的基因模型与反事实推断所需的模型之间的不匹配,这些方法在保健方面的采用受到限制。 我们建议采用专门化、数据和参数效率高的框架,将经过预先训练的非因果关系模型纳入分配转移的因果机制。 基于这个框架,我们利用潜在流匹配来训练一个放射学反事实图像生成模型,称为RadCF. 我们验证我们在三个胸X射线数据集上的做法,这些数据集涵盖不同的数据集变化、数据量和反事实问题,涉及具有挑战性的高度本地化的干预措施。 我们的结果显示,RadCF和专门化在提高数据和参数效率的同时提高了现有方法的反事实可靠性,由此产生的反事实可以在下游医疗分类器中检测和减缓捷径学习。 代码见https://github.com/GSK-AI/RadCF/。

articles.title: SPHQuant: Efficient extreme low bit weight quantization for Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Recent foundation models are moving toward native multimodal Vision-Language Models (VLMs), making VLMs a central form of next-generation foundation models. However, their large language backbones make edge deployment difficult due to high memory footprint and memory-bound autoregressive decoding. Weight-only post-training quantization is a practical solution, but pushing VLMs to extreme low bit-widths remains challenging: existing rotation-free methods suffer from outliers at 2-3 bits, while rotation-based methods improve accuracy at the cost of additional runtime overhead. We propose SPHQuant, a rotation-free spherical weight-only quantization framework for VLMs. Instead of quantizing weights directly in Cartesian coordinates, SPHQuant decomposes each 8D weight vector into coordinate signs, radius, and a positive unit direction. This representation isolates outlier magnitude into the radius while keeping directions bounded and statistically regular. Based on this insight, SPHQuant allocates extra precision to the radius to mitigate accuracy degradation induced by outliers. It further uses a compact positive-direction codebook and fine-tunes codebook entries through angular parameterization to preserve the unit-sphere constraint. We also design a hardware-friendly GEMV kernel that keeps the direction codebook small enough for shared-memory lookup and packs radial bits efficiently. Experiments show that SPHQuant matches the performance of state-of-the-art extreme low-bit quantization methods while improving decode throughput over QTIP by 30.3% on RTX A6000. Code will be released in https://github.com/Pushazf/SPHQuant.

articles.title_zh: SPHQuant: 愿景-语言模型高效的极低位数量化
articles.content_zh: 最近的基础模型正在向本土的多模式远景-语言模型(VLMs)发展,使VLMs成为下一代基础模型的核心形式. 然而,由于内存足迹高和内存约束的自递解码,他们的大型语言骨干使得边缘部署困难. 唯重的训练后量化是一个实用的解决方案,但将VLM推向极低比特宽仍然具有挑战性:现有的无旋转方法在2-3比特时出现异常值,而基于旋转的方法则以额外的运行时间间接费用来提高精度. 我们提出SPHQuant,一个无旋转的球面重量唯量化框架,用于VLM. SPHQuant不直接在笛卡尔座标中量化重量,而是将每个8D重量矢量分解成坐标标志,半径,以及正单位方向. 这种表示法将超出范围的范围隔离到半径,同时保持方向的界限和统计规律。 基于这种洞察力,SPHQuant将额外的精度分配到半径上,以减轻由外延器引起的精度降解. 它通过角参数化进一步使用紧凑的正向编码本,并对编码本条目进行微调,以保留单位-层约束. 我们还设计了一个硬件友好的GEMV内核,使方向码库足够小,可以进行共享模版的检索,并高效地包装射线位点. 实验显示,SPHQuant与最先进的极低位量化方法的性能相匹配,同时在RTX A6000上将解码吞吐量比QTIP提高30.3%. 守则将在https://github.com/Pushazf/SPHQuant中发布。

articles.title: DTKDP: A Dual Teacher Knowledge Distillation and Pruning Framework for Lightweight Oriented SAR Ship Detection
articles.content: Two-stage oriented detectors achieve high localization accuracy in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) ship detection, but their large backbones, feature pyramids, proposal modules, and heavy region of interest (RoI) heads hinder deployment. Existing lightweight SAR ship detectors typically use one-stage frameworks that lack proposal-level refinement for precise rotated localization. This paper presents a dual-teacher knowledge distillation and pruning (DTKDP) framework for lightweight oriented SAR ship detection. DTKDP introduces learnable gates into convolutional, normalization, and linear layers to prune convolutional channels and RoI-head neurons. Rotated proposal alignment (RPA) distills teacher and student predictions in a shared teacher-generated rotated proposal space, while a dual-teacher scheme combines classification and regression guidance from a homogeneous main teacher with complementary classification cues from a heterogeneous auxiliary teacher. Experiments on the SAR Ship Detection Dataset (SSDD) and Rotated Ship Detection Dataset in SAR Images (RSDD-SAR) show that DTKDP reduces the parameters of Oriented Region-based Convolutional Neural Network (Oriented R-CNN) and RoI Transformer equipped with ResNet-50 backbones by 87.5-91.8% and their floating-point operations (FLOPs) by 75.6-79.9%. In terms of average precision (AP) and mean average precision (mAP), the resulting Oriented R-CNN-slim and RoI Transformer-slim retain accuracy close to their full-scale counterparts. Relative changes across $\mathrm{AP}_{50}$, $\mathrm{AP}_{75}$, $\mathrm{mAP}_{50:75}$, and $\mathrm{mAP}_{50:95}$ range from a 2.38% decrease to a 0.65% improvement. Compared with RTMDet-tiny, they improve all four metrics on both datasets by 0.52-27.55% and consistently surpass representative distillation methods, demonstrating a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

articles.title_zh: DTKDP:轻量级东方搜索和救援系统双重教师知识消散和运行框架 船舶探测
articles.content_zh: 两级面向的探测器在合成孔径雷达(SAR)飞船探测中实现了较高的本地化精度,但其大型骨干,特征金字塔,建议模块,以及重利益区(ROI)头部阻碍部署. 现有的轻量级合成孔径雷达船探测器通常使用一个阶段的框架,这种框架缺乏精确旋转本地化的建议级改进。 本文件介绍了面向轻量级搜索和救援船探测的双重教师知识蒸馏和钻探框架。 DTKDP将可学习的门引入进化,正常化,线性地层到棱光的进化通道和RoI头神经元. 旋转的建议书调整(RPA)在教师共同生成的轮换建议书空间中提炼教师和学生的预测,而双教师计划则将同一主要教师的分类和回归指导与异类辅助教师的补充分类提示结合起来。 对SAR船舶检测数据集(SSDD)和SAR图像(RSDD-SAR)中旋转船舶检测数据集的实验显示,DTKDP将定位区域转录神经网络(Oriented R-CNN)和装有ResNet-50主干线的RoI变压器的参数减少87.5-91.8%,其浮动点操作(FLOPs)减少75.6-79.9%. 在平均精度(AP)和平均精度(mAP)方面,由此产生的Oriented R-CNN-slim和RoI Transformer-slim保留了接近其全尺寸对应的精度. $\mathrm{AP}_{50}美元、$\mathrm{AP}_{75}美元、$\mathrm{mAP}_{50:75}美元和$\mathrm{mAP}_{50:95}美元之间的相对变化幅度从2.38%下降到0.65%的改进。 与RTM Det-tiny相比,它们将两个数据集上的所有四个度量衡都提高了0.52-27.55%,并不断超越具有代表性的蒸馏方法,显示了一种有利的精度效率权衡。

articles.title: Revisiting Multi-View Stereo: A Sequence-to-Sequence Formulation
articles.content: Computing accurate geometry from multi-view images is a fundamental problem in computer vision. Recent feed-forward (FF) models jointly estimate 3D geometry and camera parameters, but they typically suffer from geometry distortion caused by reconstruction ambiguity, even when ground-truth camera parameters are supplied. In this paper, we study the multi-view stereo (MVS) problem with known camera parameters and propose a novel approach that bridges conventional MVS and FF methods. Rather than casting MVS as a sequence-to-one mapping that predicts depth only for a single reference view, we reformulate it as a sequence-to-sequence task, akin to FF models, that jointly predicts geometry for all input views. We introduce a global transformer-based architecture with two components that explicitly exploit camera-induced priors: ray-map embeddings that inject camera parameters into image patch tokens, making the transformer camera-aware, and a unified global cost volume that replaces conventional per-view cost volumes to jointly capture 3D structure across all views. Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks show our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing both MVS and FF reconstruction baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 重审多维立体声:按顺序排列
articles.content_zh: 从多视图图像中计算精确几何是计算机视觉中的一个基本问题. 最近的feed-forward(FF)模型联合估计了3D几何和相机参数,但它们通常受到重建模糊性导致的几何扭曲,即使提供了地面真实相机参数. 在本文中,我们用已知的相机参数研究多视图立体声(MVS)问题,并提出一种新颖的方法,将传统的MVS和FF方法连接起来. 与其将MVS铸成仅为单一参考视图预测深度的一对一映射,我们改编成一个序列到序列的任务,类似于FF模型,共同预测所有输入视图的几何. 我们采用了一个基于全球变压器的架构,有两个部分明确利用相机引起的前兆:将相机参数注入图像补丁符号的射线图嵌入,使变压器的相机-感知器,以及一个统一的全球成本量,取代常规的每景成本量,共同捕捉所有视图的3D结构. 对多种公共基准的广泛试验表明,我们的方法取得了最新业绩,超过了MVS和FF重建基线。

articles.title: When Wider Views Fail: Stress-Testing Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
articles.content: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models enable efficient geometry estimation from sparse images, but their pretrained nature can make them vulnerable to distribution shifts beyond their training data. Identifying these failure modes is important for understanding when such models can be reliably deployed in unconstrained imaging settings. We investigate viewpoint variation as a controlled distribution shift by varying the angular span of sparse image inputs while keeping the input budget fixed. Across multiple feed-forward reconstruction models, we observe substantial degradation as viewpoint span increases, with wide spans producing both incomplete surface coverage and geometry unsupported by the observed imagery. These results reveal that viewpoint variation can induce failure modes beyond conventional reconstruction incompleteness, highlighting the need to evaluate pretrained feed-forward models under distribution shifts that challenge their learned geometric priors.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当大视图失败时: 压力测试Feed- Forward 3D 重建
articles.content_zh: Feed-forward 3D重建模型能够从稀少的图像中有效进行几何估计,但是其事先训练的特性会使其易受到超出训练数据范围的分布转变的影响. 当这些模型能够可靠地部署在不受限制的成像环境中时,确定这些故障模式对于了解这些模式十分重要。 我们调查了差异作为控制分布转变的观点,即通过在固定投入预算的同时,改变稀少图像投入的角距。 在整个多条向前进的重建模型中,我们观察到,随着视野的扩大,大量退化,其广度既产生不完整的表面覆盖,也产生没有观测到的图像支持的几何特征。 这些结果表明,观点的变异可能诱发超出常规重建不完全的故障模式,这突出表明,在分配变化中,需要评估事先经过训练的饲料推进模式,因为这些模式对所学几何前科提出了挑战。

articles.title: ZVeC: A Zero-Shot Framework for Instance-Level Vehicle Extraction and Generative Point Cloud Completion
articles.content: LiDAR point clouds acquired in underground environments exhibit severe geometric incompleteness due to occlusions and limited sensor viewpoints, making reliable point cloud completion challenging without large supervised datasets. We propose ZVeC, a zero-shot, instance-driven framework that reformulates scene-level completion as compositional object-level reconstruction. By decomposing a scene into semantic object instances, ZVeC reduces reconstruction ambiguity in cluttered environments while eliminating the need for scenario-specific training. Each segmented vehicle is completed independently using a depth- and 3D Gaussian-conditioned diffusion model that exploits generalized geometric priors before the reconstructed instances are recomposed into the original scene. To evaluate our approach, we construct a real-world dense LiDAR benchmark of underground parking environments. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements over representative scene-level baselines in both quantitative metrics and visual quality. The completed point cloud differs substantially from the measured input (average KL divergence ~ 2.1), yet reducing the input to only 1% of the original LiDAR measurements changes the completed reconstruction only marginally (KL divergence < 0.50). This demonstrates that ZVeC produces geometrically consistent completions even under extreme input sparsity.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ZVeC:实例级车辆提取和基因点云完成的零热框架
articles.content_zh: 在地下环境中获得的LiDAR点云由于被隐蔽和传感器视线有限而显示出严重的几何不全,使得没有大型监督数据集的可靠点云完成工作面临挑战. 我们提议ZVeC,一个零镜头,实例驱动的框架,将场景级完成重塑为组成对象级重建. ZVeC通过将一个场景分解成语义对象实例,减少杂乱环境中的重建模糊性,同时消除了对情景特定训练的需要. 每节编组车厢均独立完成,采用深度和3D高斯条件扩散模型,在重建实例重新组合到原场前利用通用几何前缀. 为了评价我们的方法,我们构建了一个真实世界密集的地下停车环境LiDAR基准. 实验结果表明,在定量衡量和视觉质量方面,比有代表性的场景基线有持续改善。 完成点云与测量的输入值(平均KL差~2.1)有很大不同,但将输入值减少到最初LiDAR测量值的1%,只略微改变了完成的重建值(KL差 < 0.50)。 这表明,ZVeC即使在极端输入抽筋的情况下也能产生几何一致的完成.

articles.title: When is a closed-form RGB->S/P ratio adequate? A hyperspectral characterization on natural scenes for mesopic display
articles.content: Mesopic and low-light display transforms require, as their driving signal, a per-pixel scotopic-to-photopic luminance ratio (S/P); the exact spectral S/P is unavailable for ordinary RGB content, so a low-cost closed form that estimates S/P from a linear-RGB triplet is used in its place. Such closed forms exist but have been characterized only on narrowband / LED sources, i.e. spectrally sparse spectra, where a relative error of ~41% has been reported for a three-channel projection. Display content, however, is natural and broadband. We ask whether the same closed form is adequate there, using per-pixel spectral S/P from hyperspectral imagery as ground truth. On a daylight radiance time-series, a six-scalar closed form (three photopic and three scotopic channel weights) reproduces spectral S/P with a median error of ~0.07 that is time-invariant once the RGB input is chromatically adapted to D65; evaluated in un-adapted sRGB the error instead carries a color-temperature tilt across illuminants (~0.19), so adaptation is the enabling step for this use case. The result generalizes to an independent fifty-scene set (pooled median 0.024; 45/50 scenes within a pre-registered 0.10 band), with the few exceedances concentrated in saturated, spectrally-peaky surfaces that approach the narrowband regime (floral close-ups in this set). The scotopic weight vector is shown to be primary-model dependent, but the value used here is corroborated by a primary-free XYZ projection, and the median error stays within the band across all principled coefficient choices. We do not claim observer-validated appearance fidelity or adequacy on narrowband sources; both are out of scope. Both outcomes follow from the same three-channel projection: it is overwhelmed by spectrally sparse inputs and adequate on spectrally smooth ones.

articles.title_zh: 闭式RGB->S/P比率何时足够? 在自然场景上进行超光谱描述,用于中观显示
articles.content_zh: 中光和低光的显示变换需要作为其驱动信号,每像素的scotopic-to-phopic的润滑比(S/P);对于普通的RGB内容,准确的光谱S/P是没有的,因此使用一种低成本的封闭形式,从线性-RGB三重体中估计S/P. 这种封闭形式存在,但仅以窄带/LED源为特征,即光谱稀疏的光谱,在三通道投影中报告相对误差~41%. 然而,显示内容是自然的和宽带的。 我们问到,同一封闭形式是否足够,利用超光谱图像中的每像素光谱S/P作为地面真相。 在日光照射时间序列中,一个六面板闭合形式(三个光谱和三个色谱通道权重)复制光谱S/P,中位误差为~0.07,一旦RGB输入的色谱适应D65,即具有时间变化性;在未经调整的sRGB中评价误差,则会带一个色温倾斜跨显光剂(~0.19),所以适应是这个使用案例的有利步骤. 结果概括为独立的50幕集(集合在0.024中位数;在预先注册的0.10波段内有45/50场景),少数超过部分集中在接近窄波段系统的饱和,光谱斑的表面(本集中的浮动近距离). 相位重矢量显示为主模型依赖,但这里使用的值被无主XYZ投影所证实,中位误差在所有原则系数选择中都停留在波段内. 我们并不声称在窄带源上有观察员验证的外观忠贞性或充分性;两者都超出了范围。 这两种结果都来自相同的三通道投影:光谱的输入量稀少,光谱光滑的输入量充足,使其不堪重负。

articles.title: Mobile Imaging Solutions for Medical Diagnosis: Trends and Applications
articles.content: Advances in processing power, camera technologies, and mobile image analysis have made smartphones and other mobile devices, such as laptops, increasingly suitable for medical diagnosis and healthcare applications. Researchers have developed low-cost solutions for the early detection and monitoring of various health conditions, including eye and ENT diseases, malnutrition, heart rate variability, skin and oral conditions, and injuries, using images captured by non-medical devices such as smartphones and webcams. This survey examines existing research on mobile image-based medical diagnosis, with an emphasis on its potential to enable low-cost and accessible healthcare. We comparatively analyze state-of-the-art solutions across different healthcare application categories, examining their advantages and limitations. Based on this analysis, we identify desirable characteristics of mobile image-based diagnostic tools and highlight areas where existing approaches have made progress as well as areas requiring further research. We also discuss application-specific and common challenges and outline directions for future research. Overall, this study provides a comprehensive overview of mobile image-based healthcare solutions and their potential to support low-cost disease diagnosis and monitoring, particularly for underserved populations in remote and resource-constrained settings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 医疗诊断移动成像解决方案: 趋势和应用
articles.content_zh: 加工功率,相机技术和移动图像分析的进步,使得智能手机和其他移动设备,如笔记本电脑,越来越适合医疗诊断和保健应用. 研究人员利用智能手机和网络摄像头等非医疗器械捕获的图像,为早期发现和监测各种健康状况,包括眼科和ENT疾病、营养不良、心率变化、皮肤和口腔疾病以及伤害,制定了低成本解决方案。 这项调查审查了关于基于移动图像的医学诊断的现有研究,重点是其促进低成本和可获得的医疗保健的潜力。 我们比较分析不同保健应用类别的最新解决方案,研究其优点和局限性。 基于这一分析,我们确定了移动图像诊断工具的可取特点,并突出了现有方法取得进展的领域以及需要进一步研究的领域。 我们还讨论了具体应用和共同的挑战,并概述了未来研究的方向。 总的来说,本研究全面概述了基于图像的移动保健解决方案及其支持低成本疾病诊断和监测的潜力,特别是针对偏远和资源紧张环境中得不到充分服务的人口。

articles.title: INTCORT: Training-Free Spatial Reasoning Enhancement for Vision-Language Models via Input Transformations and Confidence Routing
articles.content: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in multimodal tasks, yet they still exhibit poor ability in spatial reasoning. Existing training-dependent and training-free enhancement methods suffer from high computational costs with catastrophic forgetting and internal mechanism interference that compromises general capabilities, respectively. In this work, we first verify two key hypotheses: appropriate geometric image transformation and query-reversal transformation can recover incorrect spatial predictions, and correct predictions exhibit higher relation-token confidence than incorrect ones. Based on these findings, we propose INTCORT, a training-free spatial reasoning enhancement framework that constructs multiple inference views through input transformations and aggregates their predictions via relation-token confidence routing, without modifying the VLM's internal mechanisms. Experimental results on several commonly-used benchmarks demonstrate that INTCORT substantially improves spatial reasoning accuracy across diverse VLMs, achieving an average improvement of 10.01% over all models and benchmarks. Compared with prior works, INTCORT achieves superior performance with improvements of up to 25.01%.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: INTCORT:通过输入转换和信心循环增强视野-语言模型的无培训空间理由
articles.content_zh: 远景-语言模型(VLMs)在多式联运任务中表现出了卓越的能力,但它们在空间推理方面仍然表现不佳。 现有的依赖培训和无培训强化方法的计算成本很高,灾难性的遗忘和内部机制干扰分别损害一般能力。 在这项工作中,我们首先验证两个关键假设:适当的几何图像转换和查询-逆变可以恢复不正确的空间预测,正确的预测显示出比不正确者更高的关系-触控信心. 基于这些发现,我们提议INTCORT,一个无培训的空间推理增强框架,通过输入转换构建多种推论观点,并通过互联互通的置信路由汇总其预测,而不修改VLM的内部机制. 一些常用基准的实验结果表明,INTCORT大大改进了不同VLM的空间推理精度,比所有模型和基准平均提高了10.01%。 与之前的作品相比,INTCORT达到了优异的性能,改进率高达25.01%.

articles.title: Streaming Video Editing with Easy Adaptation
articles.content: In this paper, we propose SVEET, a framework that requires merely training on a pretrained bidirectional video diffusion model but supports high-quality streaming video editing in an auto-regressive fashion. To tackle this problem, we first systematically revisit existing video-to-video diffusion approaches and identify two key principles for such streaming adaptation: backbone feature disentanglement and conditional frame independence. Building on these insights, we develop a novel paradigm for controllable video generation. At its core, an auxiliary model branch encodes source video inputs with temporally independent self-attention, and the intermediate features are injected into the corresponding backbone blocks for streaming-compatible control. Moreover, to bridge the discrepancy between the feature spaces of bidirectional and streaming models, we propose a decoupled training scheme that explicitly enforces the orthogonality between the optimization directions of video controllability and model causality. Such disentanglement ensures compatibility between the two objectives at inference and facilitates smooth zero-shot knowledge transfer across heterogeneous backbone architectures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SVEET achieves superior editing quality while maintaining real-time performance, attaining 15 FPS on a single H100 GPU 17 without any auxiliary acceleration techniques. Codes are available at https://github.com/YujiaHu1109/SVEET.

articles.title_zh: 以轻松的适应方式流媒体编辑
articles.content_zh: 在本文中,我们提出SVEET,这个框架只需要对预先训练的双向视频传播模型进行培训,但支持以自动递归的方式进行高质量的流媒体编辑. 为了解决这一问题,我们首先系统地重新审视现有的视频到视频传播方法,并确定这种流化适应的两个关键原则:骨干特征分散和有条件的框架独立性。 在这些洞察力的基础上,我们为可控视频生成开发了一种新的范式. 其核心是辅助模型分支编码有时空独立自控的源视频输入,中间功能被注入相应的主干块进行流式兼容控制. 此外,为了弥合双向模式和流体模式的特征空间之间的差异,我们提议了一个脱钩的培训计划,明确执行视频可控性优化方向与模型因果关系之间的正统性。 这种脱节可确保两个目标在推论上的兼容性,并有助于在各种骨干结构之间平稳零射的知识转让。 广泛的实验表明,SVEET在保持实时性能的同时实现了更高的编辑质量,在单一的H100 GPU 17上达到了15个FPS,没有任何辅助加速技术. 编码见https://github.com/YujiaHu1109/SVEET。

articles.title: Toward a foundation model for forest point clouds
articles.content: Forest inventories increasingly rely on artificial intelligence (AI) models to derive forest attributes from large-scale 3D point clouds. Current models are typically specialized to a single task, sensor, and forest type, making adaptation expensive in terms of annotations, computation, and expertise. We ask whether a single pretrained model can instead learn transferable representations across diverse forest inventory settings. Inspired by recent developments in language modelling and computer vision, we take a step toward a foundation model (FM) for 3D forestry. Using LitePT as backbone, we first establish a strong supervised baseline that sets a new state of the art on forest semantic and instance segmentation, tree species classification, and age regression benchmarks. We then curate a large-scale unlabelled corpus spanning airborne, UAV, and mobile laser scanning across diverse forest ecosystems, and pretrain the same backbone using self-supervised learning. We systematically evaluate representation learning strategies by comparing training from scratch, supervised pretraining, and self-supervised pretraining across four representative forestry tasks, under varying annotation budgets. Compared with training from scratch, self-supervised pretraining accelerates model convergence and consistently improves performance when annotations are scarce. Compared with task-specific supervised pretraining, self-supervised pretraining yields more transferable representations across downstream forestry tasks. These findings identify the practical regime in which pretrained representations are most valuable and suggest that instance discrimination, rather than forest semantics, is the main remaining obstacle to a general-purpose 3D forest foundation model. Code and models are available at: https://github.com/prs-eth/ForPT.

articles.title_zh: 迈向森林点云的基础模型
articles.content_zh: 森林编目越来越依赖人工智能(AI)模型从大规模3D点云中获取森林属性. 目前的模式通常专门用于单一的任务、传感器和森林类型,使适应在说明、计算和专门知识方面代价高昂。 我们问,一个经过预先培训的单一模式是否可以在不同的森林库存环境中学习可转让的表述。 受语言建模和计算机视野的最新发展启发,我们朝着3D林业的基础模型(FM)迈出了一步。 使用字节 PT作为骨干,我们首先建立了一个强有力的有监督的基线,为森林语义学和实例分类、树种分类和年龄回归基准设定了一个新的最新技术。 然后我们管理一个大规模无标签的生物群, 覆盖空中、无人驾驶飞行器和移动激光扫描 跨越不同的森林生态系统, 利用自我监督的学习来培养同样的骨干。 我们系统地评估代表制学习战略,从零开始比较培训,在不同的注释预算下,对四个有代表性的林业任务进行有监督的预训和自我监督的预训。 与从零开始的训练相比,自我监督的预训加快了模型的趋同,并在说明缺乏时不断提高性能. 与具体任务监督的预训相比,自我监督的预训产生更多跨下游林业任务的可转移表述. 这些结论查明了预先培训过的表述最有价值的实际制度,并表明歧视而不是森林语义歧视是阻碍三维森林基础通用模式的主要障碍。 守则和模型见:https://github.com/prs-eth/FORPT。

articles.title: Virtual neural networks: hundreds of souls in a body
articles.content: A new concept, termed virtual neural networks, is introduced, where the count of trainable parameters is kept constant, and scalability is attained purely through computational resources. This concept is an abstract framework that can be realized using any standard convolutional neural network. It merges siamese neural networks with a deep ensemble technique by generating numerous virtual models that share weights derived from a small set of physical models. The ensemble comprises up to hundreds of trained models simultaneously. All virtual networks take the same input, and their interconnected structure induces an internal distortion that boosts the entire ensemble robustness. The accuracy of the ensemble improves as the number of virtual networks increases, without changing the capacity. Virtual neural networks outperform larger capacity models, typical deep ensembles, and contemporary approaches like SWA and Masksembles. Additionally, the highest-performing individual model from the ensemble surpasses other models trained individually, even those with a greater number of parameters. Code: gitlab.com/EnginCZ/virtual-models-public

articles.title_zh: 虚拟神经网络:一个体内数百个灵魂
articles.content_zh: 引入了一个称为虚拟神经网络的新概念,即可训练参数的计数保持不变,而可扩展性完全通过计算资源实现。 这个概念是一个抽象的框架,可以使用任何标准进化神经网络来实现. 它将暹罗神经网络与深层综艺技术融合在一起,产生出众多的虚拟模型,这些模型共享从一小组物理模型中衍生出来的权重. 综艺节目由多达数百个训练有素的模特同时组成. 所有虚拟网络都采用相同的输入,其互联结构诱发内部扭曲,提升整个综艺的稳健性. 综艺的精度随着虚拟网络数量的增加而提高,而不改变容量. 虚拟神经网络超越了更大的容量模型,典型的深层综艺,以及SWA和Masksemble等当代方法. 此外,综艺节目中表现最出色的个人模型超过了其他单独培训的模型,即使是那些参数较多的模型。 代码:gitlab.com/EnginCZ/虚拟模型-公用

articles.title: Brain Metastases Segmentation for BraTS 2026 Task 1: A Multi-Architecture Comparison
articles.content: Brain metastases are the most common intracranial malignancy, occurring in roughly 30% of patients with primary solid tumors and carrying a median survival near 5.9 months. Automated segmentation is critical for treatment planning and volumetric monitoring, but metastases are frequently small, numerous, and heterogeneous in size within a single patient. We compare a plain nnU-Net baseline, a Residual Encoder Large (ResEncL) variant, region-based training, and a Primus transformer model for BraTS-METS 2026 Task 1, using patient-grouped cross-validation to prevent leakage from the longitudinal UCSD subset. Primus (label-based) is our strongest individual model by aggregate DSC/NSD, achieving 0.710/0.761 (ET), 0.742/0.785 (TC), 0.683/0.689 (WT), and 0.531/0.436 (RC). ResEncL trails Primus on aggregate DSC/NSD but achieves substantially higher lesion-wise F1 (e.g. ET: 0.452 vs. 0.052); a probability-averaging ensemble of the two only partially preserves ResEncL's F1 advantage (ET lesion-wise F1: 0.064). We further report three postprocessing and label-reconstruction pitfalls we believe generalize beyond this challenge. Code is available at https://github.com/mahdiislam79/BraTS_METS_2026.

articles.title_zh: BRATS 2026 的脑元构象分裂 任务 1: 多结构 比较
articles.content_zh: 脑元瘤是最常见的颅内恶性肿瘤,约30%的原发性固体肿瘤患者出现,其存活率中位数接近5.9个月. 自动化分解对于治疗规划和体积监测至关重要,但是,单个病人体内的元化体往往很小,数量众多,体型各异。 我们比较了一个平坦的nU-Net基线,一个残余编码器大型变体(ResEncL),基于区域的培训,以及一个用于BrATS-METS 2026任务1的Primus变压器模型,利用病人分组交叉验证来防止纵向UCSD子集的泄漏. Primus (label-based) 是按总的DSC/NSD分类的我们最强的单个模型,达到0.710/0.761(ET),0.742/0.785(TC),0.683/0.689(WT)和0.531/0.436(RC). ResEncL在聚合DSC/NSD上追蹤Primus,但能实现显著较高的损伤-顺理而行的F1(例如ET:0.452对0.052);两种概率-维源共和制只部分保留了ResEncL的F1优势(ET-顺理而行的F1:0.064). 我们进一步报告三个后处理和标签重建的陷阱,我们认为这些陷阱超出了这一挑战。 代码见https://github.com/mahdiislam79/BrATS_METS_2026.

articles.title: PrismGPT: Proxy-Guided Learning for Region-Aware Photo Editing with Self-Synthesized Reasoning
articles.content: Professional photo finishing relies on both global adjustments and region-specific local edits guided by semantic masks, yet current automated methods handle this workflow only partially. We present PrismGPT, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) framework that produces structured, region-aware editing plans from a single input image without relying on commercial black-box tools. Training a VLM to simultaneously diagnose aesthetic deficiencies at both global and local levels while predicting precise editing parameters is challenging due to the vast combinatorial decision space. We address this through proxy-guided learning: two simpler proxy tasks -- operation decomposition and region-aware aesthetic ranking -- teach the foundational skills the model needs, while a competence-based dynamic scheduler automatically rebalances the multi-task training ratio, progressively shifting emphasis from the proxy tasks to the primary editing task as each skill is mastered. Crucially, all reasoning traces used for supervised fine-tuning are self-synthesized by the same base model, eliminating the need for a stronger external teacher. Experiments on MIT-Adobe FiveK and SPIRE, a new professionally retouched benchmark we introduce, show that PrismGPT achieves state-of-the-art results while using only ~6% of the training data compared to the previous best method.

articles.title_zh: PrismGPT: 代理- Guided Learning for region-Aware 图片编辑自合成原因
articles.content_zh: 专业摄影的完成既依赖于全局调整,也依赖于以语义口罩为引导的针对特定区域的本地编辑,然而目前的自动化方法仅部分处理这一工作流程. 我们提出PrismGPT,一个VLM(VLM)的Vision-Language Model(VLM)框架,它从一个单一的输入图像产生结构化的,具有区域意识的编辑计划,而不依赖商业黑盒工具. 由于组合决策空间广阔,在预测准确编辑参数的同时,培训一个虚拟LM,以同时诊断全球和地方一级的审美缺陷。 我们通过代理指导学习来解决这个问题:两个更简单的代理任务 -- -- 操作分解和区域感知美学排名 -- -- 传授模型所需的基础技能,而基于能力的动态调度器则会自动重新平衡多任务训练比率,随着每种技能的掌握,将重点从代理任务逐渐转移到初级编辑任务. 关键是,用于监督微调的所有推理痕迹都是由同一基模型自行合成的,从而不需要更强大的外部教师. 在麻省理工学院-Adobe FiveK和SPIRE的实验中,我们提出的一个新的专业调整基准显示,PrismGPT在使用培训数据的~6%的同时,也取得了最新的结果。

articles.title: Ananke: Contractive Torus Attractor Networks
articles.content: We introduce Ananke, a representation-learning framework that scaffolds latent representations onto a structured product-torus prior, and its flagship visual backbone realization, Contractive Torus Attractor Networks (CTAN). By factorizing high-dimensional latent spaces into an orthogonal direct sum of two-dimensional phase planes ($\bigoplus_{k=1}^K \R^2$), Ananke coordinates feature updates via a decoupled dual-phase continuous flow: skew-symmetric Hamiltonian transport moves features tangentially along energy level sets to preserve semantic phase invariants, while signed gradient dissipation contracts transverse perturbations normally toward target invariant manifolds. For circular potential families with frozen parameters, logarithmic radial feedback yields the Exact Log-Symplectic Flow (ELSF), an analytical closed-form mapping with exact exponential decay of log-radius error that evaluates in a single forward pass without numerical integration. We establish local input-to-state bounds for level-set deviations and log-radius errors, and characterize the normal hyperbolicity and persistence of the ideal product torus under bounded perturbations. We further formulate the architecture through Lie--Trotter operator splitting, unifying spatial depthwise diffusion with local manifold contraction, and analyze both exact trigonometric flows and hardware-friendly symplectic dual-shear variants. Across natural image benchmarks (CIFAR-100) and clinically challenging endoscopy datasets (Kvasir-v2), CTAN demonstrates exceptional parameter efficiency: an ultra-compact hierarchical model with merely 0.27M parameters achieves 90.52\% accuracy on Kvasir-v2, outperforming 25M+ baselines (ResNet-50, DenseNet-161) by nearly two orders of magnitude in capacity, while scaled variants attain 80.32\% top-1 accuracy on CIFAR-100.

articles.title_zh: Ananke: 收缩的Torus吸引器网络
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍了Ananke,这是一个表现学习框架,它把潜在的表现放在结构化的产品托拉斯之前,以及它的旗舰视觉主干实现,即Contractive Torus吸引器网络(CTAN)。 通过将高维潜在空间纳入二维相平面的正交直角总和(\biguplus_{k=1}^K\R^2$), Ananke 坐标特征通过双相连续流更新: skew- 对称 汉密尔顿运输的特征是沿能量位位移动,以保持语义相位变量,同时签署梯度散射合同,通常向着目标相位变量移动。 对于有冷冻参数的循环型潜在家庭,对数射线反馈产生Exact Log-Sympletic Flow(ELSF),这是一种分析式封闭式映射,其精确指数衰减的对数射线误差在没有数字整合的情况下在一次前传中评价. 我们为水平设置偏差和对数辐射误差建立本地输入-状态界限,并描述理想产品托鲁斯在受限扰动下的正常双曲线性和持久性. 我们通过Lie-Trotter操作员的分割来进一步制定这个架构,将空间深度扩散与局部的多重收缩统一起来,并分析精确的三角流和硬件友好的双震变体. 在整个自然图像基准(CIFAR-100)和临床具有挑战性的内镜数据集(Kvasir-v2)中,CTAN显示出异常的参数效率:一个只有0.27M参数的超共性分级模型在Kvasir-v2上达到了90.52%的精度,比25M+基线(ResNet-50,DenseNet-161)的精度高出近两个量级,而规模化的变体在CIFAR-100上达到了80.32%的最高精度-1。

articles.title: MiTHras: Task-specific Hierarchical Semi-supervised Contrastive Masked Autoencoder for Mitotic Figure Analysis
articles.content: Mitotic figure (MF) analysis supports tumor grading and prognostic assessment, but automated models remain sensitive to differences in tissue type and image acquisition. We present MiTHras, a task-specific pretraining framework that combines pseudo-label-guided image- and token-level contrastive learning with masked reconstruction. We construct TCGA-MF-Pseudo, a corpus of 1.8 million cell-centered images from 14 TCGA cohorts spanning 11 organ sites. Comprehensive evaluation on MF classification, detection, count-based survival prediction, and subtype classification demonstrates the efficacy of MiTHras. It achieves the highest mean F1 on all three MF classification benchmarks and both subtype benchmarks. MiTHras also outperforms general-purpose and pathology foundation encoders by a larger margin under frozen-encoder linear probing than under full fine-tuning. Although detection gains are modest due to a shared candidate-detection stage, ablations confirm that token-level supervision improves typical-versus-atypical classification and linear probing. These findings establish that MiTHras yields robust, transferable representations for automated mitotic activity assessment.

articles.title_zh: MITHras: 任务特定等级半监督 用于Matotic 图象分析的相容面罩自动编码器
articles.content_zh: Mitotic figure(MF)分析支持肿瘤的分级和预测性评估,但自动化模型仍然对组织类型和图像获取的差异敏感. 我们介绍MITHras,一个任务特定的预训框架,将伪标签制导的图像和符号级对比性学习与蒙面重建相结合. 我们建造了TCGA-MF-Pseudo, 由来自TCGA14个组群的180万个细胞中心图像组成, 覆盖了11个器官场所。 对MF分类,检测,计数生存预测和亚类分类的综合评价,证明了MITHras的功效. 它在所有三个MF分类基准和两个子类型基准上都实现了最高的平均值F1. MiTHras在冷冻-编码器线性探测下比在全微调下比一般目的和病理基础编码器的功率要大。 虽然由于共同的候选检测阶段,检测增益不大,但浮标证实,象征级监督改进了典型的与典型的分类和线性检测. 这些调查结果证实,MITHras为自动线粒体活动评估提供了强有力的、可转移的表述。

articles.title: GraphSVR: q-Space--Aware Graph-Based Slice-to-Volume Registration for Diffusion MRI
articles.content: Diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) remains highly vulnerable to subject motion, particularly in time-efficient protocols and in motion-prone populations. While slice-to-volume registration (SVR) can mitigate inter-slice and inter-stack misalignment, diffusion MRI introduces additional complexity due to diffusion-direction-dependent contrast and the requirement to align dozens of measurements within a common reference frame, effectively yielding a 4D registration problem. Existing approaches rely primarily on sequential modeling or pairwise similarity and often degrade under sparse gradient sampling or severe motion. We introduce GraphSVR, a q-space-aware graph-based framework for 4D SVR registration in DWI. GraphSVR represents slice groups as nodes in an acquisition-structured graph, with edges encoding temporal proximity, spatial slice geometry and diffusion encoding relationships. A graph neural network predicts globally consistent stack-wise rigid motion, optimized in a self-supervised, zero-shot manner using only an anatomical reference image, without requiring paired ground-truth motion. We evaluate GraphSVR using both fully synthetic diffusion simulations and realistic recombination-based simulations from real acquisitions with controllable motion severity and gradient sparsity. Performance is quantified using grid error (mm) and rotation error relative to known ground-truth transforms. Under severe motion, GraphSVR reduces grid error and rotation error by 73% compared to FSL eddy, the standard DWI motion-correction method, with the largest gains observed in sparse-direction regimes. These results demonstrate that explicitly modeling acquisition structure through graph-based reasoning improves robustness and global consistency in 4D DWI motion estimation. Code is available at https://github.com/nogakertes/GraphSVR.git.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GraphSVR:q-Space-Aware Graph基切片对伏的传播磁共振登记
articles.content_zh: 扩散加权成像(DWI)仍然极易受到主体运动的影响,特别是在时间效率协议和运动易感人群中. 虽然切对量登记(SVR)可以减轻剪切间和链片间错配,但扩散磁共振则由于扩散-方向依赖的对比以及要求在共同的参考框架内对数十个测量结果进行对齐,从而实际上产生了4D登记问题而增加了复杂性。 现有方法主要依靠相继的模型或对偶相似性,往往在稀疏的梯度取样或严重运动下降解。 我们引入了GraphSVR,一个基于q-空间的图形框架,用于DWI的4D SVR注册. GraphSVR在获取结构图中作为节点代表切片组,边缘编码时间距离,空间切片几何和扩散编码关系. 一个图神经网络预测全球一致的堆叠式刚性运动,以自我监督,零镜头的方式优化,只使用解剖参考图像,而不需要对地-真实运动. 我们利用完全合成的传播模拟和以现实的重组为基础的模拟来评价GraphSVR,这些模拟来自具有可控运动严重性和梯度性的实际获得。 相对于已知的地面真实变换,使用网格误差(mm)和旋转误差量化性能. 在剧烈运动下,GraphSVR将网格误差和旋转误差比FSL eddy减少73%,这是标准的DWI运动校正方法,在稀疏方向制中观察到的最大增益. 这些结果表明,通过基于图表的推理对获取结构进行明确的建模可以提高4D DWI运动估计的稳健性和全球一致性. 代码见https://github.com/nogakertes/GraphSVR.git.

articles.title: ReSTI: A Source-Grounded Audit and Repair of STI-Bench
articles.content: Spatial--temporal benchmarks are valid only when their questions, source annotations, and answer options identify the same physical quantity. We audit STI-Bench against the official ScanNet, Waymo, and Omni6DPose sources and find systematic coordinate-system and timestamp errors, under-specified targets and times, and disagreements between keyed options and answer details. We introduce ReSTI, a source-backed revision that reconstructs every recoverable answer under an explicit target, time, coordinate system, physical quantity, and unit. Source reconstruction reveals task-level geometric failures: ScanNet Grounding omits the required alignment between annotation and raw camera coordinate systems, while Orientation measures camera rotation on the wrong plane. ReSTI replaces these labels with explicit, source-consistent geometric definitions and corrects other source-verifiable defects, including Waymo poses evaluated at the wrong timestamp. Across 2,064 legacy questions, ReSTI retains 1,782 questions and records 282 evidence-backed exclusions. ReSTI therefore provides a conservative and source-traceable basis for evaluating precise video spatial--temporal reasoning. Project page: https://github.com/pengzhansun/ReSTI.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ReSTI:对STI-Bench进行源头审查和维修
articles.content_zh: 空间时空基准只有在其问题、源说明和答案选项确定相同物理数量时才有效。 我们对照官方ScanNet、Waymo和Omni6DPose的源头对STI-Bench进行审计,发现系统协调系统和时间戳错误、未规定的目标和时间以及按键选项和答案细节之间的分歧。 我们引入了ReSTI, 一个来源支持的修订, 重建每一个可收回的答案 在明确的目标,时间,协调系统,物理数量,和单位。 源重建显示任务级别的几何失败 : ScanNet Grounding省略了注释和原始相机坐标系统之间的必要对齐,而方向测量相机在错误平面上的旋转. ReSTI将这些标签替换为明确,源一致的几何定义,并纠正其他源可核实的缺陷,包括Waymo在错误的时间戳上被评价的面孔. 在2,064个遗留问题中,RESTI保留了1,782个问题,并记录了282个证据支持的排除。 因此,RISTI为评价准确的视频时空推理提供了保守和源可追踪的基础. 项目网页:https://github.com/pengzhansun/ReSTI.

articles.title: What Makes a Good Medical Image Tokenizer? Rethinking Reconstruction and Generation in Medical Image Tokenization
articles.content: Latent diffusion models now dominate medical image generation, and every such pipeline rests on a \emph{tokenizer} that compresses images into the latent codes for image generation to operate on. Thereby, the tokenizer choice bounds every downstream task from reconstruction fidelity and generation quality to the representations available for downstream analysis. Yet, medical imaging pipelines routinely utilize tokenizers from natural imaging on the hypothesis that their behavior carries over. However, this is an assumption never tested in the medical imaging regime, where datasets are orders of magnitude smaller and images exhibit far lower inter-sample variance. We present a systematic evaluation of medical image tokenizers evaluating thirty configurations across ten model families on twelve datasets at three compression factors, spanning reconstruction, generation, latent geometry, downstream classification, and memorization. We find that (1) performance on image reconstruction and generation strongly correlate, unlike prior reports on natural images; (2) modern tokenizers use nearly all of their codebook entries, but still leave most of the latent space unused; (3) training-set memorization is mild and is further suppressed by stronger latent space compression; and (4) discrete quantization can largely preserve downstream classification, with lookup-free schemes being the main exception.

articles.title_zh: 是什么让一个良好的医疗图像切除器? 重新思考医疗图像的重建和生成
articles.content_zh: 线性扩散模型现在主导着医疗图像生成,每一个这样的管道都依赖于一个\emph{tokenizer},将图像压缩成潜在的代码,以便图像生成可以运行。 因此,象征性的选择将每一个下游任务从重建的忠诚和生成质量,到可供下游分析的表述。 然而,医疗成像管道通常使用自然成像中的标致剂,其假设是其行为延续。 然而,这是医学成像系统中从未测试过的一种假设,即数据集数量级较小,图像的样本间差异要小得多。 我们对医疗图像标注器进行了系统评估,对10个模型家庭的30个配置进行了评估,这些组合基于三个压缩系数,包括重建、生成、潜在几何、下游分类和记忆。 我们认为,(1) 图像重建和生成的性能密切相关,与以往关于自然图像的报告不同;(2) 现代标致器几乎使用其所有代码簿条目,但仍留下大部分潜在空间未使用;(3) 培训设定的记忆轻而易举,受到更强潜在空间压缩的进一步抑制;(4) 离散的量化可以在很大程度上保持下游分类,无望方案是主要例外。

articles.title: Think Like a World Model, Act Like a VLA: Distilling World-Model Representations into Compact Robot Policies
articles.content: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map observations to actions with no objective that accounts for how the world responds, so their robustness is bounded primarily by data coverage. World models carry precisely that missing objective and are better grounded for it, yet rolling the future forward costs seconds per decision and rules them out of the control loop. We show the two can be separated. What a world model knows about physical scenes lives in its \emph{internal features}; generating the future is merely the objective that produced them, so the grounding can be inherited while the generative machinery is left behind. We add one feature-alignment term to ordinary VLA training: a frozen world model is run over the training frames once and cached, and the student learns to agree with that cache. No teacher is loaded during training, the projector is discarded after it, and the deployed policy is identical to the undistilled baseline, running in $32$~ms and $1.86$~GB on a consumer RTX~5090, so every gain is attributable to the representation rather than to added capacity or test-time compute. A $0.8$B student reaches $97.9\%$ on LIBERO, improves from $48.2\%$ to $50.5\%$ on RoboCasa-GR1 humanoid manipulation, and the same objective carries over to real hardware, on both a single-arm and a bimanual platform. The gain survives changes of student scale, backbone, alignment layer, and teacher, indicating a broad representational prior rather than a fragile alignment between two particular networks. Project page: https://thaw-vla.trung-dt.com/.

articles.title_zh: 像世界模型一样思考,像VLA一样的行为:将世界模型化为契约机器人政策
articles.content_zh: 愿景-语言-行动(VLA)模型绘制了对没有说明世界如何应对的目标的行动的观测图,因此其强性主要以数据覆盖为界. 世界模型恰恰载有这个缺失的目标,并对此有更好的基础,然而将未来的前进成本秒逐一滚动,并排除它们进入控制圈。 我们显示两者可以分开。 一个世界模型对物理场景的知之在于它的\emph{内部特征};产生未来只是产生它们的目标,因此在基因机械被抛在后面的时候,地面可以继承. 我们在普通的VLA训练中增加了一个特征调节术语:一个被冻结的世界模型在训练框上运行一次并缓存,学生学会同意缓存. 培训期间没有给教师加载,投影仪随后被丢弃,所部署的政策与未固定的基准相同,运行在消费者RTX~5900上的32美元~m和1.86美元~GB,因此每一次增益都归功于代表而不是增加容量或测试时间计算. 一个0.8 B美元的学生在LIBERO上达到97.9美元,在RoboCasa-GR1人机操纵上从48.2美元提高到50.5美元,同一目标在单臂和双人机平台上延续到真正的硬件. 这一收益在学生规模、骨干、配对层和教师的变化中存活下来,表明两个特定网络之间有着广泛的代表性,而不是脆弱的配对。 项目网页:https://thaw-vla.trung-dt.com/.

articles.title: Ev-YOLO: Uncertainty-Aware Object Detection via a Unified Evidential Formulation
articles.content: Reliable uncertainty estimation is essential for deploying object detectors in autonomous systems operating in uncertain environments. Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) provides a principled framework for uncertainty-aware classification by representing network outputs as evidence and interpreting predictions through subjective logic. However, existing evidential object detectors typically combine evidential classification with regression uncertainty models that do not share the same theoretical foundation. In this work, we propose an evidential version of YOLOv8 in which both classification and bounding-box regression are formulated within a common evidential framework. Our approach exploits YOLOv8's distribution-based bounding-box representation, allowing the evidential formulation to be applied not only to classification but also to localisation. As a result, both tasks produce belief, uncertainty, and probability estimates that can be interpreted within the Dempster--Shafer framework. Experiments on KITTI, MUSES, and nuScenes show that the resulting detector remains broadly competitive with standard YOLOv8 in terms of detection accuracy while providing a localisation uncertainty that effectively discriminates between correct and erroneous detections. Moreover, this uncertainty becomes increasingly discriminative under domain shift.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Ev-YOLO: 通过统一证据制剂进行不确定-识别对象检测
articles.content_zh: 可靠的不确定性估计对于在不确定环境中运行的自主系统中部署物体探测器至关重要。 Evious Deep Learning(EDL)通过将网络输出作为证据,并通过主观逻辑解释预测,为不确定性意识分类提供了一个原则框架. 然而,现有的鉴证对象探测器通常将鉴证分类与回归不确定性模型结合起来,这些模型并不具有相同的理论基础. 在这项工作中,我们提出了YOLOv8的证据版本,在其中,分类和定界框回归都是在一个共同的证据框架内制定的。 我们的方法利用了YOLOv8基于分配的边框表示,使得证据表述不仅适用于分类,也适用于本地化. 因此,这两项任务都产生信念,不确定性,以及概率估计,可以在Dempster-Shafer框架内解释. 有关KITTI,MUSES,和nuScenes的实验表明,由此产生的探测器在探测精度方面仍然与标准的YOLOv8具有广泛的竞争力,同时提供了本地化的不确定性,有效地区分了正确和错误的探测. 此外,在领域转移的情况下,这种不确定性越来越具有歧视性。

articles.title: High-resolution Nitrogen Dioxide Maps Reveal Exposure Limit Breaches across Europe
articles.content: Nitrogen dioxide (NO2) is a common air pollutant, released into the atmosphere through the incomplete burning of fossil fuels, and associated with respiratory and cardiovascular diseases in humans. Ambient NO2 concentrations are regulated through air-quality limits assessed with a sparse network of fixed monitors. The revised EU Ambient Air Quality Directive (2024/2881) introduces a daily NO2 limit to be met from 2030. At present, neither the regulatory monitoring network nor existing coarse, annual-mean models can resolve NO2 concentrations at the spatio-temporal resolutions necessary to assess compliance. Here we map NO2 across Europe at hourly and 10m resolution with a machine-learning model that combines ground monitors with satellite, reanalysis, land-use, traffic and emission data and returns a calibrated predictive distribution at every location. Validated against held-out regulatory monitors and independent citizen-science campaigns, the maps resolve high-resolution spatiotemporal NO2 gradients for 110 metropolitan areas in Europe. We reconstruct the daily compliance statistic across those regions and find limit breaches in 91 EU air quality zones deemed compliant by the regulatory monitoring network, covering a population of approximately 135M. Beyond air quality zones and monitor locations, an estimated 9-9.4% (20M) of the population in mapped regions lives in areas where the daily NO2 limit is breached. The high-resolution maps offer a route to population-scale assessment of compliance with the 2030 limits.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 高分辨率二氧化氮地图
articles.content_zh: 二氧化氮(NO2)是一种常见的空气污染物,通过不完全燃烧化石燃料而释放到大气中,与人类呼吸道和心血管疾病有关. 环境NO2浓度通过空气质量限制进行调节,评估时使用的固定显示器网络很少。 修订后的欧盟"环境空气质量指令"(2024/2881)引入了从2030年开始的每日NO2限值. 目前,无论是监管监测网络,还是现有的粗糙、年均模型,都无法在评估遵守情况所必需的时空分辨率下解决NO2浓度问题。 在这里,我们以小时分辨率和10米分辨率绘制了整个欧洲的NO2,并采用了一种机器学习模型,该模型将地面监测器与卫星相结合,重新分析、土地使用、交通和排放数据,并返回每个地点经过校准的预测分布。 这些地图通过对被搁置的监管监测器和独立的公民-科学运动的验证,解决了欧洲110个大都会地区高分辨率的瞬间NO2梯度。 我们重建了这些区域的日常合规情况统计,发现在91个欧盟空气质量区存在被监管监测网络视为合规的有限违规现象,覆盖了大约135万人。 除了空气质量区和监测地点外,在地图绘制区域,估计有9.9%至9.4%(20M)的人口生活在每日NO2限制被突破的地区。 高分辨率地图为人口规模评估遵守2030年限额的情况提供了一个途径。

articles.title: FedMust: Semi-supervised Multi-task Student-Teacher Federated Learning for Multi-organ CT Segmentation
articles.content: Multi-organ segmentation using deep learning requires large amounts of annotated patient data; however, institutions often lack sufficiently large and diverse annotated datasets. Privacy constraints further prevent institutions from sharing patient data to overcome this limitation. Moreover, due to the labor-intensive nature of annotation and the scarcity of diverse expertise, institutions typically have labels for only a small portion of their local data, leaving the larger unlabeled portion unused. In this work, we propose a flexible semi-supervised federated multi-task student-teacher framework that leverages federated learning (FL) to improve multi-organ segmentation using both labeled and unlabeled data across participating sites. At each communication round, the proposed framework initiates local training, where clients with labels for the same task form a federation to produce an aggregated teacher model. The resulting teachers generate task-specific features for all data at each client. Subsequently, all clients form a second federation to train a multi-task student model with a shared encoder and task-specific decoders that replicate the teacher-generated features across all segmentation tasks. The aggregated student model is then used to update the local teachers and initiate the next training round. Extensive experiments demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed method compared with local and federated single-organ models, yielding an average performance gain of 13 percent across clients. The experiments also demonstrated the impact of multi-task learning and unlabeled data and the applicability of the framework in relaxing labeled-data requirements for client participation. The code is available at https://github.com/AshknMrd/FedMust.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FedMust: 半监督 多任务学生-教师联合会多组织CT分部学习
articles.content_zh: 利用深入学习的多器官分解需要大量附加说明的病人数据;但是,各机构往往缺乏足够大和多样的附加说明的数据集。 隐私限制进一步阻碍了各机构分享病人数据以克服这一限制。 此外,由于注释的劳动密集型和缺乏多种专门知识,各机构通常只有一小部分当地数据有标签,因此没有标签的较大部分没有使用。 在这项工作中,我们提出灵活的半监督联合多任务学生-教师框架,利用联合学习(FL),利用各参与站点的标签和无标签数据,改进多组织分化. 在每一轮交流中,拟议框架都启动地方培训,为同一任务贴标签的客户组成一个联合会,以产生一个汇总的教师模式。 由此产生的教师为每个客户提供所有数据的具体任务特征。 随后,所有客户组成第二个联合会,培训一个多任务学生模型,并配有共享编码器和任务特定解码器,在所有分区任务中复制教师生成的特性. 然后使用学生汇总模式更新当地教师,并启动下一轮培训。 广泛的实验表明,与当地和联邦单一机构模式相比,拟议方法的有效性,使客户的平均业绩收益达到13%。 这些实验还证明了多任务学习和无标签数据的影响以及该框架在放宽客户参与的标签数据要求方面的适用性。 该代码可在https://github.com/AshknMrd/FedMust上查阅.

articles.title: Relationally Grounded Latent World Models for Autonomous Driving
articles.content: Latent world models learn predictive representations for autonomous driving, but the relational semantics these states preserve often remain implicit. We investigate whether traffic scene graphs can serve as privileged semantic supervision for latent world representations. Building on LAW, we construct actor-centric scene graphs from nuScenes 3D annotations, encode their serialized relational structure using a frozen text embedding model, and align the visual latent representations with this semantic target during training. We remove the supervision branch at inference, so it requires neither scene graphs nor 3D annotations and adds no test-time computation. On nuScenes, our method reduces average trajectory L2 error from 0.661 to 0.622 (5.9%) and collision rate from 0.456 to 0.217 (52.4%) relative to our retrained LAW baseline. It also outperforms an unstructured caption-style semantic target, supporting the benefit of explicit relational structure for latent world-model representation learning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 具有关联基础的低级自主驾驶世界模式
articles.content_zh: 后期世界模型学习自主驱动的预测性表述,但这些状态所保留的关系语义往往仍然隐含着. 我们调查交通场景图是否可作为对潜在世界表现的特权语义监督. 在LAW的基础上,我们从nuScenes 3D注释中构建以演员为中心的场景图,用冷冻文本嵌入模型编码其序列式关系结构,并在训练期间将视觉潜伏的表示与这个语义目标一致. 我们撤除监督分支的推论,所以它既不需要场景图表,也不需要3D注释,也不增加测试时间计算. 在nuScens中,我们的方法将平均轨迹L2误差从0.661降至0.622(5.9%),碰撞率从0.456降至0.217(52.4%),与我们重新调整的LAW基线相比。 它还超越了一个无结构字幕风格的语义目标,支持为潜在世界示范表现学习提供明确的关系结构的好处。

articles.title: Video-based Surgical Skill Assessment Using Dynamics-and-Uncertainty-Aware Tree-based Gaussian Process Classifier
articles.content: The proposed pipeline integrates a representation-flow convolutional neural network with a dynamics- and uncertainty-aware tree-based Gaussian Process classifier. In this framework, latent motion dynamics are exploited both as discriminative representations and as a source of input uncertainty, enhancing robustness against temporal variations and abnormal motion transitions. Compared with conventional deep learning approaches, the proposed strategy requires less training data and offers improved computational efficiency. To further improve classification performance, we introduce novel semantic-aware compound kernels that effectively capture semantic, flow, and dynamic information embedded in surgical video features. In addition, uncertainty-aware kernels are developed to strengthen the robustness and practical applicability of the compound kernel framework. The proposed method is evaluated on two benchmark datasets, namely the JIGSAWS and the Cataract-LMM (Capsulorhexis) datasets. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance across both datasets, including the LOSO and LOUO evaluation protocols on JIGSAWS, including the subject-independent LOUO protocol on JIGSAWS, on which the framework attains a mean accuracy of \ph{96.9}\%; results under the within-subject LOSO protocol are reported for comparability with prior work, achieving competitive accuracy while substantially reducing computational cost. Overall, the proposed pipeline provides an efficient and accurate framework for video-based surgical skill assessment.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 基于视频的外科技能评估 使用动态和不确定的智能树基高斯过程分类器
articles.content_zh: 拟议的管线集成了一种能动和能不确定的以树为基础的高斯过程分级器的表达-流分解神经网络. 在这个框架内,潜在运动动态被利用,既作为歧视性的表述,又作为投入不确定性的来源,从而增强抵御时间变化和异常运动过渡的稳健性。 与传统的深入学习方法相比,拟议战略要求的培训数据较少,而且提高了计算效率。 为了进一步提高分类性能,我们引入了新颖的语义-意识复合内核来有效捕捉外科视频功能所嵌入的语义,流出和动态信息. 此外,还开发了有不确定性的内核,以加强复合内核框架的稳健性和实用性. 拟议方法在两个基准数据集,即JIGSAWS和Cataract-LMM(Capsulorhexis)数据集上进行评估。 实验结果表明,在两个数据集中,包括JIGSAWS的LOSO和LOUO评价协议,包括JIGSAWS的LOUO独立标的LOUO议定书,其框架的平均准确度为\ph{96.9};报告在LOSO协议下的结果与先前的工作具有可比性,实现了竞争性的准确性,同时大大减少了计算成本。 总体而言,拟议的管道为基于视频的外科手术技能评估提供了一个有效和准确的框架。

articles.title: Beyond Uniform Subspaces: Spectrum-Aware and Depth-Adaptive Fusion for Multi-Task Model Merging
articles.content: Model merging aims to consolidate multiple task-specific models without access to extra training process. However, existing subspace-based methods largely rely on a uniform treatment of task updates, overlooking their intrinsic spectral and depth-wise heterogeneity. We identify two key deviations from this assumption: different tasks require different subspace capacity and exhibit different tolerance to spectral transformation, while subspace projection introduces depth-dependent distortion. Based on these observations, we propose SADA-Merging, a spectrum-aware and depth-adaptive framework for data-free model merging. SADA-Merging allocates task-specific subspace capacity according to spectral complexity, adapts spectral preservation according to task-wise plasticity, and applies depth-dependent anchoring to compensate for projection-induced distortion. This enables the fusion process to adapt to both the intrinsic geometry of each task and its sensitivity across network depth. SADA-Merging operates directly on task updates and is applicable to both full fine-tuning and LoRA settings. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over existing data-free merging methods across different task scales and adaptation settings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 超越制服 子空间: Spectrum-Aware和多任务模式合并的深度组合
articles.content_zh: 模式合并旨在整合多个任务特定模式,而无需额外培训程序。 然而,现有的基于空间的子方法在很大程度上依赖于对任务更新的统一处理,忽略了它们固有的光谱和深度的异质性。 我们找出了与这个假设的两种关键偏差:不同的任务需要不同的子空间能力,对光谱转换表现出不同的耐受性,而子空间投影则引入了深度依赖的扭曲. 基于这些观测,我们提议SADA-Merging,一个光谱感知和深度适应的框架,用于无数据模型的合并. SADA-Merging根据光谱复杂度分配任务特有子空间能力,根据任务可塑性调整光谱保存,并应用依赖深度的锚定来补偿投影引起的扭曲. 这使得聚变过程能够适应每项任务的内在几何及其跨网络深度的敏感性. SADA-Merging直接运行于任务更新,既适用于全面微调,也适用于LORA设置. 广泛的实验表明,与不同任务规模和适应环境的现有无数据合并方法相比,不断改进。

articles.title: Applications of Neural Cellular Automata: State of the Art, Challenges and Opportunities
articles.content: Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs) are a new type of neural network architecture which enable accurate and robust inference at extremely small model sizes. Recently, NCAs have advanced to become interesting low-resource alternatives to convolution- and attention-based architectures for various tasks such as image analysis, synthetic image generation, and simulation. The rapid development and increased research interest necessitate a comprehensive review of the emerging technology. This review provides an overview of the fundamentals of NCAs, applications to medical imaging, as well as insights into the state of the art. We analyze recent modifications to the originally proposed NCA architecture with respect to their efficiency and accuracy. Furthermore, we review practical applications in real-world scenarios with a focus on medical image analysis, segmentation, classification, registration, depth estimation, and image synthesis. Finally, we identify several advantages of NCAs, research gaps, and conclude with an analysis of future opportunities for NCAs in medical applications in confined settings or areas that have particular demands for robustness or efficient data processing.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 神经细胞的应用 Automata:艺术状况、挑战和机遇
articles.content_zh: 神经细胞自发(NCAs)是一种新型神经网络架构,能够在极小的模型大小上进行准确而有力的推论. 最近,NCAA已经进步,成为有趣的低资源替代品,取代了基于进取和关注的架构,用于图像分析,合成图像生成,模拟等各种任务. 由于研究的迅速发展和兴趣的提高,需要对新兴技术进行全面审查。 这一回顾概括了NCAA的基础,医学成像的应用,以及对最新艺术的洞察. 我们从效率和准确性方面分析最近对最初提出的国家竞争主管机构结构的修改。 此外,我们审查了现实世界情景中的实际应用,重点是医疗图像分析、分解、分类、登记、深度估计和图像合成。 最后,我们找出了国家竞争主管机构的几个优点、研究差距,最后分析了国家竞争主管机构今后在对稳健性或高效数据处理有特别要求的封闭环境或领域的医疗应用方面的机会。

articles.title: What do VLM-Based Vision-Language Navigation Models Rely on: Interpreting and Steering Policy Behavior
articles.content: Modern Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) models rely mostly on pre-trained large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to predict navigation actions. While this fusion of language instructions and visual observations allows multimodal reasoning, it obscures how information is routed across modalities or what mechanisms drive navigation decisions. Thus, it remains unclear whether VLN models ground their predictions in relevant semantic cues or can track task progress. In this work, we study the interpretability and steerability of VLN models. We use intervention-based metrics that measure how visual observations, instructions, and visual memory causally influence navigation decisions. Our results show that these navigation policies are sensitive to all input modalities and do not depend on a single one. We further show that these agents encode navigation progress and retain semantic structure from their VLM backbones, enabling concept-level steering through internal activations. Finally, we extract activation vectors for abstract behaviors to transfer them zero-shot to out-of-distribution real-world scenarios, improving performance without additional fine-tuning.

articles.title_zh: VLM-基于视野-语言导航模型是什么 参考:解释和指导政策行为
articles.content_zh: 现代Visual-Language导航(VLN)模型大多依靠预先训练的大型Visual-Language Models(VLM)来预测导航动作. 虽然这种对语言指令和视觉观察的组合允许多式联运推理,但它掩盖了信息如何在方式上传递,或是什么机制驱动导航决定。 因此,VLN模型是将其预测建立在相关的语义提示中还是能够跟踪任务进度,目前还不清楚. 在这项工作中,我们研究了VLN模型的可解释性和可引导性. 我们使用基于干预的度量衡,测量视觉观测,指令,和视觉记忆如何因果地影响导航决策. 我们的结果显示,这些导航政策对所有输入方式都敏感,并不依赖于一种输入方式。 我们进一步表明,这些物剂编码了导航进度,并从它们的VLM主干线中保留了语义结构,通过内部活化使概念层面的指导成为可能. 最后,我们提取抽象行为的活化向量,将它们零发转移到外分流现实世界的情景,在不增加微调的情况下提高性能.

articles.title: Active Visual Sampling with a Connectome-Constrained Fly Model for One-Shot Hatch Recognition in Architectural Drawings
articles.content: Architectural drawings encode material classes through repeated hatch patterns. We test whether a connectome-constrained fly visual network, pretrained for motion, can be repurposed without task-specific weight updates as a descriptor for one-shot hatch matching. Each 64 x 64 patch is translated over eight scan trajectories and summarized across 57 cell types; query descriptors are then matched to one legend strip per class. On 400 development sheets from a synthetic benchmark built on CubiCasa5K geometry, the frozen fly pipeline reaches 0.857 area-weighted accuracy and 0.910 with an extended legend. On an equal-brightness orientation condition it reaches 0.840 versus 0.299 for eleven pixel statistics, while a Gabor bank reaches 0.900. Replacing drift with a repeated still frame lowers the combined equal-condition score by 0.089 [0.066, 0.112]. However, a receptors-only descriptor reaches 0.891 and a task-trained 5,888-parameter CNN averages 0.959, so the current evidence supports transfer and the usefulness of active sampling, but not an advantage of the biological wiring. We separate project-recorded results from recomputed checks and report a small real-drawing audit. The supported claim is therefore narrow: motion-oriented biological vision can be repurposed as a useful texture representation for architectural hatch matching, while the topology contribution and end-to-end BIM utility remain open questions.

articles.title_zh: 使用 Connectome- Constract Fly 模型在建筑图画中进行活性视觉采样 单相切识别
articles.content_zh: 建筑图画通过重复的舱口图案来编码材料类. 我们测试一个连接的受约束的飞行视觉网络,预先训练用于运动,是否可以在没有任务特定重量更新的情况下被重新使用,作为一发口匹配的描述符. 每个64×64补丁在8个扫描轨迹上被翻译出并被概括到57个细胞类型;然后将查询描述符与每个类的一个传说条相匹配. 在从CubiCasa5K几何学上建立起来的合成基准上的400个开发平板上,被冷冻的飞管达到了0.857区加权精度和0.910有扩展的传说. 在等亮度定向条件下,11个像素统计达到0.840比0.299,而Gabor银行达到0.900。 用重复的还框来取代漂移,使综合等效分数降低0.089分 [0.066,0.112]. 然而,只有受体的描述器达到0.891,任务训练的5,888参数CNN平均为0.959,因此目前的证据支持转移和活性采样的有用性,但并不是生物接线的优势. 我们把项目记录结果从重新计算的检查中分离出来,并报告一次小型的实测审计。 因此,所支持的说法是狭义的:面向运动的生物视觉可以被重新用作建筑舱门匹配的有用纹理代表,而地貌的贡献和端到端的BIM的效用则仍然有待解答.

articles.title: HyperCLIP++: Fine-tuning CLIP forOpen-vocabulary Semantic Segmentation in Hyperbolic Space
articles.content: CLIP, a foundational vision-language model, has emerged as a powerful tool for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation. While freezing CLIP's text encoder is known to preserve its generalization capability, recent studies show that fine-tuning both CLIP's text and image encoders jointly significantly enhances segmentation performance, especially for classes from open sets. In this work, we explain this phenomenon from the perspective of hierarchy alignment, since during fine-tuning, the hierarchical level of image embeddings shifts from image-level to pixel-level. We achieve this by leveraging hyperbolic space, which naturally encodes hierarchical structures. Our key observation is that, during fine-tuning, the hyperbolic radius of CLIP's text embeddings decreases, facilitating better alignment with the pixel-level granularity of visual data. Building on this, we propose HyperCLIP++, a novel and parameter-efficient adaptation strategy. HyperCLIP++ directly adjusts the hyperbolic radius of CLIP's embeddings via scaling transformations to achieve a hierarchy alignment to the target task, i.e., segmentation. To ensure this hierarchy alignment is effected consistently across both modalities and preserves their cross-modal alignment during training, HyperCLIP++ integrates a Dual Cross-Relation Communication (DCRC) module that synchronizes these adjustments between the vision and text pathways. Our experiments show that HyperCLIP++ achieves state-of-the-art performance across three benchmarks while fine-tuning only approximately 5% of CLIP's total parameters. More importantly, we observe that after adjustment, CLIP's text embeddings exhibit a relatively fixed hyperbolic radius across datasets, suggesting that the hierarchical level required for this segmentation task might be quantified using the hyperbolic radius.
