articles.title_zh: HyperCLIP++: 超曲面空间开放-vocabliary语义分区的精细调 CLIP
articles.content_zh: CLIP是一种基础视觉-语言模型,已作为开放-vocabulary语义分解的有力工具而出现. 虽然冰冻CLIP的文本编码器已知能保持其通俗化能力,但最近的研究表明,对CLIP的文本和图像编码器进行微调可共同显著地提高分解性能,特别是对于从开放的集中分解出来的类. 在这部作品中,我们从分级对接的角度来解释这一现象,因为在微调时,图像嵌入的分级级别会从图像级别转向像素级别. 我们通过利用双曲空间来达到这个目的,这个空间自然地编码了等级结构. 我们的关键观察是,在微调时,CLIP文本嵌入的双曲半径会减少,有利于更好地与视觉数据的像素级颗粒相匹配. 在此基础上,我们提出了HyperCLIP++,这是一种新颖和参数效率高的适应战略. HyperCLIP++通过缩放转换来直接调整CLIP嵌入的双曲半径,以达到与目标任务,即分化的分级相配. 为了确保在两种模式之间连贯一致地实现等级一致,并在培训期间保持其跨模式一致,HyperCLIP++整合了一个双重跨关系通信模块,使这些调整在愿景和文本路径之间同步进行。 我们的实验显示,HyperCLIP++实现了跨越三个基准的最先进性能,而微调则只占CLIP总参数的5%左右. 更重要的是,我们观察到,经过调整后,CLIP的文字嵌入在数据集之间呈现出相对固定的双曲半径,这表明这种分解任务所需的分级水平可以使用双曲半径量化.

articles.title: Evaluating Transformation Models for pCLE Mosaic Registration
articles.content: Confocal Laser Endomicroscopy (CLE) provides real-time, cellular-resolution optical biopsy but has a narrow field of view, which image mosaicing can extend to provide anatomical context. Because of line-by-line acquisition, probe motion, and probe-tissue interaction, frame alignment generally requires a non-linear transformation whose accuracy is difficult to quantify: flexible transformation models can fit intensity features and noise, so appearance-based metrics such as Normalized Cross-Correlation (NCC) can improve without a genuine gain in geometric accuracy. We therefore establish a dataset of 132 frame pairs across fourteen pCLE sequences from 4 patients with manually annotated landmark correspondences, so that Target Registration Error (TRE) can serve as a geometrically grounded complement to NCC. We assess the effect of progressively increasing the transformation model's degrees of freedom, from translation to Thin Plate Spline (TPS), and of six feature-matching backends spanning classical (Shi-Tomasi, Lucas-Kanade) and learned (SuperPoint, SuperGlue, LightGlue, LoFTR, RoMa) approaches. Translation and rigid models prove insufficient under tissue deformation, while TPS with random sampling achieves the strongest landmark-derived alignment of the evaluated configurations; among the learned matchers, used without fine-tuning, only RoMa offers a robust, if modest, advantage over other methods. At the sequence level, pairwise registration quality proved an unreliable predictor of final mosaic quality, so mosaic quality must be evaluated directly rather than inferred from pairwise metrics.

articles.title_zh: 评价PCLE Mosaic 注册的转型模式
articles.content_zh: Confocal Laser Endomicroscopy(CLE)提供实时的,细胞分辨的光学活检,但视野很窄,图像相模可以延伸为提供解剖上下文. 由于逐行获取,探针运动,和探针-问题相互作用,帧对接一般需要非线性变换,其精度难以量化: 灵活的变换模型可以适应强度特征和噪音,因此基于外观的度量衡,如常态化交叉校正(NCC),在几何精度方面可以改善而无真正收益. 因此,我们建立了一套132个帧对的数据集,横跨4个患者的14个pCLE序列,这些患者手动附加了地标的通信,因此目标登记出错可以作为NCC的几何基础补充. 我们评估逐步提高转换模型的自由度的效果,从翻译到Thin Plate Spline(TPS),以及跨越古典(Shi-Tomasi、Lucas-Kanade)和学习(SuperPoint、SuperGlue、LightGlue、LoFTR、RoMa)的六个特征匹配后端。 翻译和刚性模型在组织变形下证明是不够的,而通过随机抽样的TPS在评价的配置上实现了最强的地标衍生对接;在不作微调而被使用的有学问的配对者中,只有RoMa提供了强大的,如果是适度的,比起其他方法的优势. 在序列一级,双向登记质量证明是对最终镶嵌质量的不可靠的预测,因此,必须直接评价镶嵌质量,而不是从双向衡量标准中推断出。

articles.title: Incentive Noise and Structural Prior Infusion for Multi-modal Object Re-Identification
articles.content: Multi-modal object Re-Identification (ReID) benefits from complementary information across heterogeneous imaging modalities. To further enrich semantic representation, text descriptions have recently been incorporated as an additional modality. However, recent vision-language approaches often treat text descriptions as clean, deterministic signals and overlook their inherent noise, including modality-mismatched phrases and semantically ambiguous expressions. Moreover, prevailing methods lack explicit mechanisms to reconcile fine-grained structural discrepancies between modalities, even after high-level semantic alignment. To address these challenges, we propose a novel framework centered on Positive-Incentive Noise (π-noise) and structured prompt modulation. First, the Semantic Cross-Modal Modulator harnesses task-aware π-noise, sampled from a distribution conditioned on both visual and text inputs, to perturb global tokens and enable semantics-guided cross-modal compensation. Second, the Structure-Aware Prompt Adapter injects learnable geometric priors via prompts to enhance spatial consistency. Third, the Context-Aware Sparse Fusion module distills structural context to guide adaptive fusion while shielding identity features from noisy local details. Experiments on three multi-modal ReID benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our approach. The code is available at https://github.com/zw-absin/INSPI.

articles.title_zh: 鼓励多式对象重新识别的噪声和结构先入后出
articles.content_zh: 不同成像模式的互补信息有助于多式物体重新识别。 为了进一步丰富语义表述,最近将文字描述作为另一种方式纳入。 然而,最近的视觉语言方法往往将文本描述视为干净的、决定性的信号并忽略其固有的噪音,包括模式相匹配的短语和模棱两可的表达方式。 此外,现行方法缺乏明确的机制来调和模式之间微小的结构性差异,即使在高层次语义调整后也是如此。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出了一个以积极-鼓励噪音(π-噪音)和结构化即时调制为中心的新框架。 首先,语义交叉-模块化器利用任务感知--噪声,从以视觉和文字输入为条件的分布中取出样本,以扰动全球信使并促成语义导出跨模式补偿. 第二,结构-智能快速适应器通过提示注入可学习的几何前缀来增强空间一致性. 第三,上下文-Aware Sparse Fusion模块分解出结构上下文来指导适应性聚变,同时将身份特征屏蔽在吵闹的局部细节上. 关于三个多模式再分配基准的试验表明我们的方法是有效和有力的。 该代码可在https://github.com/zw-absin/INSPI上查阅.

articles.title: MIRAGE: Full-Body Bystander Privacy for Smart Glasses with Consent-Based Restoration
articles.content:
Video recording on smart glasses exposes more than faces. Continuous capture reveals full-body biometric signatures, including gait, posture, and silhouette, that enable person re-identification (ReID) even after conventional face sanitization.
  We present MIRAGE, a three-tier architecture for privacy-preserving smart glasses that enforces full-body privacy, supports synthetic full-body replacement, and retains encrypted recovery material for consent-based restoration. We implement MIRAGE on a Raspberry Pi~5 (a CPU-only proxy for smart-glasses compute), companion phones, and a cloud generative backend. Compared to prior systems, MIRAGE achieves 0.948 AP and 0.976 AR while accurately detecting the complete visible body. Its bounding box masking reduces learned silhouette-based ReID to essentially random guessing, with 10.86% Rank-1 accuracy compared with an 11.12% measured chance level. Even against an adaptive adversary retrained on MIRAGE's sanitized pose signals, Rank-1 gait identification drops from 90.25% to 26.20%, removing 72.5% of the adversary's identification advantage.

articles.title_zh: MIRAGE: 智能眼镜的全Body旁观者隐私,并基于同意的修复
articles.content_zh:
智能眼镜上录相比面相更能曝光. 连续捕捉揭示出全身生物特征,包括步态,姿势和平滑等,即使在常规面部消毒后仍能重新识别(ReID).
现为MIRAGE,是一种用于保护隐私的三级智能眼镜架构,它执行全体隐私,支持合成全体替换,并保留加密恢复材料,以进行基于同意的修复. 我们用Raspberry Pi~5(智能镜计算只使用CPU的代名词),伴奏手机,和云基因后端执行MIRAGE. 相较于之前的系统,MIRAGE实现了0.948 AP和0.976 AR,同时准确检测出完整的可见体. 它的边框遮盖将所学的以硅光为主的ReID降低到基本上是随机的猜测,其10.86%的Rank-1精度与11.12%的测量概率水平相比. 即使一个适应性强的对手在MIRAGE的消毒状态下重新训练, 排名一的识别率从90.25%下降到26.20%,

articles.title: Dynamic Thermal Gaussians: Multimodal 4D Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: Thermography plays a vital role in military and broader thermal analysis applications. Recent progress in 3D thermal reconstruction has extended temperature analysis from 2D to 3D space, yet most existing works assume static temperature distributions, neglecting the temporal dynamics of heat transfer in real-world environments. To address this limitation, we propose the first dynamic RGB-Thermal reconstruction framework for complex scenes. Our method jointly models RGB appearance, thermal observations, and scene geometry as they change over time. Specifically, we introduce a multimodal dynamic scene representation that anchors both the color and thermal modalities to a shared geometric substrate, ensuring their consistency under spatiotemporal deformations. We further design multimodal embeddings to enhance the motion expressiveness for each modality, and propose a multimodal routing mechanism that retains a unified set of shared multimodal Gaussians as the geometric backbone while adaptively spawning modality-specific Gaussians to strengthen the representational capacity in detail-rich regions of each individual modality. In addition, we contribute a novel benchmark dataset featuring high-frequency temperature variations to facilitate the evaluation of 4D reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves high-fidelity spatiotemporal reconstruction of both appearance and temperature. Our code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/LinLif1869/DTG.

articles.title_zh: 动态热高斯人:多式 4D 高斯人平板
articles.content_zh: 热相学在军事和更广泛的热分析应用中发挥着至关重要的作用. 3D热能重建的近期进展将温度分析从2D扩大到了3D空间,然而大部分现有作品都假定了静态温度分布,忽略了现实世界环境中热能转移的时间动态. 为解决这一局限性,我们提出了第一个动态RGB-热力重建框架,用于复杂场景. 我们的方法联合模型RGB外观,热观测, 和场景几何 随着时间的变化。 具体地说,我们采用了一种多模式动态场景代表,将颜色和热能模式固定在一个共享的几何底物上,确保它们在瞬间变形下的一致性。 我们进一步设计了多模式嵌入法,以加强每种模式的运动表达力,并提议一种多模式通路机制,保留一套统一的共享多模式高斯人作为几何中枢,同时适应性地培育出特定模式高斯人,以加强每种模式在细节丰富的区域的代表性能力。 此外,我们提供了一套新的基准数据,其中包含高频温度变化,以便于评价4D重建。 广泛的实验表明,我们的方法实现了外观和温度的高性能的瞬间重建。 我们的代码和数据集可查阅:https://github.com/LinLif1869/DTG。

articles.title: ME-VLM:A Unified VLM for Embodied Cognition and Agent Coordination
articles.content:
Physical AI requires models to ground visual and linguistic understanding in real-world environments while accounting for environmental constraints and execution feedback. We introduce MachEmbodied-VLM (ME-VLM), a unified vision-language model with two variants, 4B and 35B-A3B, that brings together embodied cognition and multimodal agent capabilities. Our work emphasizes physical perception and spatiotemporal reasoning, together with planning, interaction, and outcome assessment in both digital and physical environments. We construct training data spanning embodied and multimodal agent tasks, including execution observations and feedback to support outcome assessment and decision refinement. The training pipeline comprises embodied capability injection, separate reinforcement learning of embodied and multimodal-agent experts, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation that consolidates their complementary capabilities into a single model. Experiments show competitive performance on both embodied and agent benchmarks, as well as on autonomous-driving and embodied-navigation tasks. For edge deployment, visual token compression, W4A8 quantization, and hardware--software co-optimization enable on-device inference of the 4B variant on the M100, reducing prefill latency from 400 ms to 188 ms.

articles.title: Preoperative Prediction of Microvascular Invasion in Hepatocellular Carcinoma by Integrating Multimodal Ultrasound and Clinical Data: A Multicenter Study
articles.content: Background: Microvascular invasion (MVI) predicts recurrence and survival in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) but requires postoperative histopathology for diagnosis. We developed and validated a model integrating multimodal ultrasound and clinical data for preoperative MVI prediction. Methods: This multicenter study included 489 patients with HCC from eight centers. All patients had B-mode ultrasound (BUS), color Doppler flow imaging (CDFI), dynamic contrast-enhanced ultrasound (DCE-US), and clinical information. Data from seven centers (n = 421) were used for model development with five-fold cross-validation; data from the remaining center (n = 68) formed an independent external validation cohort. The proposed multimodal information fusion network used modality-specific encoders, a hemodynamic temporal change module for bidirectional DCE-US perfusion changes, and a representation consistency learning module to align heterogeneous ultrasound representations before Transformer-based fusion. Results: In external validation, DCE-US achieved the highest single-modality area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC; 0.8545+/-0.0198), versus clinical information (0.6715+/-0.0156), CDFI (0.6435+/-0.0344), and BUS (0.6087+/-0.0417). Pixel-difference sampling and the proposed temporal module outperformed alternative sampling and video representation methods. The full model achieved the best performance, with an AUC of 0.8953+/-0.0180, accuracy of 81.18%+/-2.83%, sensitivity of 86.40%+/-6.69%, and specificity of 78.14%+/-6.28. Conclusions: Integrating multimodal ultrasound and clinical information enabled promising preoperative MVI prediction in HCC. DCE-US was the main source of predictive information, while BUS, CDFI, and clinical information provided complementary value. The proposed framework may support preoperative risk stratification and individualized clinical decision-making.

articles.title_zh: 结合多模式超声波和临床数据对肝细胞癌的微血管入侵的预测:多中心研究
articles.content_zh: 背景:微血管入侵(MVI)预测肝细胞癌(HCC)的再生和存活,但需要进行手术后组织病理学诊断. 我们开发并验证了一个模型,将多式超声波和临床数据结合起来,用于MVI预作预测。 方法: 这项多中心研究包括来自8个中心的489名艾滋病毒/艾滋病感染者。 所有患者都拥有B-mode超声波(BUS),色彩多普勒流成像(CDFI),动态对比增强超声波(DCE-US),以及临床信息. 来自7个中心(n = 421)的数据被用于模型开发,并有5倍的交叉验证;来自所剩中心(n = 68)的数据构成了一个独立的外部验证组群. 拟议的多模式信息聚变网络使用特定模式的编码器,用于双向DCE-US输入变化的血动力时间变化模块,以及用于在变形器基于聚变之前调和多相异超声表示的表示的表达一致性学习模块. 结果: 在外部验证中,DCE-US在接收器操作特征曲线(AUC;0.8545+/-0.0198)下实现了最高的单模式区,相对于临床信息(0.6715+/-0.0156),CDFI(0.6435+/-0.0344)和BUS(0.6087+/-0.0417). 像素偏差取样和拟议的时间模块的性能超过了替代取样和视频显示方法。 全型实现最佳性能,AUC为0.8953+/-0.0180,精度为81.18%+/-2.83%,灵敏度为86.40%%+/-6.69%,特异性为78.14%+/-6.28. 结论: 将多式超声波和临床信息结合起来,使HCC的MVI预测很有希望。 DCE-US是预测信息的主要来源,而BUS,CDFI和临床信息则提供了互补价值. 拟议框架可支持操作前的风险分层和个性化的临床决策。

articles.title: Not All Task Vectors Need Equal Rank: Energy-Proportional Allocation for Model Merging
articles.content: Model merging aims to combine multiple fine-tuned models derived from a common pretrained model into a single multi-task model without additional joint training. Recent spectral merging methods improve over simple weight averaging by exploiting low-rank structures of task-specific updates, but they commonly assign the same rank capacity to every task. This uniform allocation ignores that task vectors can have heterogeneous spectral complexity, causing the shared merging space to be used suboptimally. In this paper, we propose Spectral Energy-proportional Rank Allocation (SERA), a simple task-adaptive strategy that allocates ranks according to the singular-value energy structure of each task vector. By assigning richer spectral capacity to complex or isolated tasks and fewer directions to compact tasks, SERA extends SVD-based model merging from uniform-capacity merging to task-dependent capacity allocation. Experiments under standard vision model merging protocols show that SERA improves multi-task merging performance while preserving the same total rank budget as existing spectral merging methods. Further analysis demonstrates that task-level spectral concentration is closely related to the per-task effect of adaptive rank allocation, providing insight into when and why SERA is effective.

articles.title_zh: 并非所有任务矢量都需要同等的分级:用于模型合并的能源-生产分配
articles.content_zh: 模型合并旨在将从共同的预训模型中衍生出来的多个微调模型合并为单一多任务模型而无需额外的联合培训. 最近的光谱合并方法通过利用任务特定更新的低级结构来改进比简单的平均重量,但它们通常为每一项任务分配相同的等级能力。 这种统一分配忽略了任务矢量可能具有多相分光谱复杂性,导致共享的合并空间被非最佳使用. 在本文中,我们提出"光谱能-比例分级分配"(SERA),这是一种简单的任务适应策略,根据每个任务矢量的单值能结构分配分级. 通过将更丰富的光谱容量分配给复杂或孤立的任务并减少方向分配给紧凑的任务,SERA将基于SVD的合并模式从统一容量的合并扩展到依赖任务的能力分配. 标准视觉模型合并协议下的实验显示,SARA改进了多任务合并性能,同时保留了与现有光谱合并方法相同的总排名预算. 进一步的分析表明,任务一级的光谱浓度与适应性等级分配的每个任务效应密切相关,使人们能够深入了解空间研究局何时和为何有效。

articles.title: 0.5\%>100\%: Bidirectional Reciprocal Learning for Referring Image Segmentation
articles.content: Recent advances in vision foundation models (VFMs) have shown remarkable capabilities across diverse unimodal visual tasks. However, adapting VFMs to referring image segmentation (RIS) typically necessitates precise vision-language alignment via full fine-tuning, incurring substantial computational overhead and risking catastrophic forgetting. While existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods enable safe knowledge transfer with minimal training costs, they predominantly operate independently within individual modalities or focus exclusively on unidirectional guidance from language to vision, overlooking progressive cross-modal interaction and visual feedback for textual refinement. To address these limitations, we propose Bidirectional Reciprocal Learning (BRL), a novel adapter-based PEFT framework that facilitates hierarchical, bidirectional information flow within both token-mixing and channel-mixing layers of frozen foundation models. Specifically, BRL introduces two complementary lightweight modules. The Reciprocal Attention Adapter (RAA) performs cross-modal query-key exchanges at the token level, enabling visual and linguistic tokens to mutually attend to each other for fine-grained spatial grounding. The Reciprocal Gate Adapter (RGA) generates cross-modal gating signals at the channel level, allowing global semantic context from one modality to adaptively recalibrate channel activations of the other. Extensive experiments on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of BRL over prior RIS methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance while requiring less than 0.5% backbone parameter updates. Code and models will be released at https://github.com/xiaoqiang-lu/BRL.

articles.title_zh: 0.5\%>100\%:参考图像分片双向对等学习
articles.content_zh: 视觉基础模型(VFMs)的近期进展在各种单式视觉任务中显示出了显著的能力. 然而,调整VFM以参照图像分解(RIS),通常需要通过全面微调精确的视觉语言校正,引起大量的计算间接费用并有可能造成灾难性的遗忘。 虽然现有的参数效率微调(PEFT)方法能够以最低的培训费用进行安全的知识转让,但它们主要在个别模式内独立运作,或只注重从语言到视觉的单向指导,而忽略了渐进式的跨模式互动和视觉反馈,以进行文字改进。 为了克服这些局限性,我们提出双向对等学习(BRL),这是一个基于新颖适配器的PEFT框架,它促进分级,双向信息流动,既在符号混合层,又在信道混合层中冷冻地基模型. 具体而言,BRL引入了两个互补的轻量级模块. 对等注意适配器(RAA)在道具层面进行跨模式的查询键交换,使视觉和语言道具能够互相照顾以进行精细的空间地平面. 对等出入口适配器(RGA)在通道一级生成跨模式的地标信号,使全球语义上下文从一种模式到适应性地调整另一方式的通道活化. 对RefCOCOCO、RefCOCO+和RefCOCOg基准的广泛实验表明,BRL优于以前的RIS方法,实现了最先进的性能,同时需要更新不到0.5%的主干参数。 代码和模型将在https://github.com/xiaoqiang-lu/BRL发布.

articles.title: CMAMBADEPTH: Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation with Channel Mamba and Hybrid Attention
articles.content: Accurate monocular depth estimation serves as a core enabler for single camera scene understanding. However, existing self-supervised monocular depth estimation methods generally suffer from the bottleneck of inefficient cross-scale information interaction and difficulty in balancing local and global spatial modeling. In this paper, we propose CMambaDepth, a self-supervised framework that achieves efficient multi-scale feature fusion and fine-grained contextual modeling via channel-wise selective state propagation. Specifically, Bidirectional Channel Mamba (Bi-CMamba) aligns encoder features across scales and enables bidirectional information exchange among ordered scale groups. Unidirectional Channel Mamba (Uni-CMamba) progressively aggregates decoder features and retains fine-grained scale groups through a group selection mechanism for subsequent fusion. Furthermore, a Hybrid Attention Module (HAM) is introduced to combine large-kernel local context and Manhattan self-attention for complementary spatial modeling. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves highly competitive performance. Specifically, our model achieves an AbsRel of 0.094 and an RMSE of 4.156 on KITTI, and an AbsRel of 0.140 on DDAD. In the zero-shot cross-dataset generalization test on NYUv2, it attains an AbsRel of 0.232, outperforming the baseline RA-Depth by 7.2%.

articles.title_zh: CMAMBADEPTH:自控单曲深度估计与频道曼巴和混合关注
articles.content_zh: 精确的单相机深度估计是单相机场景理解的核心助推器. 然而,现有的自我监督的单一深度估计方法一般都受到跨尺度信息互动效率低下和难以平衡当地和全球空间模型的瓶颈所困扰. 在本文中,我们提出CMamba Depth,这是一个自我监督的框架,通过信道选择的状态传播,实现高效的多尺度地物聚变和精细的上下文模型。 具体来说,双向通道Mamba(Bi-CMamba)将编码器的功能统一到各种尺度上,并能够在按顺序排列的尺度组之间进行双向信息交流。 单向通道Mamba(Uni-CMamba)通过组合选择机制逐渐聚合解码器特征并保留精细的分级组,用于后续聚变. 此外,还引入了一个混合关注模块(HAM),将大内核局部环境与曼哈顿的自我关注结合起来,以形成互补的空间模型。 实验结果表明,我们的方法取得了高度竞争性的业绩。 具体来说,我们的模型在KITTI上实现了0.094的AbsRel和4.156的RMSE,在DDAD上实现了0.140的AbsRel. 在NYUv2上的零射入相数据集泛化测试中,它达到了0.232的AbsRel,比基线RA-Depth高7.2%。

articles.title: Identity-Consistent Analysis of Long-Shot Windsurfing Video: A Domain-Specific Offline Tracking System
articles.content: Long-shot windsurfing video combines small targets, large camera pans, prolonged overlaps, and rapidly changing backgrounds. The desired output is not a generic MOT trace but a separate, stable rider-relative video for each surfer; one false identity merge can invalidate an otherwise useful result. We present an offline analysis system that detects surfers, forms conservative local tracklets, links them globally with camera-compensated motion and a foreground-masked sail-color descriptor, and uses two pose keypoints on the rig to drive a rider-relative virtual camera. The tracking stage is evaluated on 21 manually reconstructed development videos containing 41,004 retained observations. On this fixed-observation protocol, the production system achieves 0.957 pairwise precision, 0.918 recall, and 0.937 F1, compared with 0.792 F1 for OC-SORT and 0.828 for BoT-SORT. Compared with OC-SORT, it reduces fragmentation excess from 845 to 42, but nine of its 95 output tracks mix rider identities and these errors affect seven of the 21 videos.

articles.title_zh: 长热风浪的特性一致性分析 视频:一个域-特定离线跟踪系统
articles.content_zh: 长发风力视频结合了小目标,大相机平板,长时间重叠,并迅速改变背景. 所期望的输出不是通用的MOT追踪,而是每个冲浪者一个单独的,稳定的骑手相亲视频;一个假身份的合并可以使一个本来有用的结果失效. 我们提出一个离线分析系统, 检测出冲浪者, 形成保守的局部轨道, 将它们与相机补偿运动和前置的帆-彩色标记连接起来, 21个手动重建的开发视频对跟踪阶段进行了评估,其中包含41 004个保留了观测数据。 在这个固定观测协议上,生产系统实现了0.957对精度,0.918回想,0.937 F1,而OC-SORT的F1和BOT-SORT的F1分别为0.792和0.828. 与OC-SORT相比,它将分解过剩从845个减少到42个,但其95个输出道中9个混合骑手身份以及这些出错影响了21个视频中的7个.

articles.title: AgentSTAR: Agentic Shape Tracking and Reconstruction from Monocular Videos
articles.content: In this work, we present a method for shape reconstruction and tracking from video via agentic analysis-by-synthesis. Unlike prior methods which first estimate dense pixel correspondences and then recover object motion from them, our method infers a structured 3D object model, including its geometry and kinematic structure, and uses this model to optimise object track estimates over time. In our optimisation loop, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) agent iteratively refines shape or generalised pose through a render-and-compare loop, combining coarse visual reasoning with numerical pose optimisation for precise state estimation. This structured formulation enables our method to track through large motion, articulation, and severe occlusion without relying on pixel-matching objectives. Quantitatively, on ARCTIC, our method substantially outperforms state-of-the-art 3D point-tracking baselines for articulated objects, and on HOT3D it outperforms all evaluated rigid-object tracking baselines.

articles.title_zh: AgentSTAR:来自单相机视频的代理形状跟踪与重建
articles.content_zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了一种通过代理分析逐一合成从视频中进行形状重建和跟踪的方法. 与以前首先估计密集像素对应并随后从中恢复物体运动的方法不同,我们的方法推断了一个结构化的三维物体模型,包括其几何和动能结构,并使用这个模型随着时间的推移优化物体轨道估计. 在我们的优化循环中,一个视觉-语言模型(VLM)代理通过渲染和比较循环,迭代地提炼出外形或被概括的外形,将粗糙的视觉推理与数字外形优化结合起来,以进行精确的状态估计. 这种结构化的配方使我们能够在不依赖像素相配目标的情况下,通过大型运动、发光和严重隔离来跟踪我们的方法。 从数量上讲,在ARCTIC,我们的方法大大超过了所阐明物体的最先进的三维点跟踪基线,在HOT3D上,它超过了所有评估的刚性物体跟踪基线。

articles.title: VPRune: Efficient Training-free Pre-LLM Visual Token Pruning
articles.content: Visual token pruning is a promising approach to reducing the inference cost of large vision-language models (LVLMs), yet aggressive token reduction often causes substantial performance degradation. We identify three key factors behind this degradation: text-guided selection bias, information loss from discarded tokens, and positional distortion caused by sequence compaction. Based on these observations, we propose \textbf{VPRune}, a training-free pre-LLM pruning framework consisting of visual-only diversity selection, similarity-guided token recycling, and position-preserving restoration. Experiments on FastVLM-1.5B across multiple vision-language benchmarks demonstrate that VPRune achieves a favorable accuracy--compression trade-off, with particularly pronounced advantages under aggressive compression. Furthermore, evaluations on edge-device show that VPRune effectively reduces end-to-end inference latency while maintaining superior task performance, demonstrating its practicality for resource-constrained LVLM deployment.

articles.title_zh: VPRune: 高效的免费培训 视觉托肯普鲁宁
articles.content_zh: 视觉符号推算是一种减少大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)推算成本的有希望的办法,但积极的象征性推算降低往往会使性能严重退化。 我们找出造成这种退化的三个关键因素:文字指导选择偏差、被丢弃的符文造成的信息损失以及序列收缩造成的位置扭曲。 基于这些观察,我们提议\textbf{VPRune},一个无培训的LLM预运行框架,包括只选择视觉多样性,相似性引导符号再生,以及保留位置的还原. FastVLM-1.5B的实验跨越了多种视觉语言基准,表明VPRune实现了有利的精度-压缩取舍,在积极的压缩下具有特别显著的优势. 此外,对边缘装置的评价表明,VPRune在保持优异任务性能的同时,有效地减少了端到端的推断延迟性,表明其对资源受限制的LVLM部署的实用性.

articles.title: STA-TFM: Spatio-Temporal Aggregation Across Views TransForMer for Pose Estimation
articles.content: Monocular 3D human pose estimation (HPE) remains challenging due to depth ambiguity, occlu- sions, and the need for temporal consistency. While multi-view methods provide superior accuracy over monocular approaches, they often require complex setups. We introduce STA-TFM, a transformer-based architecture that combines spatial and temporal information for multi-view pose estimation. The approach leverages DSTformer, a monocular feature extractor, to capture long-range pose dependencies within each view. A fusion transformer then aggregates information across views to produce coherent 3D estimates. To address training data scarcity, we use a data generation pipeline that transforms any existing 3D pose dataset into multi-view setups with controllable parameters. Experiments on various datasets demonstrate that STA-TFM outperforms existing camera-parameter-free multi-view methods. STA-TFM achieves 50.9% and 49.5% reductions in mean per joint position error (MPJPE) and mean per joint velocity error (MPJVE) on the DHP19 dataset. Furthermore, it achieves 6.7% and 7.7% respective reductions on HAA4D, and a 15.2% MPJPE reduction on TotalCapture. STA-TFM handles noisy and missing 2D inputs, supporting potential deployment in healthcare monitoring, athletic assessment, and immersive technologies. Code, training checkpoints, and data are available at https://zenodo.org/records/22832620.

articles.title_zh: STA-TFM : 跨视图的空间- 时间聚合
articles.content_zh: 由于深度模糊、Occlu-sions以及时间一致性的需要,单体3D人类姿势估计(HPE)仍然具有挑战性。 虽然多视图方法比单视方法提供了更高的精度,但往往需要复杂的设置. 我们引入了STA-TFM,一种以变压器为基础的结构,它将空间和时间信息结合起来,用于多视图配置估计. 该方法利用了DSTformer,一种单特异性特征提取器,捕捉出每个视图中的长距离相依性. 聚变器然后汇总各种观点的信息,得出一致的三维估计. 为了解决培训数据稀缺的问题,我们使用一个数据生成管道,将任何现有的3D设置数据集转换成具有可控参数的多视图设置. 各种数据集的实验表明STA-TFM的性能超过了现有的相机参数无多视图方法. STA-TFM在DHP19数据集上每联合位置误差(MPJPE)和每联合速度误差(MPJVE)的平均值分别实现50.9%和49.5%的降低. 此外,它分别实现了HAA4D的6.7%和7.7%的削减,而MPJPE在总容量的削减率为15.2%。 STA-TFM处理噪音和缺失的2D输入,支持在保健监测、运动评估和浸入技术方面的潜在部署。 守则、训练检查站和数据见https://zenodo.org/records/22832620。

articles.title: Spatial Action Review: A Visual Analytics Dashboard for Auditing Language-to-Action Hand-offs in Electron Microscopy
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly explored as interfaces for scientific image analysis, where a visual question-answering (VQA) response may be paired with a spatial output that guides a downstream stage. A supervisor reads the language answer, while a downstream workflow such as segmentation or region review consumes the point-set output. We call this transition from inspecting the answer to relying on its point action the language-to-action hand-off. A silent failure occurs when the answer is correct while the paired action misses annotated objects needed downstream, so answer-based oversight clears a region whose action is unreliable. We introduce Spatial Action Review, a visual analytics dashboard for auditing this failure mode in electron microscopy (EM) mitochondria analysis. It links paired answer-action records through an answer-action ledger, a task-by-dataset risk map, and an image-region audit view, connecting aggregate patterns to image evidence while an adjustable action-reliability gate supports re-audit. The review ends in a human-AI hand-off, where a supervisor records whether the action is accepted, escalated, held under a stricter gate, or flagged for model revision. Across 541 image regions from an EM-adapted Qwen3-VL case-study run, point actions fail the gate in 54.4% of records with a correct VQA response, and 27.4% of all records are silent failures. A correct answer is associated with only a 5.8-percentage-point higher probability of a reliable action, with a bootstrap interval spanning zero; the point-biserial correlation between answer correctness and object coverage is 0.061. This weak coupling persists across five model conditions on 753 matched image regions. Spatial Action Review makes answer-action mismatches visible and ties them to image evidence and a recorded decision before MLLM outputs enter autonomous scientific workflows.

articles.title_zh: 空间行动审查:电子显微镜中用于审计语言对行动操作的视觉分析板
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)作为科学图像分析的界面日益被探索,其中可将可视化的问答(VQA)响应与引导下游阶段的空间输出对接. 主管阅读语言答案,而下游的工作流程如分块或区域审查则会消耗点集输出. 我们称从检查答案到依赖其点行动,这种转变是语言对行动交接。 当组合动作错过下游需要附加说明的物体时,如果答案是正确的,就会出现沉默的失败,因此基于答案的监督可以清除行动不可靠的区域。 我们引入了空间行动评论(Space Action Review),这是用于在电子显微镜(EM)线粒体分析中审核这种故障模式的视觉分析仪表板. 它通过一个答题动作分类账,一个任务逐个数据集风险图,和一个图像区域审计视图,将组合模式与图像证据连接起来,而可调整的动作可靠性门则支持再审计. 审查的结束是人与AI交接,由主管记录行动是否被接受、升级、在更严格的门下举行或标出模型修订。 在54.4%的记录中有正确VQA响应的分点动作失效, 27.4%的所有记录都是无声故障。 正确的答案与可靠行动的5.8-分高概率有关,靴子间隔为0;答案正确度与对象覆盖度之间的点-二线关联为0.061. 在753个匹配图像区域的5个模式条件下,这种薄弱的组合持续存在。 空间行动审查使答案-动作不匹配现象明显可见,并在MLLM输出进入自主科学工作流程之前将它们与图像证据和记录的决定联系起来.

articles.title: MIGA:Shared-Geometry Gaussian Representation with Implicit Amplitude Modeling for Accelerated 3D Multi-Echo MRI
articles.content: Three-dimensional multi-echo MRI provides rich anatomical and quantitative information, but repeated volumetric encoding prolongs acquisition and motivates k-space undersampling. Reconstructing undersampled multi-echo data requires exploiting shared anatomy while preserving echo-dependent signal variation; full-volume modeling also introduces substantial computational and memory demands. We propose MIGA, a scan-specific framework comprising shared anisotropic Gaussian geometry, a coordinate-conditioned multi-output amplitude network, and explicit echo-specific phase variables. The Gaussian geometry provides common spatial support across echoes, the implicit network models spatially structured amplitude variations, and the phase variables retain echo-specific complex signal information. All components are jointly optimized using only the acquired multi-coil k-space, requiring no fully sampled training data. Experiments showed that MIGA consistently outperformed the comparison methods across imaging tasks and acceleration factors, with larger improvements under stronger undersampling. MIGA also achieved a favorable quality-cost balance among the evaluated full-volume multi-echo methods. These results support the effectiveness of combining shared Gaussian geometry with implicit echo-dependent amplitude modeling for accelerated 3D multi-echo MRI reconstruction.

articles.title_zh: MIGA:用于加速3D多Echo核磁共振的带隐形光度模型的共享-高斯代表
articles.content_zh: 三维多相 核磁共振提供了丰富的解剖学和定量信息,但重复的量子编码会延长获取时间并激励k-space进行下取样. 重构被取样的多echo数据需要利用共享解剖学,同时保留依赖回声的信号变异;全量模型化也引入了大量的计算和内存需要. 我们提出MIGA,一个扫描特定框架,包括共享异同位素高斯几何学,一个具有协调条件的多输出振幅网络,以及明确的针对回声的相位变量. 高斯几何提供了跨回声的共同空间支持,隐含的网络模型空间结构的振幅变化,相位变量保留了回声特有的复杂信号信息. 所有部件都只使用获得的多油克-空地进行联合优化,不需要完整的抽样培训数据。 实验显示,MIGA在成像任务和加速度因子方面的对比方法一直优于后者,在更强的下采样下改进更大. 多边投资担保机构在经过评价的全量多生态方法之间也取得了有利的质量成本平衡。 这些结果支持将共享高斯几何与隐含回声依赖振幅模型相结合,以加速3D多echo核磁共振重建的有效性.

articles.title: MECAIL: Communication-Aware Incremental Learning for Object Detection with 14.6 KB Spatiotemporal Experts
articles.content: Intelligent transportation systems require Incremental Learning (IL) to continually improve their overall performance in dynamic environments. However, most edge devices lack the computational resources to support on-device IL, requiring updates to be transmitted from centralized servers. We propose using this setup to obtain dense, specialized module coverage that adapts a fixed base model to specific spatiotemporal contexts, such as parking lots, gas stations, ferries, or construction sites. However, in order to reliably transmit these modules to the edge device, using TCP, UDP, and BTP over V2X, Wi-Fi, and 2G-5G hardware, we establish a strict limit of 14.6 KB per module to fit within the first TCP window and to minimize UDP/BTP fragmentation. We further introduce Mixture-of-Experts for Communication-Aware Incremental Learning (MECAIL), the first method that meets this strict requirement, in which each new domain or environment is served by a small expert network that adapts the base model. We validate MECAIL on D-RICO and ODinW-13, where it largely matches the performance of parameter-heavy approaches while enabling practical, bandwidth-efficient large-scale deployment. This allows comprehensive coverage by experts for highly specific, focused, and temporary situations.

articles.title_zh: MECAIL: 与14.6 KB Spatiotepolar 专家一起为物体探测进行通讯-软件增量学习
articles.content_zh: 智能运输系统需要增量学习(IL),以便在动态环境中不断提高整体性能. 然而,大多数边缘设备缺乏支持在device IL上的计算资源,需要从集中服务器传输更新. 我们提议利用这一设置来获得密集的、专门的模块覆盖,使固定基建模型适应具体的瞬间环境,例如停车场、加油站、渡船或建筑工地。 然而,为了将这些模块可靠地传输到边缘设备,在V2X,Wi-Fi和2G-5G硬件上使用TCP,UDP和BTP,我们定下严格的每个模块的14.6KB限制,以适应第一个TCP窗口,并尽量减少UDP/BTP的分化. 我们进一步引入交流-软件增量学习(MECAIL)的专家混合法,这是满足这一严格要求的第一种方法,在这种方法中,每个新领域或环境都由一个小型的专家网络来服务,该专家网络对基础模型进行调整. 我们在D-RICO和ODinW-13上对MECAIL进行验证,它基本上与参数厚度方法的性能相匹配,同时能够进行实用、带宽高效的大规模部署。 这使专家能够全面了解非常具体、重点突出和暂时的情况。

articles.title: Do LiDAR Language Models Really Understand Spatio-temporal Relationships?
articles.content: Recent 4D LiDAR language models aim to reason about objects and their evolving spatial relationships. Yet, in our evaluation, always selecting the same option nearly matches the multiple-choice accuracy of two B4DL-derived configurations. We introduce LiDAR-Hallu, a geometry-referenced benchmark and diagnostic protocol with 10,000 questions across 150 nuScenes scenes. It covers object existence, ego-relative position, distance ordering, relative motion, and temporal localization, with explicit rules for selecting objects, comparing times, and determining reference answers. Our protocol combines fixed-answer and candidate-content controls, cross-scene pairs with identical prompts but opposite reference answers, and relation-specific recall. Analysis of 100,000 recorded responses reveals failures hidden by aggregate accuracy. Candidate duration alone makes temporal answers predictable without observing LiDAR. On paired questions, the models frequently give the same answer to scenes requiring opposite answers. Relation-specific analysis further shows that both configurations miss every positive lateral-motion case across all tested conditions. Temporal-shuffle contrastive decoding provides little net improvement, as repairs are largely offset by new errors and the main failures persist. These results show that evaluating spatio-temporal reasoning requires testing whether models distinguish the queried physical relationships, rather than relying on individual-answer accuracy alone. The source code, checkpoints, and data are released at https://github.com/Awesome4D/4DMLLM_Hallucination_Bench.

articles.title_zh: 做丽达 语言模型真的理解时空关系吗?
articles.content_zh: 最近4D LiDAR语言模型旨在解释物体及其演变中的空间关系. 然而,在我们的评价中,总是选择同一个选项,几乎与两个B4DL衍生配置的多选精度一致。 我们介绍LiDAR-Hallu,一个几何参照基准和诊断协议,在150个nuScens场景中包含一万个问题. 它涵盖了对象存在,自负相对位置,距离顺序,相对运动,以及时间本地化,有选择对象,比较时间,确定参考答案的明确规则. 我们的协议结合了固定的回答和候选内容控制,有相同的提示但反向的参考答案的相交相对,以及针对具体关系的召回. 对100 000份已记录答复的分析显示,失败以总的准确性掩盖。 仅候选人持续时间就可以在不观察LiDAR的情况下预测时间答案。 在对接的问题上,模型经常对需要相反答案的场景给出相同的答案. 关系特异性分析还表明,两种配置都错过了所有被测试条件的每个正平平平动相. 临时调整的对比解码没有多少净改进,因为修复工作在很大程度上被新的错误所抵消,而且主要故障依然存在。 这些结果表明,评价斯皮提奥-时序推理需要测试模型是否区分被询问的物理关系,而不是仅仅依靠个人回答的准确性. 源代码、检查站和数据公布于https://github.com/Awesome4D/4DMLLM_Hallucination_Bench。

articles.title: Estimating Accurate Hand Pose in Camera Space with Vision Transformer
articles.content: Monocular RGB-based hand pose estimation has emerged as a critical research frontier in computer vision. The local hand pose estimation methods predict hand poses relative to the wrist, while global hand pose estimation also requires estimating the wrist's position in the camera coordinate system. However, this camera-space estimation confronts two fundamental challenges: (1) depth ambiguity in monocular settings, and (2) the coupling effect of hand local poses and global wrist positions in the perspective projections. In particular, this coupling reflects that the projections are jointly determined by local hand poses, wrist positions, and camera intrinsics. To overcome these challenges, our framework proposes two key innovations: Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision for hand-depth information extraction and Perspective Information Embedding for resolving above coupling effect of local pose and wrist position, both integrated within the mainstream encoder-decoder architecture. Besides, we propose a novel framerate-aware multi-dataset training strategy for sequential pose refinement. Our fully integrated approach achieves at most 37.1\% superiority in CS-MJE over SOTA on HO3D. Project page: https://github.com/Mine268/CS-ViT.

articles.title_zh: 与视觉变形器一起在相机空间估算精确的手起子
articles.content_zh: 以单光学RGB为基础的手作姿势估计已成为计算机视觉中的一个关键研究前沿。 局部手提出估计方法,预测手提出的相对手腕,而全球手提出估计也要求估计手腕在相机坐标系统中的位置. 然而,这种相机-相机空间估计面临着两个根本性的挑战:(1) 单相机环境下的深度模糊;(2) 手局部的组合效应和视角预测中的全球腕部位置. 特别是,这种耦合反应出,预测是由局部手姿,手腕姿势和相机所固有的相机共同决定的. 为了克服这些挑战,我们的框架提出了两项关键创新: " 转型-异形主义监督 " ,用于手取深度信息; " 视角信息嵌入 " ,用于解决局部姿势和手腕位置的以上耦合效应,两者都纳入主流编码-解码器架构。 此外,我们提出新的框架-认识多数据集培训战略,以便不断完善。 我们完全一体化的方法在CS-MJE最多达到37.1%的优势,在HO3D上达到SOTA. 项目页:https://github.com/Mine268/CS-ViT.

articles.title: DeCo: Efficient Decouple-to-Couple Learning for Multi-Task Visual Grounding
articles.content: Multi-task visual grounding requires models to jointly understand linguistic semantics and perform accurate visual localization and segmentation. Despite the success of multimodal large language models, effectively adapting them to multiple grounding objectives remains challenging. Existing methods commonly enforce task cooperation through shared representations, while overlooking the intrinsic conflict between task-oriented feature interests. In this paper, we introduce $\textbf{DeCo}$, an efficient $\textbf{De}$couple-to-$\textbf{Co}$uple learning framework that resolves this dilemma through a two-stage paradigm: task-specific representation decoupling followed by complementary prior coupling. Specifically, we first propose Task-aware Semantic Decoupling (TSD) to route shared visual cues into individual features under salient word-level guidance, alleviating representation interference between localization and segmentation. Furthermore, we observe that segmentation naturally provides informative localization priors due to dense supervision. Based on this insight, we introduce Hybrid Prior Coupling (HPC), which integrates sentence-level semantic prior with mask-derived spatial prior for enhanced grounding. Built upon a frozen multimodal encoder, DeCo requires lightweight trainable parameters while achieving strong generalization across multiple grounding objectives. Extensive experiments on RefCOCO/+, G-Ref, ReferIt, Flickr, DIOR-RSVG, SARVG1.0, RRSIS-D, RIS-LAD, and RefDIOR demonstrate that DeCo achieves state-of-the-art performance on both natural and remote sensing benchmarks. The code and models are available at https://github.com/xiaoqiang-lu/DeCo.

articles.title_zh: DeCo: 高效的多任务视觉地平面脱钩学习
articles.content_zh: 多任务可视地定位需要模型共同理解语言语义,并进行准确的可视地定位和分化. 尽管多式联运大型语言模式取得了成功,但有效使其适应多重基本目标仍然是挑战。 现有方法通常通过共同陈述来加强任务合作,同时忽略了面向任务的利益之间的内在冲突。 在本文中,我们介绍 $\textbf{DeCo}$, 一个高效的 $\textbf{De}$couple-to-$\textbf{Co}$uple 学习框架,通过一个两阶段的范式来解决这一困境: 任务特定代表解钩,然后是互补的先结合. 具体地说,我们首先提议在突出的字级指导下,将共享的视觉提示带入单个特征,从而减轻本地化和分化之间的表达干扰。 此外,我们还注意到,由于严密的监督,分化自然提供了信息化的本地化前科。 基于这一见解,我们引入了“混合前接”(HPC),它将句子层次的语义与口罩衍生空间相融合,然后用于加强地平面。 DeCo是在被冻结的多式编码器上建造的,它需要轻量能训练的参数,同时实现跨越多地基目标的强通化。 关于RefCOCO/+、G-Reference、ReferenceIt、Flickr、DIOR-RSVG、SARVG1.0、RRSIS-D、RIS-LAD和RefDIOR的大量实验表明,DeCo在自然和遥感基准方面都取得了最新业绩。 代码和模型见https://github.com/xiaoqiang-lu/DeCo.

articles.title: Can Spiking Neural Networks play pinball? A neuromorphic motion detector for target tracking
articles.content:
Biological visual systems achieve continuous, low-latency motion perception by processing sparse, asynchronous spiking signals, enabling real-time tracking under strict energy constraints. Event-based cameras, inspired by the mammalian retina, replicate this efficiency by capturing only local brightness changes as asynchronous events, offering a natural substrate for spiking neural networks (SNNs) to parallelise computation and adapt to fast-changing scenes. Pinball provides a controlled yet dynamic testbed, requiring precise motion estimation and fast reaction to a small, rapidly moving target.
  This work presents a fully spiking, real-time perception-to-action pipeline for closed-loop pinball gameplay. A dynamic vision sensor observes a small, fast-moving ball, and a network of spiking Time-Difference Encoders on the SpiNNaker neuromorphic platform jointly estimates its position, speed, and direction. The system is characterised across receptive field size, accumulation window, and angular tuning width for real-time operation, and benchmarked in closed loop against human players across two flipper regimes of increasing physical realism. It achieves a hit rate of 56.1%, nearly double the human average, reacting within 21.7 ms (5 ms network latency) and consuming an estimated 148 μW using fewer than 25k neurons, among the fastest and most energy-efficient event-based closed-loop demonstrators benchmarked. Under more realistic flipper dynamics, tuning a single interpretable policy parameter reproduces the full spectrum of human play styles, from cautious to aggressive, with no change to the perception pipeline. A physical demonstrator, tracking a real ball and actuating real flippers in closed loop, confirms the principle operates beyond simulation. Its fully spiking, learning-free design offers a compact, energy-efficient example of real-time neuromorphic perception-to-action.

articles.title_zh: 螺旋神经网络能弹弹球吗?. 用于跟踪目标的神经形态运动探测器
articles.content_zh:
生物视觉系统通过处理稀疏,同步的闪烁信号来达到连续的,低纬度的运动感知,在严格的能量限制下实现实时跟踪. 基于事件的相机由哺乳动物视网膜所启发,通过只捕捉局部亮度变化作为同步事件来复制这种效率,为相生神经网络(SNNs)提供自然底物来并行计算并适应快速变化的场景. 弹珠提供可控而活泼的试验台,需要精确的运动估计和对一个小而迅速移动的目标的快速反应.
这部作品为闭环式弹球游戏提供了全速的实时感知至动作管道. 一个能动的视觉传感器观测到一个能快速移动的小球,以及斯皮纳克神经形态平台上由平起平起平起的时分编码器组成的网络,共同估计其位置,速度和方向. 该系统的特点是跨越可接受字段大小,积分窗口,以及用于实时操作的角调宽度等,并以闭环比照人类玩家设定的基准,跨越两个不断增强的物理现实主义的翻转系统. 它的命中率达到56.1%,几乎是人类平均水平的两倍,在21.7米(5米网络潜伏度)以内反应,并且使用不到25克神经元消耗了约148微瓦,属于以事件为基础、速度最快和能效最高的闭路示威者基准。 在更现实的翻转动力学下,调制出单一可解释的政策参数,再现出人类游戏风格的全谱,从谨慎到攻击,没有改变感想管道. 一个物理演示器,跟踪一粒真实的球并用闭环来激活真正的翻转器,证实了原理的操作超越了模拟. 它的完全平起平起,无所学习的设计提供了一个紧凑而节能的实时神经形态感知-动作的例子.

articles.title: A Lightweight Convolutional Neural Network for Real-Time Recognition of Hand-Drawn Geometric Shapes
articles.content: Recognizing hand-drawn geometric shapes is a foundational sub-problem of sketch recognition, with applications in education, human-computer interaction, and diagram digitization. This paper presents the design, implementation, and evaluation of a desktop application that recognizes four basic hand-drawn geometric shapes, circle, square, rectangle, and triangle using a compact Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). A dataset of 2,000 labeled 28x28-pixel shape images was collected independently and released publicly. The classifier consists of three convolutional blocks (16, 32, and 64 filters) with max-pooling, an in-model data-augmentation stage (random horizontal flip, rotation, and zoom), a dropout-regularized dense layer of 128 units, and a 4-way linear output layer, totaling 97{,}956 trainable parameters. The network is trained with the Adam optimizer on a sparse categorical cross-entropy objective computed directly on logits. On an 80/20 train-validation split, the model achieves 94.80% training accuracy and 96.01% validation accuracy with a validation loss of 0.1437. A Tkinter-based graphical interface allows a user to draw a shape with the mouse and receive an immediate class prediction with a confidence score. We situate this system within the broader sketch and shape-recognition literature, compare its accuracy against related hand-drawn shape classification studies, and discuss the limitations inherent to a small, single-contributor dataset. The complete source code, trained model, and per-class datasets are released publicly to support reproducibility.

articles.title_zh: 轻量级革命神经网络实时识别手绘几何形状
articles.content_zh: 识别手绘几何形状是草图识别的基础子问题,在教育、人机互动和图表数字化方面都有应用。 本文介绍一个桌面应用程序的设计,实施和评价情况,该应用程序使用紧凑的Convolutional Neural Network(CNN)识别出四个基本的手绘几何形状,圆形,正方形,矩形和三角形. 一个2000个被标注为28x28-像素形状图像的数据集被独立收集并公开发布. 分级器由三个带最大集合(16个,32个和64个滤波器)的分级块组成,一个模型中的数据增强阶段(随机水平翻转,旋转,并缩放),128个单元的淘汰-正态密集层,以及一个4向线性输出层,共97{,}956个可列车参数. 该网络与亚当优化器一起培训 直接在登录器上计算出一个稀有的 绝对的交叉目标 在80/20次列车验证分出时,该型号实现了94.80%的训练精度和96.01%的验证精度,验证损失为0.1437. 基于Tkinter的图形界面允许用户用鼠标绘制出形状并获得具有信心分数的即时类预测. 我们把这一系统放在更广泛的草图和形状识别文献中,将其准确性与相关的手绘形状分类研究相比较,并讨论一个小型的单一贡献者数据集固有的局限性. 完整的源代码,训练有素的模型,以及每类数据集都公开发布,以支持可再生性.

articles.title: Topographic Training Concentrates Causal Circuits Without Improving Neuron Monosemanticity
articles.content: Mechanistic interpretability of vision transformers seeks to decompose model computation into human-readable units, but learned representations entangle many concepts in each neuron. Feature superposition is widely treated as the central obstacle to this decomposition, yet most mitigations (sparse autoencoders, dictionary learning) are post-hoc and leave the underlying network unchanged. We ask whether a spatial-locality training loss (TopoLoss) can act as a lightweight, training-time prior that improves interpretability of standard mech-interp tools. Training ViT on ImageNet-100 across multiple TopoLoss weights $α$, we measure causal sufficiency of topographic clusters via activation patching and feature geometry via sparse autoencoders fit to the same residual stream. At $α=1.0$, topographic clusters are 2.79$\times$ more causally sufficient than random unit sets of the same size, with the effect increasing monotonically in $α$. SAE L0 sparsity decreases by 11% and dead-feature fraction rises 19-fold, yet standard neuron-level monosemanticity scores are unchanged, indicating that topographic pressure acts at circuit level, concentrating causal mass into spatially local structures without disentangling individual neurons. This dissociation suggests current neuron-level monosemanticity metrics are insensitive to a class of real interpretability gains, and positions cheap architectural priors as a viable training-time complement to post-hoc tooling.

articles.title: Critical-State RL: Diagnosing Trainable States for Multi-Turn Tool Use
articles.content: Multi-turn tool-use failures can hinge on a single model call, yet reward variation alone does not reveal which call would benefit from training. When rewards depend on later interactions, their variation can reflect downstream randomness rather than differences between the current actions. We introduce Critical-State RL to identify trainable states in multi-turn interactions. Given task-defined candidate calls and local rewards, the method assesses whether each reward captures the action's effect on task success and whether improvement over a reference policy is possible. It then uses nested sampling to separate action-dependent reward variation from continuation noise and optimizes the policy at the selected states using contextual-bandit training. Experiments on the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL) v4 compare training at diagnostic-selected states with training at alternative states. For missing-function tasks, the diagnostic selects the response after the tool becomes available; for missing-argument tasks, it selects the response before the missing argument is supplied. Training the selected responses improves performance, including about 14 percentage points on the missing-function task, while training the alternatives leaves performance flat or worse. We further apply the recipe across models and tasks, including logged repeat-call avoidance and memory management.

articles.title_zh: 临界状态 RL: 诊断可训练国家用于多轮工具
articles.content_zh: 多回合工具使用失败可能取决于单一模式呼吁,但单靠奖励变化并不能说明培训将给哪些呼吁带来好处。 当奖励依赖于后期的相互作用时,它们的变化可以反映下游的随机性,而不是当前行动之间的差异. 我们引入了临界状态RL,以识别在多回合互动中可训练状态. 鉴于任务界定的候选人呼叫和当地奖励,该方法评估每项奖励是否反映行动对任务成功的影响,以及是否可能改进参考政策。 然后,它利用嵌入式取样,将依赖行动的奖励与持续噪音区分开来,并利用背景-土匪培训,优化选定州的政策。 Berkeley函数调用领导板v4的实验将诊断选定州的培训与替代州的培训进行比较。 对于缺失函数任务,诊断在工具可用后选择响应;对于缺失参数任务,诊断在提供缺失参数之前选择响应. 培训选定的应对办法提高了绩效,包括在失能任务方面达到约14个百分点,而培训替代办法则使绩效平平或差。 我们进一步在各种模式和任务中应用秘方,包括记录的重复呼叫和内存管理。

articles.title: onPanda: Efficient Annotation of On-Policy Alignment Data for LLMs and Agents via Token-Level Correction
articles.content: We present onPanda, an interactive tool for efficiently annotating LLM alignment data and agent trajectories. onPanda adopts token-level correction as its core interaction: while reading a model response, the annotator locates the first inappropriate token and either picks a substitute from the model's candidate tokens or types the correct text via free-form editing. The system then truncates everything after that position and continues generation from the corrected prefix, repeating this locate-correct-continue loop until a satisfactory response is obtained. This mechanism lets annotators precisely steer model outputs at low cost: a small controlled study suggests that onPanda reduces median annotation time by 52% over manual post-editing. Since the vast majority of tokens in the final response are generated by the model itself, the resulting data largely preserves the model's sampling distribution and is well suited for constructing on-policy SFT and preference data. Furthermore, the token-level corrections recorded during annotation provide fine-grained supervision with precise positions and naturally paired positive--negative samples. onPanda also connects to external tools and harnesses, enabling interactive trajectory annotation in realistic environments. In addition, we release Panda-CVL, a dataset annotated with onPanda, together with a benchmark for token-level correction.

articles.title_zh: 关于熊猫的:通过Token-level校正高效地说明关于LLMS和代理的政策统一数据
articles.content_zh: 我们在熊猫上展示一个互动工具,用于高效地注释LLM校正数据和代理轨迹. 在"熊猫"上采用符号级校正作为其核心交互:在读取模型响应时,注释者会定位第一个不合适的符号,或者从模型的候选符号中选择一个替代品,或者通过自由格式编辑来打出正确的文本. 系统然后中断该位置后的一切,再从被更正的前缀中继续生成,重复这个定位-正确-连续循环,直到得到令人满意的响应. 这种机制让注释者以低成本精确地引导模型输出:一个小的控制研究表明,熊猫在手动编辑后将中位注释时间减少52%. 由于最终反应中的绝大多数信使都是由模型本身产生的,由此产生的数据在很大程度上保留了模型的采样分布,非常适合构建政策性SFT和偏好数据. 此外,在注解中记录的象征性的校正提供了精确位置的精细监督,以及自然成对的正阴性样本。 熊猫号上还连接到外部的工具和取用,使得在现实环境中能够进行交互的轨迹注释. 此外,我们还发布了"熊猫-CVL",该数据集附加了"熊猫"的注释,同时发布了"象征级修正"的基准.

articles.title: Harness-Zero: Harness Distillation via Agent-as-Harness
articles.content: Agent harnesses, the external systems that mediate model-environment interaction, can substantially improve agent performance, but their gains remain tied to the harness at deployment. Because the best harness varies across domains, instances, and models, a general-purpose agent must either settle for a suboptimal shared harness or route among an ever-growing set of specialized ones. We therefore study agent harness distillation: using a domain- or instance-optimized harness as training-time guidance and transferring the behaviors it induces into model weights, so that its gains survive under a single fixed target harness. The challenge is that the two harnesses differ in action space and available information, so guidance from the optimized harness cannot serve directly as supervision for the target one. We introduce Harness-Zero, which enables harness distillation through agent-as-harness. Guided by the optimized harness, a harnessing agent corrects student responses before execution in the target harness's action space, turning harness guidance into training demonstrations. Fine-tuning on the resulting trajectories internalizes harness-induced behavior into the model, so the specialized harness can be removed at deployment. Our experiments spanning knowledge work, tool use, and science domains show that: (1) For frontier LLMs using the same evolved harness, agent-as-harness outperforms code-as-harness. (2) With the specialized harness removed at deployment, Harness-Zero improves the base model's macro-average task success from 23.3% to 44.3%, even exceeding the 41.7% it reaches with that harness still attached. (3) Harness-Zero recovers harness-induced behaviors absent from the base model, with 82.3% average recovery across 28 patterns in the three domains.

articles.title_zh: Harness-Zero:通过Agent-as-Harness进行Harness消毒
articles.content_zh: 代理操纵,即调解模型-环境相互作用的外部系统,可以大大改善代理性能,但其收益仍然与部署时的操纵有关。 由于各种领域、实例和模型中最佳的利用方式各不相同,因此,普通用途代理人必须找到一种低于最佳的共享利用方式,或者在不断增长的一套专门工具中找到一条路线。 因此,我们研究了毒剂的利用蒸馏:利用域或实例优化的利用作为培训时间的指导,并将它诱导的行为转移到模型加权,从而使其收益在单一固定的目标利用下得以生存。 面临的挑战是,这两种手段在行动空间和现有信息上有所不同,因此,来自优化手段的指导不能直接作为目标之一的监督。 我们介绍Harness-Zero, 它能通过毒剂-As-harness来利用蒸馏。 在优化的绳索的指引下,绳索剂在目标绳索的动作空间执行前会校正学生的反应,将绳索导引向转化为训练演示. 对由此产生的轨迹进行精细调整,将牵引行为内化为模型,因此在部署时可以移除专用牵引. 我们跨越知识工作、工具使用和科学领域的实验表明:(1) 对于使用同样进化的杠杆的前沿有限责任公司来说,“一流的代理”比“一流的代理”要好。 (2) Harness-Zero在部署时拆除了专用的吊带,使该基座模型的宏观平均任务成功率从23.3%提高到44.3%,甚至超过了仍然固定在吊带上的41.7%。 (3)Harness-Zero恢复了基础模型中缺失的牵引行为,三个领域28种模式的平均恢复率为82.3%。

articles.title: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
articles.content: An LLM agent's capability is largely magnified by its harness, namely the prompts, control flow, tooling, memory, and context management surrounding the frozen backbone model. Recent methods increasingly automate this process by iteratively proposing and selecting component-wise edits of an agent harness, practically establishing a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI) at the agent-system level. However, such recursive evolution may overfit by memorizing the training tasks, showing large in-distribution gains that shrink or even vanish on out-of-distribution benchmarks. We introduce Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses (RRSI), which incorporates the principles of regularizations into harness self-improvement by constraining the evolution candidate proposal and selection. The proposer operates with a temporally annealed budget, limiting how many edits a candidate can bundle, and it encourages unexplored trajectories based on evolution history. The selector is equipped with a critic and a pruner: the critic screens benchmark-specific proposals, while the pruner, removes changes that are too small, too expensive, or no longer useful. Together these constraints favor reusable agent mechanisms over benchmark-specific ones or even noises. Across eight benchmarks spanning coding, agentic workspace and engineering design tasks, RRSI gains up to 14.1 points on the split it evolves against and up to 4.7 points on the five out-of-distribution benchmarks, while producing a harness that runs on 30% fewer policy tokens than the unregularized evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/google-research/rrsi and project page is https://regularized-rsi.com/.

articles.title_zh: RRSI: 特工哈内塞斯的定期自我改进
articles.content_zh: 一个LLM代理的能力在很大程度上被它的操纵所放大,即围绕冷冻骨干模型的导体,控制流,工具,内存和上下文管理. 最近的方法越来越多地使这一过程自动化,办法是迭代地提议和选择按元件编辑一种代理机,实际上在代理系统一级建立一种递归自我改进的形式。 然而,这种递归性演变可能过于适合训练任务,显示出巨大的分配收益,这些收益在分配外的基准上缩小甚至消失。 我们引入了哈内塞斯特工(RRSI)的规范化自我改进(RRSI),通过限制进化候选人的建议和选择,将规范化原则纳入自我改进。 提议者在运作时带有暂时性厌倦的预算,限制了一个候选人可以捆绑的编辑次数,它鼓励基于进化史的未探索的轨迹. 选手配备有评委和普鲁士:评委筛选具体基准提案,而普鲁士则删除过小,太贵,或不再有用的更改. 这些制约因素加在一起有利于可重复使用的代理机制,而不是特定基准机制,甚至还有噪音。 跨越编码、代理工作空间和工程设计任务的8个基准,RRSI在与分配外的5个基准相对应的划分上得分最高达14.1分,在分配外的5个基准上得分最高达4.7分,同时产生一个比非规范化演变少30%的政策标志的牵引力。 代码见https://github.com/google-research/rrsi,项目页面见https://rentized-rsi.com/.

articles.title: DolphinBench: Mapping the Pareto Frontier of Agent Memory
articles.content:
Agents today often take real-world actions that depend on long-term memory and context recall over time. However, most current memory benchmarks are built for a conversational question-answer format, where the question itself signals that some fact must be retrieved, and often which one. Moreover, benchmarks rarely require anything beyond accuracy from submissions, allowing memory systems to make unreasonable cost/time tradeoffs to achieve higher scores.
  We present DolphinBench, a benchmark that evaluates memory directly through an agent's task completion. DolphinBench includes three knowledge-work personas with roughly 500k tokens of user messages per persona and evaluates agents on tasks that depend on information from that history. We verify all 200 tasks per persona by running an agent with and without the relevant history, requiring success with it and failure without it.
  Finally, we require all evaluations to report total cost and latency alongside accuracy, which enables us to evaluate agent memory systems holistically. No existing memory benchmark combines all three. The dataset and evaluation code are available at https://dolphinbench.ai.

articles.title_zh: 海豚奔驰:绘制代理记忆的帕雷托边疆图
articles.content_zh:
今天的代理人往往采取现实世界的行动,这些行动取决于长期记忆和背景的回顾。 然而,目前大多数的内存基准都是为对话式的问答格式而构建的,其中问题本身表示某些事实必须检索,而且常常是哪个事实. 此外,基准很少从提交材料中需要超出准确性的任何内容,使内存系统能够作出不合理的成本/时间权衡,以达到更高的分数。
我们提出"海豚本奇" 这个通过代理任务完成 直接评估内存的基准 Dolphin Bench包括三个知识-工作人物,每人有大约500k的用户信息符号a,并评价代理人执行依赖于该历史信息的任务. 我们通过管理一个有相关历史和没有相关历史的代理人来核实每个人的所有200项任务,这需要成功和失败。
最后,我们要求所有评价报告总成本和耐久性,同时报告准确性,使我们能够对代理记忆系统进行整体评价。 没有现有的内存基准将全部三者合并. 数据集和评价代码见https://dolphinbench.ai。

articles.title: Emergent Collusion in Long-Horizon LLM Agent Interaction
articles.content: LLM agents are increasingly deployed in collaborative settings, yet long-term interaction may give rise to undesirable coordination. We study the emergence of collusion in a long-horizon multi-agent environment: two agents repeatedly complete individual tasks, share task logs, verify each other's work, and receive rewards. We introduce realistic constraints that make compliance with the verification protocol incompatible with reward maximization, and find that agents increasingly deviate from the protocol over repeated interactions. Collusion emerges in 94% of trajectories across 10 models, and more capable models within the same family reach it earlier. Controlled peer interventions show that collusion is shaped by peer behavior, while ablations reveal additional effects of reward structure, the verification feedback agents receive, and their interaction history. In particular, restricting the amount and scope of interaction history available to agents reduces collusion. Overall, our findings show that long-horizon interaction can reshape how agents coordinate in ways that create safety risks.

articles.title_zh: 长视线LLM的紧急碰撞 代理交互
articles.content_zh: 在协作环境中越来越多地部署LLM代理人,但长期互动可能导致不可取的协调。 我们研究在长距离多代理环境中串通的出现:两位特工反复完成个人任务,共享任务日志,互相验证工作,获得奖励. 我们实行现实的限制,使遵守核查议定书与奖励最大化不相容,并发现代理人越来越多地偏离议定书,而不是反复互动。 94%的轨迹出现于10种模型中,同一家族中更有能力的模型更早到达. 受控制的同行干预表明,串通是由同行行为形成的,而串通则揭示了奖励结构、核查反馈代理及其互动历史的额外影响。 特别是,限制代理人所能利用的互动历史的数量和范围,减少了串通。 总体而言,我们的调查结果表明,长期互动可以改变代理人如何以造成安全风险的方式进行协调。

articles.title: Jev for Scientific Decisions: Evaluating Semantic Choices and Their Consequences
articles.content: Scientific workflows often require choosing among known relations before a deterministic calculation can proceed. Whether observations share a culture, treatment or reference standard can change the scientific meaning of the resulting count or comparison. We evaluate Jev as a semantic decision component using a harness that follows its documented guidance and assigns arithmetic to code. The study compares twelve model configurations on twenty source-grounded Choices across ten scientific cases, each repeated five times. We measure semantic selections, downstream outputs and final claim labels separately. Jev matched five other configurations at complete semantic correctness and achieved the lowest observed median latency among successful responses. Across three comparison models, seven wrong selections on one culture-history question changed downstream counts while preserving the correct final label. These results identify a useful role for Jev in prepared scientific decision tasks and show why evaluating that role requires checking the relations and quantities that a workflow will reuse.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 科学决定联合会:评估语义选择及其后果
articles.content_zh: 科学工作流程往往要求在进行确定性计算之前,在已知的关系中作出选择。 观测是否共享一个文化,处理或参考标准,可以改变所得出的计数或比较的科学意义. 我们评价Jev是一个语义决定部分,使用一种遵循其文献指导并分配算术来编码的绳索。 该研究比较了十种科学案例的二十种基于来源的选择的十二种模型配置,每次重复五次. 我们分别衡量语义选择、下游产出和最后索赔标签。 Jev在完全语义正确性方面与另外五个配置进行了匹配,在成功反应中实现了观测到的最低中位延迟。 在三个比较模型中,一个文化-历史问题的七个错误选择改变了下游的计数,同时保留了正确的最终标签。 这些结果确定了Jev在已准备好的科学决策任务中的有益作用,并表明为什么评价这一作用需要检查工作流程将重复使用的关系和数量。

articles.title: Linguistic Features for Interpretable Textual Entailment
articles.content: Despite the success of neural models in natural language processing, their black-box nature limits interpretability and conceals the linguistic phenomena underlying their predictions. We present SLITE, an explainable hybrid model for Recognizing Textual Entailment that integrates two complementary layers of semantic analysis: a structural-relational layer, based on semantic compatibility and incompatibility between compositional entities, and a distributional-informational layer, based on structured patterns of information change between embedding-based representations of the premise and the hypothesis. We propose 17 features that combine entity-level semantic relations, polarity-sensitive lexical matching, and alignment measures over semantic sub-representations of the similarity matrix, including measures based on entropy and transfer entropy. A logistic regression trained on these features achieves an accuracy of 83% on three-class SICK and 96% on SICK-CE, outperforming IsoLex by 4 percentage points and falling within 2 percentage points of RoBERTa with a fraction of its computational complexity. Ablation studies and SHAP analysis confirm that structural-relational features are the primary drivers of classification, while distributional-informational features provide essential complementary contributions, particularly for detecting neutrality and contradiction. Our results demonstrate that further exploration of hybrid approaches is a viable and scientifically productive alternative to massive neural architectures, and we hope they will strengthen the dialogue between linguistic theory and computational modeling of inference

articles.title_zh: 可解释文本尾注的语言特征
articles.content_zh: 尽管神经模型在自然语言处理中取得了成功,但其黑盒性质限制了可解释性,并隐藏了其预测背后的语言现象. 我们提出了SLITE,一种用于识别文本的可解释的混合模型,它融合了两个互补的语义分析层:一个结构-关系层,基于语义兼容性和组成实体之间的不兼容性;一个分布-信息层,基于嵌入式的前提和假设之间的信息变化的结构模式. 我们提出17个特征,将实体级语义关系,极性敏感语法匹配,以及类似语义亚代表矩阵的对齐度量,包括基于 en和转移 en的度量. 对这些特性进行后勤回归培训后,三等SICK的精度为83%,SICK-CE的精度为96%,优于IsoLex的精度为4个百分点,低于RoBERTA的2个百分点,其计算复杂性只有一小部分。 分布式研究和SHAP分析证实,结构关系特征是分类的主要驱动力,而分布式信息特征则提供了重要的互补贡献,尤其是对于发现中立性和矛盾. 我们的结果表明,进一步探索混合方法是替代大规模神经结构的可行和有科学效益的替代方法,我们希望这些方法将加强语言理论与计算推论模型的对话.

articles.title: SocioVerse2: A Longitudinal Dynamic Social Simulation Framework under a Human-AI Co-evolutionary Paradigm
articles.content: Social simulation offers the social sciences an experimental instrument that the real world cannot supply, and generative agents have transformed it by acting as silicon samples that unite agent-based modeling with real behavioral data. Existing platforms verify collective behavior, align simulated populations with real societies in cross-sections, and employ autonomous agents for the research process. However, two social science requirements remain without systematic support: intervention in the content of a simulation and the researcher's control over the process that produces it. We present SocioVerse2, which extends SocioVerse 1.0 into a human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm built from two loops and one infrastructure. The longitudinal simulation loop simulates the target population with evolving environments and forks counterfactual branches via interventions. The controllable research loop takes the study itself as an editable state and updates state versions via controllable editing. The social science agentic infrastructure carries both loops through composable skills with researcher checkpoints, a population service over five persona pools, and an environment service over 21 real-world signal sources with point-in-time guarantees. We validate SocioVerse2 across three case families and seven case studies, from reproducing canonical agent-based models to modeling policy processes on real records and nowcasting macro-economic indices beyond the response model's knowledge cutoff. With the human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm, these cases go beyond system demonstrations to become substantive studies that investigate frontier questions in their respective disciplines. Code, data services, and a workbench are released as open-source resources.

articles.title_zh: SocialVerse2:人类-AI共同革命范式下的纵向动态社会模拟框架
articles.content_zh: 社会模拟为社会科学提供了现实世界无法提供的实验仪器,基因化剂通过作为硅样品,将基于物剂的模型与真实的行为数据联合起来,使其发生转化. 现有平台验证集体行为,将模拟人群与真实社会结合到截面中,并为研究过程使用自主代理. 然而,两项社会科学要求仍然得不到系统的支持:对模拟内容的干预和研究人员对产生模拟的过程的控制. 我们介绍的是SocialVerse2,它把SocialVerse 1.0扩展为由两个环路和一个基础设施构建的人类-AI共同进化范式. 纵向模拟循环通过干预模拟目标人群的不断变化的环境和叉反事实分支. 可控研究环将研究本身作为可编辑状态,并通过可控编辑更新状态版本. 社会科学代理基础设施通过与研究人员检查站的可调合技能、一个超过5人池的人口服务以及一个超过21个实时信号源的环境服务,提供点对点保障。 我们验证了3个案例家庭的 " SocialVerse2 " 和7个案例研究,从复制以犬科为主的模型,到在真实记录上建立政策进程的模型,以及现在在反应模型的知识断层之外对宏观经济指数进行模拟。 有了人类-AI共同进化的范式,这些案例超越了系统演示,成为调查各自学科前沿问题的实质性研究. 代码,数据服务,和一个工作本位作为开源资源发布.

articles.title: ToneCL: Contrastive Learning for Few-Shot Syllable-Level Tone Classification
articles.content: Tone languages constitute over 50-70% of the world's languages, but the vast majority are low-resource, lacking the large transcribed corpora needed for automatic tone classification. Existing datasets are typically collected at the sentence level, whereas field linguists require fine-grained syllable-level annotations. We propose ToneCL, a lightweight contrastive learning framework for few-shot syllable-level tone classification. We simulate low-resource conditions on Mandarin and Vietnamese, limiting labeled data to tens of examples per tone class. ToneCL is pretrained on unlabeled speech with augmentations that preserve tonal identity, then fine-tuned on few-shot examples. Experiments show our method consistently outperforms baselines, achieving 91.6% on six-speaker Mandarin at 10 shots. Cross-lingual transfer is also effective: pretraining on Vietnamese and fine-tuning on Mandarin reaches 91.0\% accuracy at 10 shots. Ablation confirms that frequency band rejection is the most critical augmentation.

articles.title_zh: ToneCL: 少Shot Syllable-Level Tone 分类的对比性学习
articles.content_zh: 通音语言占世界语言的50-70%以上,但绝大部分是低资源,缺乏自动音调分类所需的大转写体. 现有的数据集一般是在句子层次上收集的,而字段语言学家则需要细写音节层次的说明. 我们提出ToneCL,一个轻量级对比性学习框架,用于几发音节级音调分类. 我们模拟普通话和越南语的低资源条件,将标注数据限制在每声调类的几十个例子. TONECL在无标签的语音上预训,辅音保存了Tonal特性,然后微调了几个镜头的例子. 实验显示我们的方法 持续超过基线, 实现91.6%的六语普通话 在10点。 跨语言转接也有效:越语预训和普通话精细化10发达到91.0\%精度. 膨胀证实了频率波段拒绝是最关键的增强.

articles.title: Human-LLM Deliberation as Interactive Proof: Conditions for Verifiability Without Transparency
articles.content: When an LLM supplies an argument that a user could not readily construct, how can the user decide whether to accept its claim? Inspired by interactive proofs, we model human-LLM deliberation as an interaction between a prover with unrestricted internal search and a resource-bounded human verifier. The verifier requests and checks supporting details without access to the LLM's internal state. Passed checks accumulate evidence toward an acceptance threshold. We prove anytime-valid soundness against adaptive provers: the probability of ever accepting a false claim is at most a chosen error level, provided the task supplies bounds on false passes and human checking errors that remain valid after every relevant history. A finite-horizon completeness bound additionally requires bounds on the adequacy of honest responses and sufficient diagnostic progress. Further checks can strengthen the evidence for acceptance, but each requires another adequate response and reliable human effort. Whether this tradeoff permits certification depends on the verifier's effort budget, cognitive load, expertise, and fatigue. We identify conditions under which the supplied bounds certify a specified sequence of local checks but not a specified global check under the same resource budgets.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 作为互动证据的人类-LLM审议:没有透明度的可验证性的条件
articles.content_zh: 当一个LLM给出一个用户无法轻易构造的论点时,用户如何决定是否接受其主张? 在互动证据的启发下,我们把人-LLM审议作为一种互动,一种具有不受限制的内部搜索的证明人与资源约束的人类验证人之间的互动. 核查员要求并检查支持性细节,而不能访问LLM的内部状态. 通过检查后,证据累积到接受阈值。 我们证明随时对适应性证明人的正确性:接受虚假主张的概率最多只能是所选择的误差水平,只要任务提供虚假通行证的界限和在每一有关历史之后仍然有效的人检查错误。 有限范围的完整性还需要对诚实反应的充分性和充分的诊断性进展加以约束。 进一步检查可以加强接受的证据,但每项检查都需要另一种充分的反应和可靠的人力努力。 这种权衡是否允许认证取决于核查者的努力预算、认知负荷、专门知识和疲劳。 我们确定条件,根据这些条件,提供的范围可以证明当地检查的特定顺序,但不能证明同一资源预算下的具体全球检查。

articles.title: SLICEChat: Progressive In-Encoder Token Pruning for Whole-Slide Pathology Language Models
articles.content: Whole-slide pathology images (WSIs) contain gigapixel-scale visual content, creating a major scalability challenge for slide-level multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing approaches process thousands of patch tokens and typically apply compression only after slide encoding, leaving multimodal attention computationally expensive. We introduce SLICEChat, a slide-level MLLM that integrates progressive token pruning within a hybrid Mamba--Transformer slide encoder. Mamba layers enable efficient long-range propagation, while Transformer layers preserve global interactions as the sequence is progressively shortened. Between stages, language-supervised, region-aware pruning removes spatially coherent low-utility regions under a controlled keep-rate schedule, producing compact slide representations before multimodal fusion. On SlideBench VQA, SLICEChat achieves 79.84% accuracy on TCGA and 59.09% on BCNB cohorts, outperforming prior slide-level pathology MLLMs, and achieves the highest overall WSI-Bench metrics. It also provides competitive memory usage and the inference latency among the evaluated models. These results demonstrate accurate and computationally efficient multimodal reasoning over gigapixel WSIs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SLECCHAT:全滑病理学语言模型的进化编码器
articles.content_zh: 全滑病理图像(WSI)包含千兆像素尺度的视觉内容,为滑动级的多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)创造了重大的可伸缩性挑战. 现有方法处理上千个补丁符号,一般只在幻灯片编码后进行压缩,使多式联运注意力计算成本昂贵. 我们介绍SLICEChat, 一种滑动级的MLLM, 它将渐进式的符号调试 在一个混合的Mamba-Transformer幻灯片编码器中。 Mamba层能够有效进行远距离传播,而变形器层随着序列的逐渐缩短而保持全球相互作用。 在各阶段之间,语言监督、区域意识的穿透消除了在控制保持率时间表下空间一致的低效用区域,在多式联运聚变之前产生紧凑的幻灯片表示。 在SlidBench VQA上,SLICEChat在TCGA上达到79.84%的精度,在BCNB组中达到59.09%,比之前的滑行级病理MLLMs表现优异,并实现了WSI-Bench总的测量标准最高. 它还提供有竞争力的内存使用和被评价模型的推断。 这些结果表明,在千兆像素和西施方面,采用精确和计算高效的多式联运推理。

articles.title: OSWorld-Pro: Process-based Evaluation for Computer Use Agents
articles.content: Evaluation of Computer-Use Agents (CUAs) is often limited to the final deliverables they create (at the end of hundreds of steps) and assessed with functional verifiers, as seen in OSWorld. However, such evaluation of end-state performance lacks transparency into how and why agents fail in various tasks, obfuscating critical insight for subsequent improvement. For instance, agents that err during keyboard inputs would require a different mitigation strategy from those that fail to precisely provide click-based inputs on the graphical UI. We introduce OSWorld-Pro: a set of over 300 tasks containing over 2800 subgoals to enable the procedural evaluation of CUAs grounded in over 67,000 human annotations. We use robust human-aligned LLM-Judges to evaluate the fulfillment of OSWorld-Pro subgoals and thereby reveal the progress that models make throughout a series of sequentially dependent subgoals. Our findings reveal that OSWorld-Pro is challenging even for state-of-the-art LLMs, with top performers like Claude Opus 5 achieving only 75.7% vs. 83.4% on OSWorld. Furthermore, we identify critical process-focused failure modes of various models (e.g. subgoal-irrelevant actions and click-based mistakes) to provide insights to improve performance and efficiency of CUAs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OS World-Pro:计算机使用代理人基于程序的评价
articles.content_zh: 对计算机使用代理(CUAs)的评价往往局限于它们(在数百个步骤的尽头)产生的最终可达到的目标,并用功能验证器进行评估,这在OSWorld中可以看到. 然而,对结束状态业绩的这种评价缺乏透明度,无法了解代理人如何和为什么在各种任务中失败,从而模糊了以后改进的重要见解。 例如,在键盘输入时出错的代理商需要不同的缓解策略,而不是那些无法准确提供图形用户界面输入的基于点击的策略。 我们介绍OSWorld-Pro:一套300多项任务,其中包括2 800多个次级目标,以便能够根据67 000多篇人文说明对海关协调会进行程序评价。 我们利用与人类一致的LLM法官来评价OSWorld-Pro次级目标的实现情况,从而揭示模式在一系列依次依赖的次级目标方面取得的进展。 我们的发现显示,OSWorld-Pro甚至对最先进的LLMS也具有挑战性,克洛德·奥普斯5等顶尖表演者在OSWorld上只取得了75.7%对83.4%的成绩. 此外,我们确定各种模式(如次级目标相关行动和点击错误)的关键的以进程为重点的失败模式,以便提供见解,提高统一协议的绩效和效率。

articles.title: The Copy Ceiling: An Input-Exposure Control for Ontology-Grounded Generation over Curated Corpora
articles.content: When a language model answers from a curated corpus via graph-based retrieval, a large grounding uplift does not establish reasoning over the retrieved structure: the context may already expose the gold answers. We propose exposure accounting, which classifies each gold item by whether the shown context exposes it and whether the answer recovers it. Its scalar reference is the copy ceiling, the recall a verbatim copy of the context achieves; signed gain over copy measures the model's recall relative to this deterministic, judge-free baseline. Across ten models, unaided recall averages 0.26 and grounded recall 0.92, yet gain over copy is uniformly negative (-0.067 to -0.022). Of 11,360 gold-item observations, representing 1,136 target instances evaluated under ten models, only three unexposed items receive lexical credit. A stratified model-judged audit of 423 observations, with a symmetric quotation-verification policy, estimates that 97.1% of credited items assert the requested relation; all three unexposed credits fail relational adjudication. On targets the scaffold does not expose, lexical recovery falls from 0.121 unaided to 0.004 grounded; adjudication validates 71 of the 92 unaided credits and none of the three grounded credits, without establishing full-frame relational recovery rates. Rephrasing questions outside the graph's title vocabulary reduces exposure from 0.964 to 0.328, while an absence-triggered fallback activates on only 2 of 506 questions. A paired production study improves judged quality by +0.27 pooled, but negative controls do not establish content specificity beyond a well-formed on-corpus block. These results support exposure accounting as a standing control for corpus-derived evaluations. The accounting distinguishes exposed-item omissions from beyond-exposure recoveries; it does not determine whether reasoning occurred.

articles.title_zh: 复制上限:肿瘤全方位生成在Curated Corpora上的输入-曝光控制
articles.content_zh: 当一个语言模型通过基于图表的检索来回答一个解析器时,一个大的地基提升并不能建立对被检索结构的推理:上下文可能已经暴露出黄金解析. 我们建议进行接触衡算,根据所显示的上下文是否暴露,以及答案是否恢复,对每个黄金项目进行分类。 它的刻度参考是副本的上限,上下文的逐字记录;相对于这一确定性、无法官基线,该模型相对于副本的缩写,签名收益。 在十个模式中,无援助召回的平均值为0.26,有依据召回的平均值为0.92,但收益高于副本则一致负数(-0.067至-0/022)。 在11 360项黄金项目观察中,有1 136项是按10种模式评估的目标,只有3项未曝光项目获得法证。 对423项意见进行分级的模型判断审计,并采用对称的报价核查政策,估计97.1%的贷记项目坚持要求的关系;所有3个未暴露的信用都未能通过关系判断. 在脚手架没有暴露的目标上,无援助的词汇回收率从0.121降至0.004;判决确认92个无援助信贷中的71个,3个有依据信贷中的71个,但没有确定全面关系回收率。 重写图标题词汇以外的问题,将曝光量从0.964降至0.328,而一个缺席触发的回落则在506个问题中仅有2个启动. 配对生产研究通过+0.27集合提高判断质量,但负控不能确定超出公司成型良好的块的含量特异性. 这些结果支持将接触情况核算作为对从属评价的长期控制。 会计区分了暴露项目的遗漏和暴露之外的回收;它不能确定是否发生了推理。

articles.title: Decomposing Error and Style in Automated Clinical Coding
articles.content: In automated clinical coding, where the label space spans tens of thousands of diagnosis and procedure codes, models are currently evaluated against a single gold annotation, treating any deviation as error. But we find when two teams code the same 110 ACI-Bench encounters, they agree on only 73% of codes (Jaccard similarity) for the same note; even after an independent clinical audit removes erroneous codes, agreement rises only to 77%. Is that gap error or something systematic? We model the systematic component as coding style $ψ$, a coder- or site-specific policy over what to code and how much to document, and recast coding as $p(\mathrm{code}\mid\mathrm{note},ψ)$, estimating $ψ$ with a 10-dimension rubric. If style were noise, conditioning on it would do nothing. Instead, across five datasets a model conditioned with a data-matching style raises ICD F1 by up to 26 points and an extreme mismatched one lowers it by up to 21. Four prompt based coding methods spanning 39-49 F1 converge to 52-56 once style is supplied (All p<0.05). Much of what single-gold evaluation charges to model error is recoverable, unmodeled style.
