articles.title_zh: 自动临床编码中的解析错误和样式
articles.content_zh: 在自动临床编码中,标签空间跨越数以万计的诊断和程序代码,模型目前根据单一的金注进行评价,将任何偏差都视为错误。 但我们发现,当两个团队编码相同的110 ACI-Bench相遇时,他们只同意73%的代码(Jacccard相似性)用于同一注解;即使在独立的临床审计删除错误代码后,协议只上升到77%. 差距错误还是系统性的? 我们把系统组件模拟为$\$的编码样式、关于编码内容和记录内容的编码器或站点特定政策,并将编码重编为$p(\mathrm{code}\mid\ mathrm{note}},\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ 如果风格是噪音, 调节它不会做什么。 相反,在5个数据集中,一个以数据匹配风格为条件的模型将ICD F1提升高达26分,一个极端不匹配将它降低高达21分. 一旦提供了样式(所有p<0.05),将跨越39-49 F1的四种即时编码方法汇合到52-56。 用于模型错误的单金评价费大多是可回收的,没有模型的风格.

articles.title: Extracting Arguments, Not Just Classifying Them: Instruction-Tuned LLMs for Generative Component Detection
articles.content: Argumentative component detection (ACD) is a core subtask of Argument(ation) Mining (AM) and one of its most challenging aspects, as it requires jointly delimiting argumentative spans and classifying them into components such as claims and premises. While research on this subtask remains relatively limited compared to other AM tasks, most existing approaches formulate it as a simplified sequence labeling problem, component classification, or a pipeline of component segmentation followed by classification. In this paper, we propose ITFACD, a novel approach based on instruction-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) using compact instruction-based prompts, and reframe ACD as a language generation task, enabling arguments to be identified directly from plain text without relying on pre-segmented components. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that our approach achieves higher performance compared to state-of-the-art systems. To the best of our knowledge, this is one of the first attempts to fully model ACD as a generative task, highlighting the potential of instruction tuning for complex AM problems. Our code and the datasets used are openly available in the following GitHub repository.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 提取参数, 不仅仅是分类主题: 用于基因组件检测的指令- 调制 LLMs
articles.content_zh: 辩证成分探测(ACD)是辩证(配方)采矿(AM)的核心子任务,也是其最具挑战性的方面之一,因为它要求共同划定辩证期限并将其分类为债权和房地等组成部分。 虽然与其它AM任务相比,对这一子任务的研究仍然相对有限,但大多数现有方法将其表述为简化序列标签问题,组件分类,或组件分解的管道,然后分类. 在本文中,我们提出ITFACD,这是一种以使用紧凑指令制导的提示的指令调制大语言模型(LLMs)为基础的新颖方法,并将ACD重新设定为一种语言生成任务,使得各种论点能够直接从纯文本中识别出来,而不依赖于预分部分的组件. 对标准基准的实验表明,我们的方法比最先进的系统取得了更高的业绩。 据我们所知,这是作为基因任务全面模拟ACD的最初尝试之一,突出了为复杂的AM问题进行教学调谐的潜力。 我们的代码和所使用的数据集在下面的GitHub寄存器中公开提供.

articles.title: The Answer-Basin Representation Hypothesis: We Are Not Probing or Steering Concepts
articles.content: The Linear Representation Hypothesis associates high-level concepts with directions in language models, but it remains unclear how these concept-related linear structures are organized within the model. We propose the Answer-Basin Representation Hypothesis: the probability measure induced over answers by the model's continuation distribution organizes these linear structures, with its statistics represented along linear directions shared across questions. All continuations yielding the same answer form an answer basin, whose mass is their total probability. These basin masses define the pushforward probability measure over answers. We posit that concept-related linear structure emerges from differences in the answer measure rather than being determined by changes in concept labels. Experiments across models and tasks link concept-consistent effects and their reversals in probing and steering to the alignment between concept labels and the answer measure.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 回答-基础陈述假设:我们不是试验或指导概念
articles.content_zh: 线性表达假说将高层次的概念与语言模型中的方向联系起来,但仍然不清楚这些与概念相关的线性结构是如何在模型内组织的. 我们提出Answer-Basin代表假设:模型持续分布所引发的对答案的概率度量,组织这些线性结构,其统计数据按线性方向排列,在各种问题之间共享。 所有续作产生相同的答案形成一个答案盆地,其质量是其总概率. 这些盆地群定义了推向概率度量,而不是答案。 我们假定,与概念有关的线性结构来自答案计量的差异,而不是由概念标签的变化决定。 跨模型的实验和任务将概念一致的效果及其在探测和引导概念标签与答案度量的校正上的逆转联系起来.

articles.title: MSI-Bench: Evaluating Multi-Speaker Voice Interaction for Collaborative AI Agents
articles.content: Voice provides a natural and immediate interface for AI agents. Many settings in which voice agents could be useful, including meetings, households, and collaborative work, are inherently multi-speaker. Supporting these settings introduces challenges that are largely absent from one-on-one interaction. We introduce the Multi-Speaker Interaction Benchmark (MSI-Bench) for evaluating multi-speaker voice interaction. Each test case is a short multi-party multi-turn audio scene with participant context, expected tool calls, and atomic rubrics. The benchmark targets three capability families: multi-speaker memory, multi-speaker instruction following, and multi-speaker reasoning. It comprises 1,152 test cases, evenly split between Mandarin Chinese and English (576 each). The strongest configuration on each split passes all rubrics on only 66.8% of English and 54.5% of Mandarin cases, and the strongest open-weight configuration on 34.0% and 19.3%. Failure analysis separates perception from reasoning: open-weight models are bottlenecked by the multi-speaker audio front-end, while frontier systems still fail speaker-scoped decision making on clean transcripts---and models across the board often respond when no one has addressed them. These results identify speaker-grounded perception, speaker-scoped decision making, and conversational restraint as concrete targets for future voice agents.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MSI-Bench:评价大赦国际合作代理人的多语种语音互动
articles.content_zh: 语音为AI代理提供了自然和即时的接口. 语音代理商可以发挥作用的许多环境,包括会议、家庭和协作工作,本质上是多语种。 支持这些环境带来了一对一互动基本上缺失的挑战。 我们采用多语种互动基准(MSI-Bench)来评价多语种语音互动。 每个测试案例是一个简短的多党多回合音频场景,包含参与者上下文,预期工具调用,以及原子主题. 该基准针对三个能力家族:多语种记忆,多语种教学跟随,多语种推理. 它包括1,152个测试病例,平均分为普通话和英语(各576个). 每个拆分时最强的配置只通过66.8%的英语和54.5%的普通话病例的所有标题,最强的开放量配置则通过34.0%和19.3%。 失败分析将认知与推理区分开来:开放量级模型被多语种音频前端的瓶颈,而前沿系统仍然无法对干净的语录作出演讲者范围的决定——和全局模型在无人处理时经常做出回应. 这些结果确定,以发言者为基础的认识、以发言者为对象的决策以及对话上的克制是未来语音代理人的具体目标。

articles.title: When Quantization Preserves Accuracy but Not Evidence: Explanation-Aware Post-Training Quantization for Medical LLMs
articles.content:
Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment of large language models, and PTQ methods are usually optimized and evaluated with generic reconstruction, perplexity, or answer accuracy. But in explanation-critical domains, preserving only the final answer may be insufficient, since users may also inspect generated rationales to judge whether a prediction is trustworthy. We study this issue in medical multiple-choice question answering, where rationales should provide evidence that supports the selected answer.
  We propose an explanation-aware objective for transformation-based PTQ. Our method builds an offline faithfulness cache from full-precision teacher rationales and uses it during optimization to preserve answer-supporting evidence tokens and evidence-conditioned answer behavior. We instantiate it on OSTQuant under W4A4KV4 quantization and evaluate four 7B--8B medical and instruction-tuned LLMs on MedExQA, MedExpQA, and ChallengeClinicalQA. While a same-calibration OSTQuant baseline preserves task accuracy, it can substantially weaken answer-supporting rationales. Our objective is to preserve the full-precision model's answer-supporting behavior rather than improve gold-label accuracy, and our method better preserves the full-precision model's answer behavior and rationale-to-answer support. These results suggest that PTQ for explanation-critical settings should evaluate preservation of answer-supporting evidence, not only answer accuracy. Code and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/dut0817/EAQuant.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当量化保值保存准确但非证据:解释-对医学法学硕士课程进行了解后量化时
articles.content_zh:
训练后量化(PTQ)可以高效地部署大型语言模型,PTQ方法通常被优化和评价,具有通用重建,迷惑性,或回答准确性. 但在解释关键域中,只保留最后答案可能是不够的,因为用户还可以检查所产生的理由,以判断预测是否可信。 我们在医学的多选择问题回答中研究这个问题,其中的理由应当提供支持选定答案的证据.
我们提出了一个基于转化的PTQ的解释意识目标. 我们的方法从完全精密的老师原理中构建了离线的忠实缓存,并在优化时使用它来保存支持解答的证据符号和有证据条件的回答行为. 我们在W4A4KV4量化下在OSTQuant上进行即时分析,并对MedExQA、MedExpQA和ChallengeClinicalQA上的4个7B-8B医疗与指导调制LLMs进行评估。 虽然OSTQuant相同的校准基线能够保持任务准确性,但它可以大大削弱回答支持的理由。 我们的目标是保留全精度模型的答案支持行为,而不是提高金质标签的准确性,我们的方法更好地保存全精度模型的答案行为和理性对答案的支持. 这些结果表明,用于解释关键设置的PTQ应当评价对答案支持证据的保存,而不仅仅是答案的准确性. 守则和评价脚本见https://github.com/dut0817/EAQuant。

articles.title: Adapting Tree-Structured Speculative Decoding to DeepSeek-V4 for Efficient Inference
articles.content: Repeated execution of the target model during autoregressive decoding is a major source of LLM inference latency. Unlike linear speculation, which follows a single candidate chain, tree-structured speculation retains multiple branches from shared prefixes; under the same budget, this broader coverage can improve acceptance and efficiency. Adapting it to DeepSeek-V4 is nontrivial: its CSA/HCA online compressed attention concentrates the difficulty on the target-verify side, where branches diverging from a shared prefix compress into different states, breaking cross-branch state consistency. We integrate tree-structured speculative decoding into the DeepSeek-V4-Flash pipeline via branch-aware causal verification, temporary state isolation, and accepted-path state refresh, keeping verification and compressed-state updates consistent across branches. Across budgets D=5 to D=8, batch sizes 1 to 64, and three datasets (GSM8K, MBPP, ShareGPT), tree speculation achieves a higher accepted length than the matched linear configurations in all settings (e.g., at D=8 about 2.83--3.41 versus 2.39--2.84) and improves throughput in nearly all configurations---marginal only at the smallest budget---by up to about 18.5%. More importantly, the gains follow stable, transferable regularities: the relative gain grows with the budget and is most pronounced for less predictable workloads at small-to-medium batch sizes, while beyond a certain budget throughput plateaus and decouples from the still-rising accepted length. These results show that retaining multiple candidate paths under the same budget can effectively improve DeepSeek-V4 decoding efficiency, and offer experience for adapting speculative decoding to future models with compressed, sparse, or structured context representations.

articles.title_zh: 将植树式光谱解码器调整为DeepSeek-V4,以高效推论
articles.content_zh: 目标模型在自旋解码过程中的重复执行是LLM推论延迟的一个主要来源. 与遵循单一候选链的线性投机不同,树结构投机保留了共享前缀的多个分支;在同一预算下,这种更广泛的覆盖范围可以提高接受率和效率. 使其适应DeepSeek-V4是非三角性的:其CSA/HCA在线压缩注意力将难度集中在目标验证侧,其中分支从共享前缀压缩到不同的状态,打破跨分支状态一致性. 我们通过分支意识因果核查、暂时状态隔离和接受路径状态更新, 将树结构的投机解码整合到DeepSeek-V4-Flash管道中, 在所有预算D=5至D=8、批量尺寸1至64以及三个数据集(GSM8K、MBPP、ShareGPT)中,树投机在所有情况下都实现了比对应线性配置更高的公认长度(例如,D=8约为2.83-3.41,相对于2.39-2.84),几乎所有配置的吞吐量只有最小的预算比18.5%左右。 更重要的是,收益遵循稳定、可转移的规律:相对收益随着预算的增长而增加,而且对于小到中型批量规模的较不可预测的工作量而言最为明显,而超出一定的预算吞吐量高原,与仍在增长的公认长度脱钩。 这些结果表明,在同一预算下保留多个候选路径可以有效地提高DeepSeek-V4解码效率,并提供经验,以压缩、稀疏或结构化的上下文表示方式使投机解码适应未来的模型。

articles.title: Muon Can Outperform Dedicated Continual Learning Methods
articles.content: Continual learning with Low-Rank Adapters (LoRA) typically mitigates forgetting by penalizing the overlap between a new update and the accumulated past weights, which discourages certain update directions without controlling how an update distributes its energy over the ones that remain. We ask whether that restriction has to be task-aware, or whether a generic one supplied by the optimizer is enough. We train a plain incremental LoRA (IncLoRA) with Muon, which orthogonalizes each update, and compare it against O-LoRA and ELLA over five seeds and three task orders on the Standard CL Benchmark and three seeds on TRACE. IncLoRA+Muon reaches the accuracy band of the dedicated methods on Standard CL and improves on every AdamW configuration on TRACE. One update-constraining mechanism is enough, whether it comes from the loss or from the optimizer; on Standard CL a second one does not help, and for the most restrictive method it costs 8.4 points of accuracy and the plasticity to fit each task. What separates the two optimizers is not the size of the update, which under Muon is 0.91 to 2.06 times that under AdamW, but how it is distributed. AdamW confines it to between 1.4 and 1.8 effective singular directions, Muon spreads it over 7.0, and the two do not overlap in any tracked run. Part of the advantage usually attributed to dedicated CL methods may therefore be explained by the geometry of the optimizer's updates.

articles.title_zh: Muon Can 超越专有的继续学习方法
articles.content_zh: 与Low-Rank适配器(LORA)的不断学习通常通过惩罚新的更新与过去累积的权重之间的重叠来缓解遗忘,这不利于某些更新方向,而不会控制更新如何将其能量分配到剩下的那些上. 我们问,这种限制是否必须认识到任务,还是由优化者提供的一般性限制就够了。 我们与Muon一起训练一个平坦增量的LORA(IncLORA),将每次更新进行正交化,并将它与O-LORA和ELLA相比,在标准CL基准上的5个种子和3个任务订单以及TRACE上的3个种子. IncLORA+Muon在标准CL上达到了专用方法的精度波段,并在TRACE上改进了每个AdamW配置. 一个更新-约束机制就足够了,无论是来自损失还是来自优化器;在标准CL上,第二个机制无济于事,对于最限制性的方法来说,它需要8.4分的准确性和可塑性来适应每项任务. 将两个优化器分开的不是更新的大小,在穆恩下是亚当W下的0.91到2.06倍,而是如何分配. 亚当W将其限制在1.4到1.8有效单向之间,穆恩将其分布在7.0,两者在任何履带运行中都不重叠. 因此,通常归属于专用CL方法的部分优势可能由优化器更新的几何来解释.

articles.title: Circuit Hypernetworks for Quantum-Augmented Diffusion Language Models
articles.content: Language models can be adapted by changing the computations applied to individual tokens. Quantum circuits offer one such approach, but evaluating wider circuits inside a large model can be computationally demanding. Here we introduce HyperQ, which adds token-conditioned quantum residual branches to a frozen masked-diffusion language model. A quantum residual branch is a module in each transformer block that reads a token's hidden state, emits the coordinates of that token's circuit, executes it, and adds the measured values back through a residual connection. The backbone remains frozen, and only the added branches are trained. Within each branch, a lightweight circuit hypernetwork emits token-specific rotation angles, coupling strengths, and measurement axes in a shared sparse circuit structure. The required expectation values have an exact classical expression whose evaluation cost grows linearly with the qubit count, enabling circuits from 16 to 64 qubits to be trained within a 1.1-billion-parameter backbone. Across downstream benchmarks, increasing circuit width raises the average score from 47.65 to 54.30. At 64 qubits, HyperQ exceeds the backbone and its low-rank-adapted counterpart by 4.71 and 3.67 points, respectively. HyperQ is fine-tuned on 20,000 prompt-response pairs, compared with 200,000 for the classical baselines. These findings support token-conditioned circuit emission as a tractable architectural approach to quantum-augmented language modelling.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 量子增强扩散语言模型的电路超网络
articles.content_zh: 语言模型可以通过改变应用于单个符号的计算方式来调整. 量子电路提供一种这样的方法,但评价一个大模型内较宽的电路可以进行计算要求. 在这里,我们引入了HyperQ,它为冷冻的遮掩扩散语言模型添加了象征性的有条件的量子残留分支. 量子剩余分支是每个变压器块中的一个模块,它读取一个符号的隐藏状态,释放那个符号的电路的坐标,执行它,并通过一个剩余连接来添加测量值. 骨干仍然被冻结,只有新增的分支才得到训练. 在每个分支内部,一个轻量级的电路超网络会发出特定符号旋转角度,结合优势,以及共享的稀疏电路结构中的测量轴. 要求的预期值有一个精确的古典表达式,其评价成本随着方位计的线性增长,使得16到64个方位的电路能够在11亿参数的骨干范围内得到训练. 纵观下游基准,线路宽度的增加将平均得分从47.65提高到54.30。 在64qubits上,HyperQ分别以4.71和3.67的点数超过主干及其低排名的适应对应. HyperQ在20,000对快速响应对上进行了微调,而古典基线则有20万对. 这些发现支持以象征性条件的电路排放作为量子增强语言建模的一种可牵引的建筑方法.

articles.title: Assessing Readability with LLMs: The Role of Reasoning and Few-Shot Prompting
articles.content: Readability assessment is essential for tailoring texts to intended audiences across educational, healthcare, and information retrieval domains. However, traditional readability formulas struggle to generalize across genres and languages, while supervised machine learning models rely on scarce, domain-specific annotated corpora, limiting their applicability--particularly for less-resourced languages. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a highly scalable, multilingual alternative that requires no task-specific training, yet the impact of advanced prompting strategies on their performance remains underexplored. In this paper, we conduct a systematic benchmark of diverse open-source LLMs for multilingual readability assessment, focusing on the prediction of discrete readability levels required by educational frameworks. In addition to English, we evaluate our approach on a less-resourced language, Slovenian, to establish whether LLMs remain effective in low-resource settings. Specifically, we investigate the influence of explicit reasoning, demonstrating that Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting and reasoning-oriented models yield significant improvements over direct answering. Furthermore, our exploration of few-shot in-context learning reveals that providing just one labelled example per category (1-shot) substantially enhances prediction quality compared to zero-shot settings, with additional examples offering diminishing returns. By comprehensively comparing these approaches against traditional unsupervised metrics and state-of-the-art supervised baselines, we establish the viability of out-of-the-box LLMs as robust, cross-lingual readability assessors.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 使用法学硕士评估可读性:理性和少点刺激的作用
articles.content_zh: 可读性评估对于使文本适合教育、保健和信息检索领域的预期受众至关重要。 然而,传统的可读性公式难以在流派和语言中通用,而受监督的机器学习模型则依赖于稀缺的,专有域的附加说明的corpora,限制了它们的应用性——特别是对于资源较少的语言. 大语言模型(LLMs)提供了一个高度可扩展的多语种替代方案,不需要针对特定任务的培训,然而,先进的促进战略对其业绩的影响仍然没有得到充分利用。 在本文中,我们为多语种可读性评估对多种开放源代码的LLMs进行了系统化的基准,重点是预测教育框架所需的离散可读性水平。 除英语外,我们评价我们采用资源较少的语言斯洛文尼亚语的做法,以确定在资源匮乏的情况下,法学硕士是否仍然有效。 具体地说,我们调查了明确推理的影响,表明 " 思考链 " (Cain-of-thought (CoT))所激发的和以推理为导向的模型比直接回答有了重大的改进。 此外,我们探索的少部分镜头内文字学习显示,每个类别(一镜头)只提供一个标注的例子,与零镜头设置相比,大大提升了预测质量,其他例子显示回报率正在下降。 通过将这些方法与传统的不受监督的衡量尺度和最新受监督的基线进行全面比较,我们确定外部有限责任公司作为稳健、跨语言的可读性评估员的可行性。

articles.title: Written as a Record, Read as an Address: What a Forward Pass Leaves in an Operation's KV Cache
articles.content: When a language model reads an operation such as "Swap the contents of Box F and Box B", its forward pass writes keys and values for those tokens into the KV cache. Prior work on entity tracking establishes what models use: bindings are resolved at query time rather than stored as explicit latent state. We ask what they write at the operation span and how it is accessed. We split a forward pass into a frozen writer and a reader: the writer's cache is recomputed without gradients, while the reader sees only the instruction and operation tokens, with all state descriptions hidden, and is trained in isolation. Anything the reader recovers was therefore already present in the unmodified cache. On a synthetic boxes task, a base reader recovers $\leq 0.06$ of queried bindings against $0.75$--$1.00$ after training, and recoverability tracks the operation's read/write footprint. We find two modes of access. Across Llama-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B, operation-span transplants causally redirect which visible state is read even when the two worlds hold identical values, revealing a routing record. Isolation training preserves routing and adds direct access to the payload, the value the operation read, from the single operand-name token in a narrow mid-depth band (layers 12--15 of 32 in Llama-3.1-8B, 14--17 in Mistral-7B) --- the same site that holds the routing record. The same recipe extends to further operations, ToMi and GSM8K, but is bounded by training coverage and costs open-book accuracy. Operation tokens thus leave localized, causally recoverable records that support both routing and direct payload access, though the model that writes them reads mainly the address they carry and not the value.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 写入为记录, 读作地址: 操作 KV 缓存中会留下什么前传
articles.content_zh: 当一个语言模型读取"将Box F和Box B的内容扫描"等操作时,其前传将这些符的密钥和值写入KV缓存. 以前关于实体跟踪的工作确定了模型使用什么:绑定在查询时解决,而不是作为明确的潜伏状态储存。 我们询问他们在行动期间写了什么,以及如何获取。 我们把一个前传分成一个冷冻的编剧和一个读者:编剧的缓存被重编而无梯度,而读者只看到指令和操作符,所有状态描述都隐藏着,被隔离训练. 因此,阅读器恢复的任何东西已经存在未修改的缓存中。 在合成箱任务中,一个基础阅读器从0.75美元到1.00美元的询问装订费中回收0.06美元,并且可回收性跟踪操作的读写脚印。 我们找到两种进入方式。 在Llama-3.1-8B和Mistral-7B两地,操作-span移植因果重定向,即使两个世界持有相同的值,可见状态也会被读取,揭示出一条路由记录. 隔离式训练保留了路由,并增加了对有效载荷的直接访问,操作值读取,从一个狭小的中深波段(Llama-3.1-8B的32层中的12-15层,Mistral-7B的14-17层)的单个操作名符号上看得出——这个地点是拥有路由记录的同一地点. 同样的配方也适用于进一步的操作,即TOMI和GSM8K,但以培训的覆盖面和开本准确性的费用为限。 因此,操作标志留下了局部的、可因果收回的记录,这些记录既支持路由,也支持直接有效载荷的存取,尽管写这些记录的模型主要读取它们携带的地址,而不是价值。

articles.title: Custom Named Entity Recognition and Topic Classification for Global Health Publications
articles.content: How should natural language processing models be selected and adapted for global health literature in environments where annotated data and computational resources are limited? This thesis investigates these challenges through experiments on semantic tag discovery, named entity recognition (NER), and multi-label topic classification. First, skip-gram word2vec models trained on progressively larger specialized corpora are compared with BioWordVec to assess how corpus size and domain context influence tag discovery. Vocabulary coverage and qualitative evaluation indicate that broader coverage does not necessarily yield more useful domain-specific associations. The analysis then turns to entity extraction, comparing convolutional spaCy models with a RoBERTa-based transformer on 1,000 annotated sentences. Under a lenient scoring protocol, the transformer achieves 0.80 micro-F1 versus 0.65-0.69 for convolutional models, but takes 82 seconds rather than 5-6 seconds. This trade-off motivates fine-tuning convolutional models and integrating a disease recognizer that achieves 81.33% test F1 on the NCBI Disease Corpus. Combined with PDF preprocessing, entity filtering, and MeSH enrichment, the resulting pipeline supports document-level indexing. To complement entity extraction with thematic annotation, MiniLM-based few-shot classification is compared with BART-MNLI zero-shot inference across 50 topics and 1,000 handcrafted test sentences. BART-MNLI achieves 95.2% single-label accuracy versus 59%; reported multi-label accuracies are 88% and 32% under partly manual assessment. However, its higher inference cost limits practical integration. The results show where domain specialization and lightweight adaptation offer practical value, and where transformer accuracy justifies higher inference costs, providing an empirical basis for building knowledge systems under resource constraints.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 全球卫生出版物的自定义实体识别和专题分类
articles.content_zh: 在附加说明的数据和计算资源有限的环境中,应如何选择自然语言处理模型并对其进行调整,以用于全球卫生文献? 此论文通过关于语义标记发现的实验,命名实体识别(NER),以及多标签主题分类来调查这些挑战. 首先,对正在逐渐扩大的专门化公司进行测试的跳格格词2vec模型与BioWordVec进行了比较,以评估生物体大小和域背景如何影响标记的发现。 词汇覆盖面和定性评价表明,更广泛的覆盖面不一定产生更有用的特定领域协会。 分析后转向实体提取,比较进化温泉 在1000个注解句子上带有基于RoBERTa的变压器的Cy模型. 在宽松的评分协议下,变压器在转录模型上实现0.80微F1对0.65-0.69,但需要82秒而不是5-6秒. 这种权衡激励了精细的演化模型,并结合了一种疾病识别器,在NCBI疾病体格上实现了81.33%的F1测试. 由此产生的管道与PDF预处理、实体过滤和MeSH浓缩相结合,支持文件级索引编制。 为了用主题注释来补充实体提取,将基于MiniLM的几发分类与BART-MNLI的零发推断进行比较,涉及50个专题和1000个手工测试句. BART-MNLI的单标签精度为95.2%,而59%;报告的多标签精度为88%,部分人工评估为32%。 然而,其较高的推论成本限制了实际的整合. 结果显示,在哪些领域专业化和轻量级适应具有实际价值,在哪些领域变压器准确性证明推论成本较高,为在资源制约下建立知识系统提供了经验依据。

articles.title: UK-PRBENCH: A Paragraph-Level Precedent Retrieval Benchmark for United Kingdom Case Law
articles.content: Prior case retrieval (PCR) aims to identify precedent cases relevant to a given query case. Existing PCR benchmarks and methods predominantly operate at the document level, treating entire judgments as the unit of relevance. This formulation is suboptimal for legal practitioners, as judgments address multiple legal issues and only a small subset of paragraphs is relevant to a particular query. Addressing this gap, we introduce UK-PRBench, a benchmark for paragraph-level precedent retrieval in UK case law, constructed from judgments obtained from the UK National Archives and covering a broad range of UK courts and tribunals. Furthermore, we evaluate state-of-the-art retrieval models and establish baseline results. Our experiments show that paragraph-level precedent retrieval remains challenging for current retrieval approaches, highlighting substantial room for improvement. UK-PRBench provides a standardised benchmark for evaluating fine-grained precedent retrieval and advancing retrieval systems for the UK legal domain.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 英国-英国:联合王国的分款检索基准 判例法
articles.content_zh: 先前的案件检索(PCR)旨在确定与特定查询案件有关的先例案例. 现有的PCR基准和方法主要在文件一级运作,将整个判决视为相关的单位。 这种提法对法律从业人员来说不够理想,因为判决涉及多个法律问题,只有一小部分段落与特定查询相关。 为了弥补这一差距,我们采用了联合王国-PR Bench,这是联合王国判例法中分款一级先例检索的基准,以联合王国国家档案馆的判决为基础,涵盖广泛的联合王国法院和法庭。 此外,我们评价最先进的检索模型,并确定基线结果。 我们的实验表明,对于目前的检索方法而言,段级先例检索仍然具有挑战性,这突出表明有很大的改进余地。 UK-PR Bench为评价完善的先例检索和推进联合王国法律领域的检索系统提供了标准基准。

articles.title: Evaluating Decision Models for Text Annotation in Computational Social Science
articles.content: Computational social science increasingly relies on large language models for text annotation, and the validity of published findings now rests on the labels generated by such models. Decision models, a new model class built for categorical question answering, answer typed questions with a choice, a probability distribution over the label set, and a confidence score rather than free text, at a small fraction of frontier inference prices. Whether their answers are accurate, and whether that stated confidence can be trusted on social science constructs, are unknown. Here, we mirror the evaluation of Ziems et al. (2024) on 18 computational social science classification tasks (7,977 items), comparing the first commercial decision model and two open-weight counterparts against 19 frontier and open-weight language models under the same zero-shot protocol. The decision model trails the per-task best LLM on 14 of 15 evaluation tasks, with a median deficit of 11.6 macro-F1 points, at a median 44 times lower measured cost. Its confidence is better calibrated than the verbalized confidence of 16 of the 19 LLMs, yet three frontier models show lower median calibration error (0.157 against 0.066). While items above 0.9 confidence are typically labeled accurately (median accuracy 0.815), on one task, empathy in peer-support dialogues, the model reports high confidence while performing near chance. Nonetheless, our results suggest that decision models are useful as a first step in the annotation pipeline: routing low-confidence items to an LLM matches or exceeds the LLM alone at a quarter to half of its cost.

articles.title_zh: 评价计算社会科学中文本注释的决定模型
articles.content_zh: 计算社会科学越来越依赖大语言模型来进行文字注释,现在公布的研究结果是否有效取决于这些模型所产生的标签. 决策模型,一个为断然回答问题而构建的新模型类,以选择方式回答打字的问题,在标签集上概率分布,信心分数而不是自由文本,以边框推断价格的一小部分. 他们的答案是否准确,以及所宣称的信心是否能够相信社会科学的构造,是未知的. 在这里,我们反映Ziems等人(2024年)对18项计算社会科学分类任务的评价(7,977项),将第一个商业决策模型和两个开放量级对应模型与19个前沿和开放量级语言模型进行同一零镜头协议下的比较. 决策模式在15项评价任务中的14项上跟踪了每个任务中最佳的LLM,中位赤字为11.6个宏观-F1点,中位值为计量成本的44倍。 它的置信度比19个LLMs中16个的口服置信度更准,然而有3个前沿模型显示中位校准误差较低(0.157对0.066). 虽然0.9以上项目通常被贴上准确的标签(中间准确度0.815),但有一项任务,即同行支持对话中的同情,模型报告,在进行近乎偶然的情况下,具有高度的信心。 然而,我们的结果表明,决策模式作为说明程序的第一步是有用的:将低信心项目与LLM匹配,或以成本的四分之一至一半超出LLM。

articles.title: Toward a Unified Mathematics of Concepts
articles.content: Concepts are commonly defined as abstract, compact representations of knowledge and treated as basic units of intelligent behavior. Yet, cognition, psychology, and AI lack a shared mathematical language for them. Modern systems represent concepts as vectors, distributions, symbols, graphs, and other structures, but these formalisms are typically treated as competing rather than as solutions to a common problem. We propose an operation-based view that evaluates mathematical frameworks by the conceptual operations they support, identifying thirteen operations (including similarity, composition, generalization, and grounding) that recur across cognition, psychology, and AI. We show that ten frameworks embody distinct commitments to concepts as self-contained content, relational structure, or evolving process, and that these commitments determine which operations each supports naturally. For example, vector-based models facilitate graded similarity and generalization but struggle with explicit composition, whereas symbolic models support composition but offer but generalize poorly. No single framework we examined naturally supports all operations without extension. We test this account empirically using categorization as a case study, operationalizing nine theories on the same items against human judgments. Despite addressing the same conceptual question, the theories produce different procedures and results, demonstrating that mathematical commitment shapes what a theory can explain. We call for hybrid formalisms that treat content, relation, and process as jointly primary.

articles.title_zh: 迈向概念的统一数学
articles.content_zh: 概念通常被定义为抽象的,紧凑的知识表现,并被作为智能行为的基本单位对待. 然而,认知、心理学和AI缺乏一种共同的数学语言。 现代系统代表着作为矢量,分布,符号,图表等结构的概念,但这些形式主义一般被视作是相互竞争的,而不是共同问题的解决方案. 我们提出一种基于操作的观点,通过它们支持的概念操作来评价数学框架,确定13个在认知、心理学和AI之间反复出现的操作(包括相似性、组成、概括性和地基). 我们显示,10个框架体现了对概念的不同承诺,即自足内容、关系结构或不断发展的进程,这些承诺决定了每个行动自然支持哪些行动。 例如,基于矢量的模型可以促进分级的相似性和通用性,但与明确的构成有矛盾,而象征性的模型则支持组成,但提供但通用性差。 我们所审查的任何单一框架都自然支持所有没有延期的行动。 我们实证地用分类作为案例研究来检验这一账户,根据人类的判断,将关于同一项目的9个理论付诸实施。 尽管解决了同样的概念问题,理论产生不同的程序和结果,表明数学承诺决定了理论能够解释什么. 我们呼吁将内容、关系和进程视为共同首要的混合形式。

articles.title: QLoRA Fine-Tuning of Ministral LLM for Sequence-to-Function Protein Annotation
articles.content: Functional annotation of newly sequenced proteins remains a bottleneck in molecular biology: the number of sequences in public repositories grows far faster than the capacity for manual curation. Most computational approaches consider annotation as multi-label classification over a fixed ontology, which constrains predictions to a predefined label set. In this work we study the the protein annotation as a sequence-to-text generation problem. We fine-tune the 3B-parameter Ministral 3 base model with QLoRA (4-bit NF4 quantization with low-rank adapters) on sequence annotation pairs. We assess predictions with an LLM-as-expert protocol: a GPT model prompted as a senior molecular-biology curator scores organism identification as binary and function annotation quality. We conclude that QLoRA-fine-tuned compact LLMs can generate curator-style annotations with genuine biological value for a substantial subset of proteins. We also discuss future directions in data quality, model scaling, and evidence grounding that are needed to make the approach sufficiently reliable for practical use.

articles.title_zh: QLORA 序列到功能蛋白质注释的 LLM 省部级分类
articles.content_zh: 对新测序蛋白的功能注释仍然是分子生物学中的一个瓶颈:公共寄存器中的序列数量增长远快于人工解析能力. 大多数计算方法将注解视为一个固定的本体学上的多标签分类,这把预测限制在预先定义的标签集上. 在这个作品中,我们研究蛋白质注释作为一个序列到文本生成问题. 我们用QLORA(4位NF4四配位适配器)来微调3B参数Ministry 3基型在序列注释配对上. 我们用一个LLM-as-专家协议来评估预测:一个GPT模型作为高级分子生物学导师将机体识别分数为二进制和函数注释质量. 我们的结论是,QLORA-fine-tuned 紧凑的LLMS可以生成具有真正生物价值的对大量蛋白质子集的图谱式说明. 我们还讨论了今后在数据质量、模型规模和证据基础方面的方向,这些方向是使这一方法具有足够可靠性以供实际使用所必需的。

articles.title: LLJ Cards: Best practices for the Use of LLMs as Judges
articles.content: In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a popular alternative for evaluation. Often referred to as LLMs as judges (LLJs), these systems have been widely adopted by researchers and practitioners across a broad range of measurement tasks, driven by their strong performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness relative to human judgment. However, a growing body of work has shown that the use of LLJs raise concerns about their validity and reliability as evaluators. Existing efforts to address these challenges have largely focused on developing bias-mitigation techniques and refining prompting strategies. While these approaches represent an important step forward, they primarily offer technical fixes and leave a more fundamental challenge unaddressed: the lack of standardized, transparent, and reproducible evaluation practices. In this paper, we introduce LLJ Cards, a framework that synthesizes best practices from measurement theory, natural language generation, and machine learning literature into practical guidelines for LLJ-based evaluations. While LLJs offer a promising path toward scalable evaluation, their effective use requires grounding in rigorous evaluation principles to ensure validity, reliability, and reproducibility. LLJ Cards addresses this need by providing a structured framework for applying these principles in the design and reporting of automated evaluations.

articles.title_zh: 法学长 纸牌 : 利用法学硕士作为法官的最佳做法
articles.content_zh: 近年来,大语言模型(LLMs)逐渐成为流行的评价替代品. 这些系统通常被称为LLMs作为法官(LLJs),在广泛的计量任务中被研究人员和从业人员广泛采用,其驱动力是其强性能,可扩展性,相对于人类判断的成本效益. 然而,越来越多的工作表明,有限责任法官的使用引起了对其作为评价人员的有效性和可靠性的关切。 应对这些挑战的现有努力主要侧重于开发减轻偏见技术和完善激励战略。 虽然这些办法是向前迈出的重要一步,但它们主要提供了技术解决办法,留下了更根本的挑战,即缺乏标准化、透明和可复制的评价做法。 在本文中,我们引入了LLJ卡,这个框架综合了从测量理论,自然语言生成,机器学习文献中的最佳做法,成为基于LLJ的评价的实用指南. 虽然法学专业人员为可扩展评价提供了一条大有希望的道路,但其有效利用需要建立在严格的评价原则的基础上,以确保有效性、可靠性和可复制性。 法学长 卡片满足了这一需要,为在自动评价的设计和报告过程中应用这些原则提供了一个结构化的框架。

articles.title: Fathom-Vaidya: Advancing Medical Reasoning with Rubric-Based Rewards
articles.content: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in healthcare requires robust performance across two complementary dimensions - diagnostic reasoning: the convergent, evidence-driven task of inferring a patient's condition from clinical data to produce a diagnosis, and clinical healthcare reasoning: the broader, navigational judgment required to communicate, plan, and adapt across multi-turn clinical interactions where a single correct answer may not exist. Recent benchmarks such as HealthBench and MedXpertQA reveal persistent weaknesses in both areas, exposing failures in complex diagnostic scenarios and limitations in contextual, patient-centered dialogue. We introduce a sequential training framework that targets these facets using synthetic data and rubric-based reinforcement learning. First, we improve diagnostic reasoning using MedBullets-derived questions with rule- and rubric-guided Reinforcement Learning (RL). We then shift to clinical reasoning by generating 5.3k synthetic multi-turn scenarios, each paired with multi-dimensional rubrics to comprehensively assess the response. This approach yields over 10% improvement on MedXpertQA, and our 30B model achieves 50.1% accuracy on HealthBench-Hard, surpassing proprietary baselines including GPT-5 (thinking). Our results show that targeted synthetic datasets and rubric-based training can systematically improve both diagnostic and interactive clinical reasoning in medical LLMs.

articles.title_zh: Fathom-Vaidya:用基于Rubric的奖励来推进医疗理性
articles.content_zh: 在保健领域应用大语言模型需要两个相辅相成的方面——诊断推理:从临床数据推断病人的病情以产生诊断,以及临床保健推理:在可能不存在单一正确答案的情况下,在多回合临床互动中进行沟通、规划和适应所需的更广泛的导航判断。 最近的基准,如Health Bench和MedXpertQA,揭示了这两个领域持续存在的弱点,暴露了复杂诊断情景中的失败和以病人为中心的对话的局限性。 我们采用一个连续培训框架,利用合成数据和基于主题的强化学习,针对这些方面。 首先,我们用“MedBullets”衍生的问题改进诊断推理,并采用规则和标题指导的强化学习(RL)。 然后我们转向临床推理,产生5.3k合成的多转折场景,每个场景都配以多维线条来全面评估反应. 这个方法在MedXpertQA上获得了超过10%的改进,我们的30B模型在Health Bench-Hard上达到了50.1%的准确度,超过了包括GPT-5(思考)在内的专有基线. 我们的结果表明,有针对性的合成数据集和基于主题的培训能够系统地改进医学法学硕士的诊断和互动临床推理。

articles.title: 1% of Tokens Can Be Enough: On Gradient Estimation in On-Policy Distillation
articles.content: Sparse on-policy distillation (OPD) allocates teacher supervision to a small subset of tokens in student-generated trajectories. However, useful teacher guidance can yield a noisy update when its gradient is estimated from a sampled next token. We study this estimation problem at a fixed prefix in information geometry and propose an information-efficiency ratio (IER) based on a signal-to-noise decomposition. IER characterizes relative gradient estimation error under an optimal scalar baseline. A candidate-set approximation enables token selection based on IER and its combination with existing usefulness scores, while retaining the sampled reverse-KL training objective. On mathematical and medical reasoning tasks, adding IER improves existing selectors in multiple settings, with sparse configurations matching or exceeding full OPD without token selection at small token budgets of 0.1\%--1\%. These results support accounting for both usefulness and gradient-estimation reliability when allocating sparse supervision. Our code is available at https://github.com/BruceSheng1202/IER-OPD.

articles.title_zh: 1%的托肯可以满足:在政策扭曲中进行渐进估计
articles.content_zh: Sparse on Political discription(OPD)在学生生成的轨迹中,将老师的监管分配到一个小子集. 然而,有用的教师指导可以在从下个指标样本中估计其梯度时产生噪音更新。 我们在信息几何的固定前缀中研究这个估计问题,并基于信号对噪分解提出信息效率比(IER). IER在最佳斯卡尔基线下描述相对梯度估计误差. 候选人设置的近似可以使符号选择建立在IER及其与现有有用分数的结合基础上,同时保留抽样的反KL训练目标. 在数学和医学推理任务上,加入IER会改善多个环境中现有的选择器,在0.1\%-1\%的小符号预算下,零星的配置匹配或超过完整的OPD,而不选择令牌. 这些结果支持在分配分散的监督时既考虑到效用,又考虑到梯度估计的可靠性。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/BruceSheng1202/IER-OPD上查阅。

articles.title: End-to-end Jordanian dialect speech-to-text self-supervised learning framework
articles.content: Speech-to-text engines are extremely needed nowadays for different applications, representing an essential enabler in human-robot interaction. Still, some languages suffer from the lack of labeled speech data, especially in the Arabic dialects or any low-resource languages. The need for a self-supervised training process and self-training using noisy training is proven to be one of the up-and-coming feasible solutions. This article proposes an end-to-end, transformers-based model with a framework for low-resource languages. In addition, the framework incorporates customized audio-to-text processing algorithms to achieve a highly efficient Jordanian Arabic dialect speech-to-text system. The proposed framework enables ingesting data from many sources, making the ground truth from external sources possible by speeding up the manual annotation process. The framework allows the training process using noisy student training and self-supervised learning to utilize the unlabeled data in both pre- and post-training stages and incorporate multiple types of data augmentation. The proposed self-training approach outperforms the fine-tuned Wav2Vec model by 5% in terms of word error rate reduction. The outcome of this work provides the research community with a Jordanian-spoken data set along with an end-to-end approach to deal with low-resource languages. This is done by utilizing the power of the pretraining, post-training, and injecting noisy labeled and augmented data with minimal human intervention. It enables the development of new applications in the field of Arabic language speech-to-text area like the question-answering systems and intelligent control systems, and it will add human-like perception and hearing sensors to intelligent robots.

articles.title_zh: 约旦方言端对端语音自控学习框架.
articles.content_zh: 语音到文本引擎是目前极为需要的,用于不同的应用,是人与机器人互动中必不可少的促进因素。 然而,有些语言缺乏标注的语音数据,特别是在阿拉伯语方言或任何低资源语言中。 事实证明,需要有一个自我监督的培训过程和通过吵闹的培训进行自我培训是不断更新的可行解决办法之一。 本条提出一个端对端,变压器为主的模型,框架为低资源语言. 此外,该框架还采用了定制的音频对文本处理算法,以实现高效的约旦阿拉伯语方言语音对文本系统。 拟议框架能够吸收许多来源的数据,通过加快人工注释过程,使外部来源的地面真相成为可能。 该框架使培训过程能够利用吵闹的学生培训和自我监督的学习,在培训前后阶段利用无标签的数据,并纳入多种类型的数据扩充。 拟议的自我培训方法在字数误差率降低方面,比微调后的Wav2Vec模型高出5%。 这项工作的成果为研究界提供了一套约旦语的数据集,以及处理低资源语言的端到端方法. 这是通过利用培训前、培训后和注射带噪音的标签和增加数据的能力来完成的,而人类的干预是最少的。 它能够开发阿拉伯语语音对文本领域的新应用,如问答系统和智能控制系统,还将在智能机器人中添加人形感知和听觉传感器.
